title: StateFlow: Building, Evolving, and Accessing 3D World States for Previsualization
summary: Previsualization is an intermediate layer between ideas and production in film, games, architecture, and urban design. It lets creators iteratively refine scenes, actions, cameras, and spatial-temporal dynamics. Yet existing generative methods rely on simple prompts to jointly control all of these factors through one-shot image or video synthesis, offering weak controllability and limited support for iterative editing. Fundamentally, a world comprises multiple elements with geometry, appearance, and other attributes, together with cameras. Different frames are produced through local modifications or recombinations of this shared state, which is otherwise largely reused. Therefore, we argue that the missing component is an explicit and persistent working state. To address this, we present StateFlow, a state-centric framework for generative previsualization. Rather than generating videos in one shot, StateFlow uses an editable 3D world to organize scene structure, evolution, and cameras, while off-the-shelf video models enhance visual quality when higher fidelity is desired. This world is maintained as a persistent structured 3D state of scene elements and camera configurations, serving as the core working representation for previsualization. Built on this insight, StateFlow has three stages to construct, evolve, and access the world state. State construction lifts generated 2D content into a coherent 3D world through prior-guided, conflict-aware dual-view initialization, while State evolution translates user intent into structured state transitions while preserving world memory, avoiding full-scene regeneration for each edit. State access uses render-feedback reflection to refine camera plans into visually feasible trajectories, avoiding reliance on VLM semantics alone. Experiments show that StateFlow produces high-quality 3D worlds for video creation and game-like prototyping.

AI.tldr: StateFlow是一个以显式可编辑3D世界为核心的状态中心生成式预可视化框架。区别于现有的一次性图像/视频合成方法，它通过持久化的结构化3D状态组织场景元素、演化和相机配置，将生成式预可视化分为状态构建、状态演化、状态访问三个阶段，实现更强的可控性和迭代编辑能力。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式预可视化方法依赖简单提示词通过一次性图像或视频合成来联合控制场景、动作、相机和时空动态，存在可控性弱、缺乏迭代编辑支持的问题。论文认为根本原因在于缺少一个显式且持久的工作状态——世界的本质是多个具有几何、外观等属性的元素与相机的组合，不同帧通过对共享状态进行局部修改或重组产生。
AI.method: StateFlow包含三个阶段：(1) 状态构建：通过先验引导、冲突感知的双视图初始化，将生成的2D内容提升为一致的3D世界；(2) 状态演化：将用户意图转化为结构化状态转换，同时保留世界记忆，避免每次编辑都重新生成完整场景；(3) 状态访问：使用渲染反馈的反思机制将相机计划精炼为视觉上可行的轨迹，不单纯依赖VLM语义判断。离线视频模型可在需要更高保真度时增强视觉质量。
AI.result: 实验表明StateFlow能够为视频创作和类游戏原型设计生成高质量3D世界。
AI.conclusion: 论文验证了以显式持久3D状态作为工作表示的状态中心框架对于生成式预可视化是有效的，该框架在保证高质量视觉输出的同时提供了更强的可控性和灵活的迭代编辑能力，弥补了现有生成方法在预可视化场景中的不足。

title: AVA-Encoder: Towards Agent-Native Video Representation Learning
summary: Creative agents still lack an effective way to learn from high-quality human films, limiting their ability to produce cinematic-grade videos. A key challenge is the absence of a structured video representation that is both faithful to film content and directly usable for agentic reasoning and manipulation. To address the challenge, we propose the Agentic Video Auto-Encoder (AVA-Encoder), a framework for learning agent-native video representations via agentic auto-encoding. AVA-Encoder transforms a video into a knowledge graph (KG) representation and then reconstructs it back into video. Its hierarchy and state nodes store structured text, while a linked asset layer holds generated images, audio, and video. Typed edges preserve the relations between these text descriptions and assets in a form that agents can easily understand, query, and edit. The video reconstruction differences drive a textual-gradient optimization framework, which expresses evaluation feedback as natural-language update directions for Data-Independent Encoding Policy Pseudo-Training in the outer loop and optional Data-Dependent KG Representation Refinement in the test-time inner loop. Extensive experiments show that AVA-Encoder improves by 20.7 percentage points over the strongest external baseline. In the controlled policy-only setting, its pseudo-trained shot-level Agentic Video Encoder policy also outperforms a carefully human-tuned policy while using 74.3% fewer system-prompt tokens. We release the complete AVA-Encoder framework, a reliable agentic video reconstruction benchmark, and the first dataset of high-quality film KG representations.

AI.tldr: 提出AVA-Encoder框架，通过代理自动编码将视频转换为知识图谱表示再重建回视频，利用文本梯度优化策略学习电影级视频表征，使创作智能体能够从人类高质量影片中学习。
AI.motivation: 创作型智能体缺乏从高质量人类电影中学习的有效途径，根本原因在于缺少一种既忠实于电影内容又可直接用于智能体推理与操作的视频结构化表示。
AI.method: 采用代理自动编码范式：将视频编码为知识图谱表示（包含层次结构节点、状态节点、资产层及类型化边），再将其重建为视频。重建差异驱动文本梯度优化框架，在外循环中进行数据无关的编码策略伪训练，在内循环（测试时）进行可选的依赖数据的知识图谱表示精炼。
AI.result: 相比最强外部基线提升20.7个百分点；在受控的纯策略设置中，伪训练的镜头级编码策略优于人工调优策略，同时系统提示词token减少74.3%。发布了完整框架、可靠的代理视频重建基准以及首个高质量电影知识图谱表示数据集。
AI.conclusion: AVA-Encoder为创作智能体提供了一种有效的代理原生视频学习方案，验证了知识图谱视频表示与文本梯度优化相结合的训练范式在电影级视频生成领域的可行性与优越性。

title: Beyond Trial-and-Error: Agentic Optimization for Image-to-Video Adherence
summary: Modern black-box Image-to-Video (I2V) models offer powerful capabilities in automated content creation, yet their lack of fine-grained control and reliability presents significant challenges in professional workflows. Their inherent stochasticity causes minor variations in textual prompts or hyperparameters to yield drastically different outputs often necessitating inefficient, brute-force trial-and-error processes. To address these limitations, we introduce the ``Agentic Self-Improvement" framework, which reframes video synthesis into a closed-loop, goal-directed optimization. Our framework systematically navigates the generation parameter space using a novel two-stage approach. In the first stage, an iterative prompt optimization loop uses a multimodal Large Language Model (mLLM) to refine the input prompt. This refinement implements two automated evaluations: Davidsonian Scene Graph (DSG) queries ensure semantic adherence, and Common Mistake Questions (CMQ) for artifact detection. At the second stage, we use Bayesian optimization to efficiently co-optimize stochastic seeds and CFG scales. This search is guided by a suite of quality metrics, including the novel Video-Text Adherence (VTA) score derived from the DSG and CMQ evaluations. Our framework significantly outperforms unguided search methods: in human preference studies, videos generated via our agentic approach were strongly preferred over baseline outputs, achieving win rates up to 69\%. This work provides a practical and extensible methodology for enhancing the predictability and control of state-of-the-art video generation models, moving the field beyond speculative curiosities toward reliable, production-ready tools.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Agentic Self-Improvement"框架，将黑盒文本到视频（I2V）生成重构为闭环的目标导向优化过程。该框架采用两阶段方法：第一阶段通过多模态大语言模型（mLLM）进行迭代提示词优化，利用Davidson场景图（DSG）查询确保语义一致性并检测伪影；第二阶段使用贝叶斯优化联合优化随机种子和CFG尺度，由包括新颖的Video-Text Adherence (VTA)分数在内的质量指标引导。在人类偏好研究中，该方法相比基线实现高达69%的胜率。
AI.motivation: 现有黑盒I2V模型虽然生成能力强，但缺乏细粒度控制和可靠性，微小的提示词或超参数变化会导致截然不同的输出，迫使专业人员依赖低效的暴力试错过程，难以满足专业工作流的要求。
AI.method: 提出Agentic Self-Improvement闭环框架，分为两个阶段：(1) 迭代提示词优化阶段，利用mLLM结合Davidson Scene Graph (DSG)查询和Common Mistake Questions (CMQ)两种自动化评估来精炼输入提示；(2) 贝叶斯优化阶段，协同优化随机种子和CFG缩放参数，由包括新提出的Video-Text Adherence (VTA)分数在内的质量指标套件引导搜索。
AI.result: 该框架显著优于无引导的搜索方法，在人类偏好研究中，智能体方法生成的视频对比基线输出获得强烈偏好，胜率高达69%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为增强最先进视频生成模型的可预测性和可控性提供了实用且可扩展的方法论，推动该领域从投机性的技术好奇向可靠的生产级工具演进。

title: SelectLight: Learning to Select Signal Plans Generated by Distributed Model Predictive Control for Urban Traffic Networks
comment: 37 pages, 14 figures, 13 tables. Submitted to Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies
summary: Coordinated traffic signal control across urban networks must adapt to changing demand while satisfying operational constraints. Multi-objective distributed model predictive control (DMPC) can construct feasible signal plans online, but prescribed rules for selecting among trade-off solutions cannot learn from realized closed-loop outcomes. We propose SelectLight, which implements post-optimization selection by allowing a multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) policy to choose directly from plans generated online by DMPC. At each control update, state-pruned multi-objective dynamic programming (SP-MODP) evaluates plans with a Newellian point--spatial queue model and returns a bounded set of mutually nondominated candidate signal plans for total queueing delay, peak queue accumulation, and total number of stops. A topology-aware attention policy trained with independent proximal policy optimization (IPPO) selects one unmodified plan from each variable-size set. This confines learning to candidate selection, preserves the prescribed signal timing constraints, and leaves the selected plan and its predicted objective trade-offs available for inspection. Experiments on two 28-intersection SUMO networks show that SelectLight achieves the best delay-related performance and that its advantage widens with demand. At twice the baseline demand, it reduces queueing delay and waiting time by 5.57% and 6.44%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline. SelectLight also incurs the lowest transfer loss under every tested demand shift. With a 120 s prediction horizon, the per-intersection 99th-percentile SP-MODP solution time is 5.408 ms, well below the 5 s control interval.

AI.tldr: 提出SelectLight框架，将多智能体强化学习（MARL）策略直接用于从分布式模型预测控制（DMPC）在线生成的非支配候选信号方案集合中进行后优化选择，既保留了可解释性与约束可行性，又能从闭环结果中学习，在两个28交叉口SUMO网络中取得最优延迟性能与最低迁移损失。
AI.motivation: 多目标分布式模型预测控制（DMPC）能在线上构造可行的信号配时方案，但其在权衡解之间的选择规则是预先规定的，无法从实际闭环结果中学习改进。已有方法未能将学习能力与约束可行的规划能力有效结合。
AI.method: 提出SelectLight框架：(1) 状态剪枝多目标动态规划（SP-MODP）用Newellian点-空间队列模型评估方案，返回关于总排队延迟、峰值排队积聚和总停车次数的有界互不支配候选方案集合；(2) 基于拓扑感知注意力策略，使用独立近端策略优化（IPPO）训练，从每个变长集合中选择一个未修改方案；(3) 学习仅限定于候选选择，保留预设信号配时约束，所选方案及其预测目标权衡可被检验。
AI.result: 在28交叉口SUMO网络上，SelectLight取得最佳延迟相关性能，且优势随需求增加而扩大。在2倍基线需求下，相对最强基线减少排队延迟5.57%、等待时间6.44%。在全部测试需求迁移场景下迁移损失最低。120秒预测时域下，每交叉口99%分位SP-MODP求解时间为5.408毫秒，远低于5秒控制间隔。
AI.conclusion: 将MARL嵌入DMPC后优化选择流程是可行且高效的，它兼顾了学习能力、约束可行性、实时性、可解释性和泛化能力，为城市网络协调信号控制提供了一种新范式。

title: One Frozen Simulator Is Not Enough: Simulator Collapse in Multi-Agent RL
summary: Multi-agent reinforcement learning for human-AI interaction typically relies on a single large language model to simulate user behavior. We show that this approach systematically fails to generalize, and trace the failure to simulator collapse: because the simulator LLM is mode-collapsed, an LLM policy trained against it overfits to narrow strategies that exploit the simulator's dominant mode, and such a policy transfers poorly to unseen simulators and real users. We formalize this collapse theoretically and propose two complementary solutions, one at inference time and one at training time. The inference-time solution, Verbalized Sampling, broadens the simulator's behavior by sampling from a verbalized response distribution, reducing mode collapse. The training-time solution, Co-Training, jointly optimizes the policy against a population of trainable simulators, preventing it from overfitting to any single simulator's mode. We validate both solutions on three multi-turn benchmarks: Persuasion for Good, $τ^2$-bench, and CooperBench. Verbalized Sampling improves held-out success by up to 9% over single-simulator RL, and Co-Training pushes gains further to 14%; the human study shows similar gain on real users. Both solutions preserve the policy diversity that collapses under single-simulator RL. To support further work in this direction, we release SCOPE, an open-source framework for Population Co-Training multi-agent RL. More broadly, our results suggest that the diversity of the training environment, not only the policy, is critical to the generalization of multi-turn RL to real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文指出基于单一LLM模拟用户的多智能体强化学习方法存在系统性泛化失败，根源在于"模拟器坍缩"（simulator collapse）——模拟器LLM模式坍缩导致策略过拟合其主导模式，从而在真实用户上表现不佳。作者提出两个互补方案：推理时的Verbalized Sampling（通过言语化响应分布采样拓宽模拟器行为）和训练时的Co-Training（联合优化策略对抗可训练模拟器群体），在三个多轮基准和人类研究上分别提升最多9%和14%的held-out成功率。
AI.motivation: 多智能体强化学习用于人机交互时通常依赖单一LLM模拟用户行为，但这种做法系统性泛化失败。作者将失败根源归结为"模拟器坍缩"：模式坍缩的模拟器导致策略过拟合其主导模式，进而无法迁移到未见过的模拟器和真实用户。当前缺乏对该问题的理论形式化分析和有效解决方案。
AI.method: 首先从理论上形式化定义了"模拟器坍缩"问题。随后提出两个互补方案：(1) 推理时的Verbalized Sampling——从模拟器的言语化响应分布中采样，拓宽行为空间并削弱模式坍缩；(2) 训练时的Co-Training——让策略针对一组可训练的模拟器群体进行联合优化，避免过度拟合单一模拟器的模式。作者还发布了SCOPE开源框架，用于支持种群Co-Training多智能体RL。
AI.result: 在Persuasion for Good、τ²-bench和CooperBench三个多轮基准上验证：Verbalized Sampling较单模拟器RL在held-out成功率上提升最高9%；Co-Training进一步将增益推至14%；人类研究在真实用户上观察到相似增益。两种方案均保持了单模拟器RL下会崩溃的策略多样性。
AI.conclusion: 训练环境的多样性（而非仅策略本身）对多轮RL泛化到真实世界部署至关重要。模拟器群体的多样性是提升RL策略在真实用户上泛化能力的关键因素。

title: Few-Shot Ordinal Learning for Day-Wise Freshness Estimation with Hyperspectral Fish Images
summary: Non-destructive food quality assessment has increasingly benefited from hyperspectral imaging (HSI), which captures spectral signatures linked to biochemical changes during storage. Estimating day-wise freshness, however, remains challenging owing to strong inter-fillet variability and scarce labelled data per product. All existing deep learning approaches for HSI-based freshness prediction operate under full supervision, requiring densely annotated training sets that are costly to obtain at the individual-product level. We introduce, to the best of our knowledge, the first few-shot learning framework for HSI-based food quality estimation. Each fillet defines a distinct episodic task, and a CORAL-style ordinal prediction head captures the ranked nature of freshness progression through cumulative threshold modelling. Biologically grounded monotonicity and embedding smoothness constraints further guide predictions toward plausible trajectories. On a 16-day salmon HSI dataset under a strict unseen-fillet protocol, our method achieves a mean absolute error of 1.58 days and 2-day accuracy of 72.3% with only three labelled days per fillet, substantially outperforming scalar regression and label-distribution baselines under an identical unseen-fillet protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个用于高光谱成像（HSI）食品质量估计的少样本学习框架。每个鱼片定义为一个独立的情节任务，采用CORAL风格的有序预测头通过累积阈值建模捕捉新鲜度进展的排序特性，并利用生物学启发的单调性与嵌入平滑性约束引导预测。在16天三文鱼HSI数据集上，严格的未见鱼片协议下，仅需每鱼片三个标注日即可达到1.58天的平均绝对误差和72.3%的两天准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于HSI的新鲜度预测深度学习方法全部依赖全监督训练，需要大量逐产品级别的密集标注数据，成本高昂。同时，不同鱼片间差异大且每个产品的标注数据稀少，导致按天估计新鲜度仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 1）构建少样本学习框架，将每个鱼片定义为独立的情节任务（episodic task）；2）采用CORAL风格的有序预测头，通过累积阈值建模（cumulative threshold modelling）捕捉新鲜度进展的排序（ranked）属性；3）引入生物学启发的单调性约束和嵌入平滑性约束，引导预测朝向合理的新鲜度变化轨迹。
AI.result: 在16天三文鱼HSI数据集上，采用严格的未见鱼片（unseen-fillet）协议，该方法以每鱼片仅三个标注日实现1.58天的平均绝对误差（MAE）和72.3%的两天准确率，显著优于相同协议下的标量回归和标签分布基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明少样本学习结合有序回归策略能够有效应对HSI食品质量评估中的数据稀缺与样本间差异大的挑战，为高光谱食品新鲜度预测提供了一种低成本、高精度的可行方案。

title: Domain-Aware Lightweight Spectral-Grouped Convolutions for Hyperspectral Fish Freshness Classification
summary: Hyperspectral imaging (HSI) offers nondestructive assessment of fish freshness by detecting biochemical alterations across spectral bands. However, conventional deep learning approaches do not fully address the particular characteristics of HSI data, such as spectral dominance over spatial textures, ordinal label structure, and a small number of training samples. We propose SGNet (Spectral-Grouped Network), a lightweight architecture that separates spectral and spatial feature extraction using grouped convolutions and a depthwise spatial pathway. A dual attention mechanism that couples channel-wise squeeze-and-excitation with spatial gating adaptively highlights informative features. SGNet achieves 97.8% classification accuracy and 0.64 days mean absolute error (MAE) with just 4.75M parameters when tested on our newly developed 16-day refrigerator-stored salmon fillet dataset. Ablation studies validate the contribution of each component, while comparisons demonstrate a five- to eighteen-fold parameter reduction relative to ResNet-50 and Vision Transformers. Our findings indicate that domain-aware design supports precise, real-time freshness prediction for industrial implementation.

AI.tldr: 提出SGNet（光谱分组网络），一个针对高光谱成像鱼类新鲜度检测的轻量级深度学习架构，通过分组卷积和深度可分离空间路径分离光谱与空间特征提取，并采用双注意力机制。在16天冷藏三文鱼数据集上达到97.8%分类准确率和0.64天MAE，仅需4.75M参数，相比ResNet-50和ViT实现5-18倍参数缩减。
AI.motivation: 传统深度学习未能充分适配高光谱成像数据的特点：光谱信息主导空间纹理、标签具有序数结构、训练样本数量有限。现有方法无法高效处理这些特性，需要一种领域感知的轻量级网络架构以实现工业级的实时鱼类新鲜度预测。
AI.method: 提出SGNet架构，核心设计包括：(1) 使用分组卷积分离光谱维度特征提取；(2) 采用深度可分离空间卷积路径处理空间纹理；(3) 引入双注意力机制，将通道维度的squeeze-and-excitation与空间gating相结合，自适应地突出信息丰富的特征；(4) 针对序数标签结构进行优化设计。
AI.result: 在自建16天冰箱储存三文鱼片数据集上，SGNet达到97.8%分类准确率和0.64天平均绝对误差（MAE），仅需4.75M参数。与ResNet-50和Vision Transformers相比，参数减少5至18倍。消融实验验证了各组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 领域感知的架构设计（充分考虑HSI的光谱主导性、序数标签和小样本特性）能够在保持高精度的同时实现轻量化，适合工业实时新鲜度预测应用。

title: SCOUT: Unlocking Enhanced Spatial Reasoning via Structured Chain-of-Thought and Multi-Objective Process Reward
summary: Existing Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibits a critical bottleneck in robust spatial reasoning. Recent reinforcement learning (RL) methods aim to close this gap with verifiable outcomes, yet they suffer from poor credit assignment across intermediate reasoning steps. Concurrently, structured reasoning approaches overlook the critical depth perception necessary for comprehensive 3D understanding. To address these challenges, we propose SCOUT (Structured Chain-Of-Thought Utilizing Process-Supervised RL Training). Specifically, we design a structured Chain-of-Thought (CoT) framework that explicitly models 3D environmental perception to ensure robust spatial understanding and reasoning. Furthermore, we introduce a novel RL algorithm featuring multi-objective process rewards and a tailored advantage estimation method, facilitating fine-grained credit assignment across distinct segments of the reasoning trajectory. To support our framework, we develop SCOUT-24k, a structured spatial reasoning CoT dataset synthesized through a customized pipeline. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that SCOUT-3B improves upon baseline models by 16.85% and 6.3% on general spatial benchmarks and complex spatial reasoning tasks respectively. Notably, our larger SCOUT-7B even outperforms GPT-4o by a margin of 4.28%. Moreover, despite being trained exclusively on single image, SCOUT-7B exhibits robust out-of-domain generalization to multi-image and video scenarios. These empirical results render SCOUT as a critical step towards next generation of spatially-aware VLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCOUT框架，通过融合结构化的3D环境感知思维链（CoT）与多目标过程奖励的强化学习训练，解决了VLM在空间推理中的两大瓶颈：奖励稀疏/信用分配不足，以及缺乏深度感知的结构化推理。SCOUT-3B在通用空间基准上提升16.85%，SCOUT-7B超越GPT-4o达4.28%，且仅用单图像训练即展现出对多图像和视频场景的跨域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉语言模型（VLMs）在空间推理方面存在关键瓶颈。一方面，基于强化学习（RL）的方法虽可利用可验证结果缩小差距，但面临中间推理步骤间信用分配差的问题；另一方面，结构化推理方法忽略了三维理解所需的深度感知能力。这两大不足共同制约了VLM实现全面的3D空间理解与推理。
AI.method: 1) 设计结构化CoT框架，显式建模3D环境感知以保证空间理解与推理的鲁棒性；2) 提出新型RL算法，包含多目标过程奖励(multi-objective process rewards)与定制化的优势估计方法，实现推理轨迹不同段落间的细粒度信用分配；3) 构建SCOUT-24k数据集，通过定制化pipeline合成结构化空间推理CoT数据用于训练。
AI.result: SCOUT-3B在通用空间基准和复杂空间推理任务上分别比基线模型提升16.85%和6.3%；更大规模的SCOUT-7B超越GPT-4o达4.28%的绝对优势；尽管仅以单图像训练，SCOUT-7B仍展现了对多图像和视频场景的稳健的域外泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: SCOUT通过将结构化3D感知思维链与过程监督强化学习相结合，有效克服了VLM空间推理中信用分配和深度感知两方面的缺陷，实验结果表明该方法显著提升了空间推理性能，并具备良好的跨模态跨场景泛化能力，为下一代具备空间感知能力的VLM提供了关键一步。

title: Generation as Auxiliary Supervision: Enhancing Visual Understanding at Zero Inference Overhead via Decoupled Embedding Prediction
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress, visual understanding and generation are typically treated as divergent objectives. Existing unified frameworks often rely on discrete visual tokenization or diffusion objectives whose generative targets differ from the continuous representations consumed by visual understanding models, making direct transfer to enhance existing pretrained MLLMs non-trivial. In this work, we present GAS, a generation-guided training framework that reinterprets visual generation as auxiliary supervision for representation learning. Concretely, GAS adapts Next Embedding Prediction (NEP) as a cross-modal generation paradigm within a decoupled Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture. By maintaining a shared lower trunk and parallel upper layers, GAS lets generation losses enrich the shared visual pathway with finer spatial precision and stronger visual retention while shielding the upper understanding layers from direct generation gradients. To maximize this synergy, we further construct highly correlated generation tasks that demand deep cognitive grounding rather than generic synthesis alone. Across model scales and training stages, GAS improves aggregate multimodal understanding, with its most reliable gains on perception and spatial comprehension. Crucially, because the auxiliary generation branch is discarded after training, these gains incur zero inference overhead. Extensive controlled comparisons and representation-level analyses further clarify when and why generation-guided training benefits understanding, and demonstrate the feasibility of generation-guided training as a practical route to stronger multimodal understanding.

AI.tldr: GAS：一个生成引导的训练框架，将视觉生成重新诠释为表示学习的辅助监督，通过解耦的Mixture-of-Transformers架构和Next Embedding Prediction范式，在不引入推理开销的前提下提升多模态大语言模型的感知与空间理解能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中视觉理解与视觉生成通常被视为发散的目标，现有统一框架依赖离散视觉tokenization或扩散目标，其生成目标与理解模型所用的连续表示不一致，导致无法直接迁移以增强已有的预训练MLLMs。
AI.method: 提出GAS框架，将Next Embedding Prediction（NEP）作为跨模态生成范式，融入解耦的Mixture-of-Transformers（MoT）架构；通过共享下层主干和并行上层，使生成损失丰富共享视觉通路（获得更精细的空间精度与更强的视觉保留），同时屏蔽上层理解层免受直接生成梯度的干扰；并构造需要深度认知基础的强相关生成任务来最大化协同效应。
AI.result: 在多种模型规模和训练阶段下，GAS提升了整体多模态理解能力，尤其在感知和空间理解上有最可靠的增益；生成分支在训练后被丢弃，因此零推理开销；通过受控对比实验和表示层面分析阐明了生成引导训练何时以及为何有益于理解。
AI.conclusion: 生成引导训练可作为增强多模态理解的一条实用路径，在无推理成本的前提下显著提升感知与空间理解能力。

title: GeoFlow: Efficient Driving Video Generation via Geometry-Aligned Priors
summary: Generative models like Diffusion Models and Flow Matching have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in synthesizing high-fidelity driving videos, but are severely constrained by high inference latency due to the requirement of extensive sampling steps. We argue that this inefficiency stems from the prevailing reliance on a standard Gaussian source distribution, where consecutive frames are initialized as independent Gaussian noise. This paradigm disregards the rich spatiotemporal correlations inherent in driving videos, compelling the model to regenerate deterministic scene structures existing in previous frames from noise, which is both computationally redundant and prone to geometric inconsistency. To address this problem, we propose GeoFlow, a novel framework designed to achieve efficient driving video generation by harnessing explicit geometric priors. Instead of sampling from standard Gaussian noise, we leverage multi-view geometry and spatially-adaptive noise injection to construct a Geometry-Aligned Prior (GAP) distribution as starting point. This initialization bridges the gap between source distribution and data distribution, yielding a significantly straighter and shorter sampling trajectory. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GeoFlow can achieve remarkable efficiency of both training and inference: merely several hours of fine-tuning on baseline models can significantly boost few-step generation quality, while fully converged training drastically reduces number of inference steps required for state-of-the-art video generation.

AI.tldr: GeoFlow提出利用显式几何先验（Geometry-Aligned Prior, GAP）替代标准高斯分布作为扩散/流匹配模型的初始化分布，通过多视图几何和空间自适应噪声注入构建对齐先验，显著缩短采样轨迹，实现高效驾驶视频生成。
AI.motivation: 当前扩散模型和流匹配模型虽能生成高质量驾驶视频，但推理延迟高。作者指出其低效根源在于使用标准高斯源分布，导致连续帧被初始化为独立高斯噪声，忽略了驾驶视频固有的时空相关性，迫使模型从噪声中重新生成已有场景结构，既计算冗余又易产生几何不一致性。
AI.method: GeoFlow框架利用多视图几何和空间自适应噪声注入构建Geometry-Aligned Prior (GAP)分布作为采样起点，取代标准高斯噪声初始化。该先验分布弥合了源分布与数据分布之间的差距，从而产生更直、更短的采样轨迹。
AI.result: 实验表明GeoFlow在训练和推理效率上均有显著提升：仅需数小时微调基线模型即可大幅提升少步生成质量；完全收敛的训练可将SOTA视频生成所需的推理步数大幅减少。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式几何先验缩小源分布与数据分布的距离，能够从根本上缓解扩散模型在驾驶视频生成中的采样效率瓶颈，实现更高效的训练与推理。

title: How to Spend Your Oracle Budget: Practical Guidance for Protein Structure Prediction Models
comment: Proceedings of the ICML 2026 Workshop on Structured Probabilistic Inference & Generative Modeling (SPIGM)
summary: Foundation models for protein structure prediction remain unreliable on certain targets. External oracles can flag and correct these failures, but biological oracles are expensive, making oracle budget a critical constraint. Existing guidance methods, such as FK-steering, DPO, and Best K-of-N sampling, differ in how they spend this budget, yet no systematic comparison exists to guide method selection. To bridge this gap, we benchmark these methods alongside the recently proposed Optimisation Over Outputs (O3), which applies off-the-shelf optimisers within a generative model's latent subspace. We extend the usage of O3 to protein structure prediction models. Overall, our work provides the first practical reference for oracle budget-aware guidance. Our evaluation on two protein targets, calmodulin (1CLL) and E. coli aspartate transcarbamoylase (9EEH), reveals that no single method consistently dominates across all budgets and oracles. Specifically, O3 proves most effective at low oracle budgets, while FK-steering and DPO demonstrate improved performance as the budget increases. We distil these findings into actionable recommendations for practitioners operating under real-world oracle-budget constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地对比了多种oracle预算感知的蛋白质结构预测指导方法（FK-steering、DPO、Best K-of-N和O3），在calmodulin和9EEH两个蛋白质靶标上评估发现：没有任何单一方法在所有预算和oracle条件下始终占优——O3在低预算下最有效，而FK-steering和DPO在预算增加时表现更好，并据此为实践者提供了可操作的建议。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质结构预测的基础模型在部分靶标上仍不可靠，而外部生物oracle可以标注和纠正这些失败，但生物oracle成本高昂，因此oracle预算成为关键约束。已有的多种指导方法（FK-steering、DPO、Best K-of-N）在预算消耗策略上各不相同，但缺乏系统性对比来指导方法选择。
AI.method: 将最近提出的Optimisation Over Outputs (O3)方法（在生成模型的潜在子空间内应用现成优化器）扩展到蛋白质结构预测模型，并与FK-steering、DPO和Best K-of-N三种现有方法一起进行基准测试，在两个蛋白质靶标（1CLL和9EEH）上使用不同oracle预算进行评估。
AI.result: 实验结果显示没有单一方法在所有oracle预算和oracle条件下始终占据主导地位。O3在低oracle预算下表现最优，而FK-steering和DPO在预算增加后展现出更好的性能。该工作是首个针对oracle预算感知指导的实用参考基准。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果被提炼为面向实践者的可操作建议，帮助他们在真实世界oracle预算约束下选择最合适的指导方法，填补了该领域缺乏系统性方法对比的空白。

title: HSTGFormer: Hyper Spatial-Temporal Graph Transformer for 3D Human Pose Estimation
summary: Transformer-based methods have achieved strong performance in monocular 3D human pose estimation, but most existing approaches organise spatial and temporal reasoning as separate stages, which may weaken unified spatial-temporal interdependencies inherent in human motion and compress frame-level structural information before temporal modelling. In this paper, we propose HSTGFormer, a graph-enhanced Transformer framework that reformulates spatial-temporal reasoning as localised coupled graph aggregation over joint-time nodes. Specifically, HSTGFormer introduces a Hyper Spatial-Temporal Graph (HSTG), which decomposes global spatial-temporal reasoning into local spatial-temporal receptive fields around individual joint-time nodes by extending per-frame skeleton graphs into temporal neighbourhoods, thereby enabling structure-aware coupled reasoning while preserving local structural motion information. It further incorporates an Adaptive Dual-Scale Temporal Graph (ADSTG) to capture joint-specific temporal dependencies over complementary short- and long-range windows. A lightweight node-wise fusion module further adaptively integrates the two graph representations for each joint-time node. Experiments on Human3.6M and MPI-INF-3DHP show that HSTGFormer achieves strong accuracy with high computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HSTGFormer，一种图增强的Transformer框架用于单目3D人体姿态估计。它通过超时空图(HSTG)将全局时空推理分解为关节-时间节点周围的局部时空感受野，并结合自适应双尺度时间图(ADSTG)捕获短长窗口的关节特定时间依赖，最后通过轻量节点级融合模块进行整合。在Human3.6M和MPI-INF-3DHP上取得高精度和高计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer方法将空间和时间推理分为独立阶段，这削弱了人体运动中固有的统一时空相互依赖性，并在时间建模之前压缩了帧级结构信息。
AI.method: 1) 超时空图(HSTG)：将每帧骨架图扩展到时间邻域，将全局时空推理分解为各关节-时间节点周围的局部时空感受野，实现结构感知的耦合推理并保留局部结构运动信息；2) 自适应双尺度时间图(ADSTG)：在互补的短窗口和长窗口上捕获关节特定的时间依赖；3) 轻量节点级融合模块：自适应地将两种图表示整合到每个关节-时间节点。
AI.result: 在Human3.6M和MPI-INF-3DHP基准上，HSTGFormer取得了强准确的性能，同时保持高计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 将空间-时间推理重构为关节-时间节点上的局部耦合图聚合，能够更有效地建模统一时空依赖关系，在保持高精度的同时降低计算开销，验证了图增强Transformer在3D人体姿态估计中的有效性。

title: Making Collaborative Signals Count: Graph-Aware Large Language Models for Sequential Recommendation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been widely adopted as backbones for recommender systems. However, their language-centric pretraining makes it difficult to capture collaborative signals implicit in user-item interactions, which are crucial for personalized recommendation. Existing methods either inject collaborative representations produced by external recommenders or model only intra-sequence dependencies, limiting their ability to exploit global collaborative patterns. To address this limitation, we propose GALLM, a graph-aware LLM framework for sequential recommendation. GALLM constructs a collaborative graph over text tokens and item tokens, and models three types of relations: Text--Text relations for preserving semantic dependencies, Item--Text relations for aligning item tokens with their textual descriptions, and Item--Item relations derived from global item co-occurrence patterns. These relations are transformed into lightweight learnable attention biases and incorporated into the LLM attention mechanism, enabling collaborative-aware token interactions without introducing an additional graph encoder. Experiments on four real-world benchmarks show that GALLM achieves the best performance among the compared baselines, improving over the strongest baseline by 9.76\% on average in HR@5.

AI.tldr: 提出GALLM框架，通过在LLM注意力机制中引入基于协作图的注意力偏置，使大语言模型能够捕捉用户-物品交互中的全局协作信号，用于序列推荐，在四个基准数据集上相比最强基线在HR@5上平均提升9.76%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型以语言为中心预训练，难以捕捉用户-物品交互中的隐式协作信号，而协作信号对个性化推荐至关重要。现有方法要么依赖外部推荐器注入协作表示，要么仅建模序列内部依赖，限制了全局协作模式的利用。
AI.method: GALLM在图谱（文本token与物品token构成的协作图）上建模三种类型的关系：Text-Text关系（保留语义依赖）、Item-Text关系（对齐物品token与其文本描述）、Item-Item关系（基于物品全局共现模式）。这些关系被转化为轻量级可学习注意力偏置，直接整合进LLM注意力机制中，无需额外图编码器。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界基准数据集上的实验表明，GALLM在所有对比基线中取得最佳性能，在HR@5上平均比最强基线提升9.76%。
AI.conclusion: 通过在LLM内部注入注意力偏置的方式，GALLM能够在不引入额外图编码器的情况下，使语言模型感知全局协作模式，有效提升序列推荐的性能。

title: Map-Det3D: Metric Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction Prior for Multi-view 3D Object Detection from Streaming Inputs
summary: Metric 3D object detection is a core capability for embodied agents, yet most reliable systems lean on depth sensors, trading away cost, power, and integration simplicity. This motivates monocular 3D detection, which avoids additional constraints, yet it faces a major obstacle: from a single image, depth, and especially absolute scale, are underconstrained. As a result, the prevailing pattern of detecting in 2D and then predicting 3D attributes is often brittle, since modest range errors can dominate 3D localization, and the learned scale prior can fail when cameras, motion, or environments undergo domain shifts. To address this, we propose Map-Det3D, an online multi-view 3D object detection model that brings detection directly into a 3D space reconstructed from RGB. We map a short temporal window into multiple views and repurpose a feed-forward metric 3D reconstruction model as our geometric backbone while tuning its object-aware capabilities. Building on this representation, Map-Det3D directly predicts boxes in metric 3D space, without the widely used 2D-to-3D lifting. Experiments across different benchmarks show that this design supports strong online performance and robust transfer without adaptation, suggesting that training reconstruction priors for detection is a practical route to stable metric 3D detection from monocular video. Code and models are available at https://royyang0714.github.io/Map-Det3D.

AI.tldr: 提出Map-Det3D，一种在线多视角3D目标检测模型，通过将短时间窗口的RGB帧映射到多视角，利用前馈度量3D重建模型作为几何骨干，直接在度量3D空间中预测边界框，无需传统的2D-to-3D提升，在多个基准上展现强在线性能和鲁棒域迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 单体3D检测因单一图像中深度和绝对尺度欠约束而面临根本性困难，现有"2D检测+3D属性预测"范式脆弱：测距误差主导3D定位，且学习到的尺度先验在相机、运动或环境域偏移时容易失效。需要一个不依赖深度传感器但能在度量3D空间中稳定检测的方案。
AI.method: Map-Det3D将短视频时间窗口映射为多视角图像，复用前馈度量3D重建模型作为几何骨干并微调其面向对象的能力，在此基础上直接在度量3D空间中预测3D边界框，避免了广泛使用的2D-to-3D提升步骤。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的实验表明，Map-Det3D在在线性能上表现优异，且无需适配即可实现鲁棒的跨域迁移，证明将重建先验用于检测是可行的路线。
AI.conclusion: 训练重建先验用于检测，是实现从单目视频进行稳定度量3D检测的实用途径；直接在地图重建的3D空间中检测优于传统的2D检测后再提升3D属性的范式。

title: Connecting the tensor-categorical formulation of anyon condensation with operator algebras and entropic order parameters
summary: Anyon condensation that describes the transition between topological quantum field theories can be formulated in the language of tensor categories or that of operator algebras. We deploy the formalism of Doplicher-Haag-Roberts bimodules over quasi-local $\mathrm{C}^{*}$-algebras recently developed in [1] to investigate anyon condensation, which is associated with an extension of a certain operator algebra. The connection between notions in the two formulations is thereby made manifest in an intuitive, diagrammatic manner. An entropic order parameter, as the quantum information-theoretic measure characterising a condensation, is naturally defined, and we give a very simple proof of a bound on it.

AI.tldr: 本文利用最近发展的准局部C*-代数上的Doplicher-Haag-Roberts双模形式化体系来研究任意子凝聚现象，建立了张量范畴与算子代数两种表述之间的联系，并自然地定义了表征凝聚的熵序参量，给出了其上限的极简证明。
AI.motivation: 任意子凝聚描述拓扑量子场论之间的转变，已有的两种表述——张量范畴和算子代数——之间的对应关系尚未被充分阐明。本文旨在通过DHR双模形式化体系，使这两种表述之间的概念联系变得直观明了，并为凝聚现象提供一个量子信息论意义上的序参量。
AI.method: 采用文献[1]中提出的准局部C*-代数上的Doplicher-Haag-Roberts双模形式化体系，将任意子凝聚与特定算子代数的扩张相关联，通过图示化方式使张量范畴与算子代数两种表述中的概念对应关系变得直观。在此基础上，定义了一个基于量子信息论的熵型序参量来表征凝聚。
AI.result: 给出了一个非常简洁的关于该熵序参量上限的证明。
AI.conclusion: DHR双模形式化体系为理解任意子凝聚提供了统一的框架，使得两种表述的概念联系更为直观，同时熵序参量的引入为凝聚提供了量子信息论层面的定量刻画。

title: MVFM-3DAD: Multi-view Flow Matching for 3D Anomaly Detection via Density Proxy Estimation
comment: ICIG 2026 oral presentation, 13 pages, 3 tables, 4 figures
summary: In 3D anomaly detection (3DAD), most existing methods rely on Memory bank retrieval or reconstruction. However, memory-based methods are constrained by the coverage of stored normal features, while reconstruction-based methods may learn identity shortcuts that also reconstruct anomalous inputs well. These limitations motivate a density-oriented approach that evaluates whether a test sample follows the learned normal distribution. To this end, we propose MVFM-3DAD, a flow-based framework that reframes 3DAD as density proxy estimation over the normal data distribution. MVFM-3DAD introduces a Bidirectional Geometric Projector (BGP), whose forward process converts irregular point clouds into structured multi-view representations. The Flow-guided Density Proxy Estimator (FDPE) estimates a reference density for each view feature, after which the backward process of BGP maps these multi-view density estimates to their corresponding 3D points. Building on it, anomalous features can be identified by their terminal normality. Unlike conventional flow-based likelihood estimation, our formulation requires neither input reconstruction nor explicit Jacobian evaluation, yielding a simple and efficient anomaly-scoring mechanism. Extensive experiments show that MVFM-3DAD outperforms the strongest competing methods on Real3D-AD and MVTec3D-AD. Code is available at https://github.com/lil-wayne-0319/MV3D-AD

AI.tldr: 提出MVFM-3DAD，一种基于流的3D异常检测框架，通过双向几何投影器将不规则点云转换为结构化多视图表示，并由流引导密度代理估计器评估各视图特征的参考密度，再利用逆向过程映射回3D点，以终端正常度识别异常特征，无需输入重建或显式雅可比计算。
AI.motivation: 现有3D异常检测方法主要依赖记忆库检索或重建：记忆库方法受限于存储正常特征的覆盖范围，重建方法可能学习身份捷径从而也能重建异常输入。这促使研究者探索基于密度的方法，直接评估测试样本是否符合学习到的正常数据分布。
AI.method: 提出MVFM-3DAD流式框架，包含两个核心组件：1) 双向几何投影器(BGP)，通过前向过程将不规则点云转换为结构化多视图表示；2) 流引导密度代理估计器(FDPE)，估计每个视图特征的参考密度。随后BGP的逆向过程将这些多视图密度估计映射回对应的3D点，通过终端正常度识别异常特征。该方法无需输入重建或显式雅可比计算。
AI.result: 在Real3D-AD和MVTec3D-AD基准上，MVFM-3DAD的性能优于最强的竞争方法，且由于无需重建或雅可比计算，异常评分机制简单高效。
AI.conclusion: 将3D异常检测重新定义为正常数据分布上的密度代理估计是有效的替代范式，避免了记忆库覆盖限制和重建身份捷径问题，同时实现了SOTA性能与高效率。

title: Autonomous Telerehabilitation via Skeletal Motion Prediction and Joint-Level Performance Assessment
summary: Autonomous rehabilitation systems must not only recognize human motion but also provide structured feedback to support users without continuous therapist supervision. This paper presents a telerehabilitation pipeline that integrates skeleton-based exercise quality assessment and short-term motion prediction into a two-module system operating on marker-free RGB video. A self-attentive Bidirectional LSTM performs exercise quality classification using MMD-NCA metric learning, while a graph-based motion prediction module computes per-joint position errors between predicted and observed poses, generating spatially localized deviation signals. Each module is evaluated independently on established benchmarks: the classifier achieves 96.45% mean-class accuracy on squat sequences from the PROZIS dataset, and the adopted STARS predictor achieves a mean MPJPE of 75.8 mm at 560 ms on Human3.6M, outperforming graph and recurrent baselines across all prediction horizons. The framework is designed for eventual deployment in assistive robotics and home-based rehabilitation contexts; end-to-end integration and clinical validation are important directions for future work. By combining motion recognition and prediction in a single system, this work contributes a step toward autonomous, feedback-driven telerehabilitation, for more accessible and scalable rehabilitation solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种远程康复流水线，将基于骨架的运动质量评估与短期运动预测集成到两个模块中，在无标记RGB视频上运行。质量评估模块采用自注意力双向LSTM结合MMD-NCA度量学习，在PROZIS数据集上达到96.45%的均值类别准确率；运动预测模块采用STARS图变换器，在Human3.6M上实现75.8 mm的MPJPE。该系统面向辅助机器人和家庭康复场景，旨在提供无需治疗师持续监督的自主反馈。
AI.motivation: 自主康复系统需要不仅能识别人体运动，还能提供结构化反馈以支持用户在没有治疗师持续监督的情况下进行康复训练，因此需要一种将运动质量评估与运动预测相结合的端到端解决方案。
AI.method: 采用两模块架构：1）自注意力双向LSTM（BiLSTM）结合MMD-NCA度量学习进行运动质量分类；2）基于图的运动预测模块（STARS预测器），通过计算预测姿态与观测姿态之间的逐关节位置误差，生成空间局部化的偏差信号。
AI.result: 分类器在PROZIS数据集的深蹲序列上达到96.45%的均值类别准确率；STARS预测器在Human3.6M上560ms预测时域内达到75.8 mm的均值MPJPE，在所有预测时域上均优于图和循环基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为自主、反馈驱动的远程康复系统迈出了重要一步，面向更可及、可扩展的康复解决方案。端到端集成和临床验证是未来研究的重要方向。

title: Better Slots, Better Worlds: Representation Quality & Robustness in Object-Centric World Models
comment: Published at Model-Based RL in the Era of Generative World Models Workshop at RLC 2026
summary: Learning world models from offline trajectories enables agents to accomplish different tasks through planning. Object-centric (OC) representations, which decompose a scene into a set of slots that bind to its objects, have been proposed as an inductive bias for world models that are more sample-efficient and generalize better. Yet prior object-centric world models (OCWMs) take the slot encoder as given and evaluate only in-distribution, leaving open whether the object-centric bias actually delivers for planning and what within the OCWM drives it. We conduct a controlled study of OCWMs for visual model-predictive control along two axes: object-centric representation quality and generalization under distribution shift relative to scene-centric models. We find that (i) planning success correlates positively with unsupervised slot-quality metrics (FG-ARI, mBO), though the gains saturate at high slot quality; (ii) with well-bound slots, the auxiliary proprioception inputs and masking inductive bias that prior methods relied on become unnecessary; and (iii) under unseen distribution shifts, the OCWM with well-bound slots is more robust overall than the end-to-end trained scene-centric LeWM, while DINO-WM, built on similar frozen pretrained features, remains competitive -- pointing to pretrained features as a key contributor to robustness.

AI.tldr: 该论文对以对象为中心的world models（OCWMs）进行了受控研究，探讨其在视觉模型预测控制（MPC）中的表示质量和泛化能力。研究发现：规划成功率与无监督槽位质量指标（FG-ARI、mBO）正相关但存在饱和效应；槽位质量良好时，先验方法依赖的辅助本体感觉输入和掩码归纳偏置不再必要；在分布偏移下，槽位良好的OCWM整体鲁棒性优于端到端训练的scene-centric模型LeWM，而基于冻结预训练特征的DINO-WM仍具竞争力，表明预训练特征是鲁棒性的关键贡献者。
AI.motivation: 尽管面向对象的world models（OCWMs）被提出作为提高样本效率和泛化能力的归纳偏置，但先前的OCWMs将槽位编码器视为给定模块且仅在分布内评估，未能验证对象中心归纳偏置是否真正有益于规划决策，以及OcWM中究竟是哪一部分驱动了其表现。本文旨在填补这一空白，通过受控实验系统评估OCWMs的优势来源。
AI.method: 作者沿两个维度对OCWMs进行受控研究：（1）对象中心表示质量，使用无监督槽位质量指标（FG-ARI、mBO）与规划成功率进行相关性分析；（2）分布偏移下的泛化能力，与scene-centric模型（LeWM）及基于冻结预训练特征的DINO-WM进行对比。同时通过逐步去除辅助输入（本体感觉）和掩码归纳偏置来消融验证其必要性。
AI.result: 研究发现：（i）规划成功率与FG-ARI、mBO等无监督槽位质量指标呈正相关，但在高槽位质量下收益趋于饱和；（ii）当槽位绑定良好时，辅助本体感觉输入和掩码归纳偏置不再是必要的；（iii）在未见过的分布移位下，具有良好槽位绑定的OCWM整体上比端到端训练的LeWM更鲁棒，而DINO-WM（基于相似的冻结预训练特征）与其竞争相当，提示预训练特征对鲁棒性有重要贡献。
AI.conclusion: 对象中心表示的质量（而非辅助机制）是驱动OCWM规划性能的关键因素；良好的槽位质量足以弥补额外的归纳偏置需求；预训练特征在分布偏移下的鲁棒性中扮演重要角色。该工作为OCWMs的设计提供了可操作的指导，明确了对象中心归纳偏置在规划中的实际价值及其局限。

title: Learning Loco-Manipulation From SMPC Demonstrations With Sparse Offline-to-Online RL
summary: Integrating locomotion and manipulation is essential for robot autonomy, but scaling standard Reinforcement Learning (RL) to complex tasks is severely bottlenecked by the slow, manual process of dense reward shaping. To bypass this limitation, we leverage Sample-based Model Predictive Control (SMPC) entirely in simulation as an automated, rapidly tunable expert to generate massive offline datasets. Because this data solves the fundamental exploration problem, we can train an off-policy RL agent using purely sparse task rewards, drastically reducing the time required to learn new skills and eliminating the need for manual tuning. Integrating this high-level agent with a low-level dynamic stability controller yields more optimal behaviors that strictly align with true task objectives, ultimately allowing the learned policies to surpass the original optimal control teacher. We validate the robustness of this sim-to-real framework by successfully deploying complex loco-manipulation skills across different morphologies, including an arm-equipped Spot quadruped and a G1 humanoid.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用基于采样的模型预测控制（SMPC）在仿真中作为自动化专家生成大规模离线数据的方法，仅用稀疏任务奖励训练离策略强化学习智能体，从而绕过密集奖励塑形的瓶颈。该框架结合高层智能体与低层动态稳定性控制器，使学到的策略超越原始最优控制教师，并在不同形态机器人（Spot四足和G1人形）上验证了sim-to-real的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 机器人自主性要求移动和操作能力的整合，但标准强化学习（RL）在复杂任务上的扩展受限于密集奖励塑形的缓慢人工过程。作者旨在通过消除人工奖励设计的需求，大幅缩短新技能的学习时间。
AI.method: 1) 在仿真中使用基于采样的模型预测控制（SMPC）作为自动化、可快速调整的专家，生成大规模离线数据集；2) 利用该数据解决探索问题，用纯稀疏任务奖励训练离策略RL智能体；3) 将高层RL智能体与低层动态稳定性控制器集成；4) 在仿真到现实的框架中部署。
AI.result: 学到的策略能够超越原最优控制教师，产生严格符合真实任务目标的更优行为，并在不同形态的机器人（配备机械臂的Spot四足机器人和G1人形机器人）上成功部署复杂的移动-操作技能，验证了框架的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过SMPC生成数据替代人工奖励设计，显著降低强化学习训练时间，同时保持乃至超越最优控制器的性能，为跨形态的复杂移动-操作任务提供了可扩展的sim-to-real解决方案。

title: Reconfiguring Geovisualization in the Age of Generative AI: Insights from Domain Experts
summary: GenAI is increasingly integrated into geovisualization, yet its broader implications for professional practice are insufficiently understood. To examine these implications, we conducted semi-structured interviews with 20 geovisualization experts. The interviews were structured around four broad analytical domains: Data, Ideation, Prototyping, and Iteration, while also encouraging participants to reflect on issues that extend beyond these activities. Our findings show that GenAI expands the capabilities of geovisualization, particularly in terms of data handling, creative exploration, and rapid prototyping, but does not simply remove existing constraints. Instead, key bottlenecks are shifting from production to judgment and verification. As routine technical tasks become more automated, professional value increasingly depends on spatial reasoning, contextual interpretation, aesthetic and ethical judgment, and the ability to assess whether AI-generated outputs are appropriate for use. At the same time, GenAI introduces new challenges regarding provenance, interpretability, and accountability, raising questions about how responsibility should be distributed across models, developers, practitioners, institutions, and users. These shifts are particularly significant in geovisualization because spatial representations are constrained by geographic reality and must balance scientific validity, visual expression, and technical implementation. We therefore argue that responsible GenAI in geovisualization requires domain-specific approaches to spatial validation, provenance, uncertainty communication, human oversight, and accountable use. This study provides an expert-grounded perspective on how GenAI is reconfiguring geovisualization as a practice of spatial knowledge production. It also identifies implications for future professional practice, education, system design, and governance.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对20位地理可视化专家的半结构化访谈，考察了生成式AI（GenAI）对地理可视化专业实践的影响。研究发现GenAI扩展了数据管理、创意探索和快速原型制作等能力，但并未消除现有约束，而是将瓶颈从生产环节转移到判断与验证环节。研究提出负责任地使用GenAI需要领域特定的空间验证、溯源、不确定性沟通、人工监督和问责机制。
AI.motivation: GenAI日益融入地理可视化，但其对专业实践更广泛的影响尚未得到充分理解。本研究旨在通过专家访谈来填补这一认知空白，揭示GenAI如何重塑地理可视化的专业实践。
AI.method: 采用半结构化访谈法，对20位地理可视化专家进行深入访谈。访谈围绕四个分析领域展开：数据（Data）、构思（Ideation）、原型制作（Prototyping）和迭代（Iteration），同时鼓励受访者反思超越这些活动的更广泛议题。
AI.result: GenAI扩展了地理可视化的能力（数据处理、创意探索、快速原型），但瓶颈从生产环节转向了判断与验证环节。专业价值越来越依赖于空间推理、情境解释、美学与伦理判断以及评估AI输出适当性的能力。同时引入了关于溯源、可解释性和问责性的新挑战，涉及模型、开发者、实践者、机构和用户之间责任的重新分配。
AI.conclusion: 负责任地在地理可视化中使用GenAI需要领域特定的方法，包括空间验证、溯源、不确定性沟通、人工监督和问责制。研究为GenAI如何重构地理可视化的空间知识生产实践提供了基于专家视角的洞见，并对专业实践、教育、系统设计和治理提出了启示。

title: Localizing to Debias: A Patch-Level Benchmark and Baseline for Weakly Supervised Spatial Anomaly Detection
summary: Despite growing interest in weakly supervised video anomaly detection (WSVAD), current methods struggle to bridge the gap between coarse temporal supervision and fine-grained spatial reasoning. A key obstacle is the tendency of temporal detectors to latch onto background and scene-level cues rather than truly discriminative anomaly evidence. This background bias raises ethical concerns: models may inadvertently associate anomalies with societal or environmental context rather than authentic crime-related cues. Without spatial grounding, such biases remain hidden and unauditable. To address this, we propose SST-WSVADL, a sparse spatio-temporal framework that bridges temporal anomaly detection with fine-grained spatial localization. Rather than processing all spatial regions indiscriminately, SST-WSVADL progressively focuses on the most anomaly-relevant spatio-temporal regions through dynamic sparsification, naturally suppressing background dominant content while preserving discriminative evidence. The temporal and spatial branches are coupled end-to-end via motion-aware regularization that guides sparsification toward dynamically informative regions, without relying on external detectors or vision-language prompts. We publicly release frame-level spatial annotations and a method-agnostic evaluation protocol for three public datasets: UCF-Crime, XD-Violence, and MSAD. These resources enable the community to audit spatial biases in WSVAD predictions, supporting progress toward more ethical and accountable anomaly detection. Experiments demonstrate that SST-WSVADL is competitive with prior methods across benchmarks while enabling localization and patch-level auditability of scene bias, providing a reproducible foundation for interpretability-oriented evaluation of WSVAD models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SST-WSVADL，一个稀疏时空框架，通过动态稀疏化逐步聚焦异常相关时空区域，抑制背景主导内容，同时发布帧级空间标注和评估协议，用于审计WSVAD模型的场景偏差。
AI.motivation: 弱监督视频异常检测存在粗粒度时间监督与细粒度空间推理之间的鸿沟，时间检测器容易依赖背景和场景级线索而非真正的判别性异常证据。这种背景偏差可能将异常与社会或环境背景错误关联，产生伦理问题。由于缺乏空间grounding，这类偏差难以被发现和审计。
AI.method: 提出SST-WSVADL稀疏时空框架：(1) 通过动态稀疏化逐步聚焦最异常相关的时空区域，抑制背景主导内容；(2) 时间与空间分支通过运动感知正则化端到端耦合，引导稀疏化指向动态信息丰富的区域；(3) 不依赖外部检测器或视觉语言提示；(4) 发布三个数据集（UCF-Crime, XD-Violence, MSAD）的帧级空间标注及方法无关的评估协议。
AI.result: 实验表明SST-WSVADL在多个基准上与现有方法表现相当，同时实现了定位能力和patch级场景偏差可审计性，为WSVAD模型的可解释性评估提供了可复现基础。
AI.conclusion: 该工作不仅提升了弱监督视频异常检测的性能，更通过空间标注资源和评估协议推动了模型偏差的可审计性，为更伦理和负责任的异常检测铺平了道路。

title: Mechanist: AI as a Scientific Instrument for Discovering the Mechanisms of Intelligence
summary: AI models have achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, yet the mechanisms underlying their capabilities and the risks they may pose remain poorly understood. As AI development becomes faster and increasingly automated, mechanistic exploration remains largely manual, widening the gap between what models can do and our ability to understand and control them. To bridge this gap, we introduce Mechanist, an agentic system that uses AI as a scientific instrument for the autonomous discovery of mechanisms underlying AI intelligence. To support autonomous mechanistic discovery, we construct an interpretability-focused knowledge graph of approximately 13,000 papers and integrate it with a multidisciplinary database of 43 million papers spanning 26 fields. We further curate a library of 32 foundational methods for mechanism analysis, causal intervention, and validation. Compared with Claude Code and existing AI-scientist systems, Mechanist generates more valuable mechanism hypotheses and executes experiments more reliably. Mechanist also demonstrates a progression from discovering model behaviors to explaining and controlling AI models. Specifically, Mechanist first uncovers a counterintuitive safety risk in scientific laboratories, showing that unsafe traits can transfer across modalities through apparently safe training data. Mechanist then develops a mechanism theory of belief, revealing how models represent world knowledge, form beliefs, infer the beliefs of others, and how these mechanisms emerge during pretraining. Finally, Mechanist translates these mechanistic insights into practical interventions that improve model performance across diverse scenarios and steer scientific foundation models toward generating DNA sequences with specified properties.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Mechanist，一个利用AI作为科学仪器来自动发现AI模型内部机制的智能体系统。该系统整合了约13,000篇可解释性论文的知识图谱和覆盖26个领域、4,300万篇论文的多学科数据库，并配备了32种机理分析方法库。实验表明Mechanist在生成机制假说和执行实验方面优于Claude Code和现有AI科学家系统，并成功实现了从发现模型行为到解释和控制系统性AI的完整进展，包括发现跨模态安全风险迁移、建立信念的机制理论，以及将机制洞见转化为实际干预措施。
AI.motivation: AI模型的能力和风险机制仍未被充分理解，而随着AI开发速度加快和自动化程度提高，机制探索仍主要依赖人工，导致模型能力与人类理解和控制能力之间的差距不断扩大。
AI.method: Mechanist是一个智能体系统，构建了包含约13,000篇论文的可解释性知识图谱，并集成了涵盖26个领域、4,300万篇论文的多学科数据库。系统还配备了32种用于机制分析、因果干预和验证的基础方法库，以支持自主的机制发现过程。
AI.result: 与Claude Code和现有AI科学家系统相比，Mechanist生成了更有价值的机制假说并更可靠地执行实验。具体成果包括：发现不安全特征可通过看似安全的数据跨模态迁移的安全风险；建立了关于模型如何表示世界知识、形成信念、推断他人信念及其预训练期间涌现机制的信念理论；并将机制洞见转化为实际干预，提升模型在多种场景下的性能，引导科学基础模型生成具有指定属性的DNA序列。
AI.conclusion: Mechanist展示了从发现模型行为到解释和控制系统性AI的完整能力进展，证明了以AI作为科学仪器进行自主机制探索的可行性和潜力，为缩小AI能力与可理解性、可控性之间的差距提供了有效路径。

title: The SLT 2026 SmartGlasses Challenge: Benchmarking Egocentric Multi-Talker Speech Recognition and Understanding with Audio-Language Models
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) have created new opportunities for wearable speech interfaces, with smart glasses providing an egocentric platform for continuous audio sensing and assistance. However, speech recognition and understanding in this setting remain challenging because of dynamic acoustic conditions, speaker overlap, and the spatial ambiguity introduced by wearer-centered recording geometry. To support systematic evaluation in this setting, we introduce the IEEE SLT 2026 SmartGlasses Challenge for egocentric multi-speaker speech processing. The challenge consists of two tracks, Dyadic Dialogue Understanding and Multi-party Meeting Understanding, and jointly evaluates Time-Stamped Speaker-Attributed Automatic Speech Recognition (TSA-ASR) and Spoken Language Understanding (SLU). It is built on a 106-hour four-channel egocentric speech dataset containing 714 sessions collected in real-world scenarios. This paper describes challenge tasks, dataset construction, submissions, and summarizes the main findings from the shared evaluation. The results show that heavy speaker overlap remains a major factor affecting TSA-ASR performance, while paralinguistic acoustic understanding continues to be difficult for current audio-language models in complex SLU settings. Further details can be found on the official challenge website.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了IEEE SLT 2026智能眼镜挑战赛，该挑战赛针对以自我为中心视角的多说话人语音处理问题，基于106小时四通道自我中心语音数据集，评估时间戳说话人属性自动语音识别（TSA-ASR）和口语语言理解（SLU）两个任务。结果表明说话人重叠是影响TSA-ASR性能的主要因素，而副语言声学理解在复杂SLU场景中仍是当前音频-语言模型的难点。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型和多模态大语言模型的进展推动了可穿戴语音接口的发展，智能眼镜提供了持续的音频感知平台。然而，由于动态声学条件、说话人重叠以及佩戴者为中心的录音几何带来的空间模糊性，该场景下的语音识别和理解仍具挑战性，需要系统化的评估框架来推动研究。
AI.method: 构建了IEEE SLT 2026智能眼镜挑战赛，包含两个赛道：双人对话理解和多方会议理解，联合评估TSA-ASR和SLU。基于106小时四通道自我中心语音数据集（含714个真实场景会话），描述了任务设计、数据构建、参赛提交及共享评估结果。
AI.result: 评估结果显示，严重说话人重叠是影响TSA-ASR性能的主要因素；在复杂的SLU场景中，副语言声学理解对当前音频-语言模型仍是难点。挑战的详细信息已发布于官方挑战网站。
AI.conclusion: 该挑战赛为智能眼镜自我中心多说话人语音处理提供了首个系统化基准，揭示了说话人重叠和副语言理解是当前技术面临的关键瓶颈，为未来可穿戴语音接口研究指明了方向。

title: Dual-Model Sentiment Analysis of Consumer Reviews in the Retail Coffee Sector Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Approaches
summary: Consumer reviews play an important role in shaping brand perception and business strategies, particularly in service-driven industries such as retail coffee. This study presents a comparative sentiment analysis framework for Starbucks customer reviews using classical machine learning and deep learning approaches. The dataset, collected from ConsumerAffairs, contains more than 700 reviews and was analyzed through preprocessing and exploratory data analysis to identify temporal and geographic patterns. Sentiment labels were generated by binarizing star ratings, with ratings of 4 and 5 classified as positive and ratings of 1 to 3 as negative. The resulting dataset was substantially imbalanced toward negative sentiment. Five machine learning classifiers, including Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Tree, Random Forest, and Naive Bayes, were evaluated alongside five deep learning models: LSTM, RNN, Bidirectional LSTM, GRU, and CNN. Model performance was assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. SVM achieved the highest accuracy among the machine learning models at 91.0 percent, while Bidirectional LSTM showed the strongest performance among the deep learning models and demonstrated good generalization on unseen data. The findings also show that class imbalance negatively affected positive sentiment recall across several models. Overall, this study provides a comparative evaluation of machine learning and deep learning approaches for real-world consumer sentiment analysis and highlights the importance of appropriate model selection and preprocessing for customer experience analytics in the retail coffee sector.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一个针对星巴克客户评论的对比情感分析框架，使用经典机器学习和深度学习方法。基于ConsumerAffairs收集的700多条评论，评估了五种机器学习分类器（逻辑回归、SVM、决策树、随机森林、朴素贝叶斯）和五种深度学习模型（LSTM、RNN、BiLSTM、GRU、CNN）。结果显示SVM在机器学习模型中取得最高准确率91.0%，BiLSTM在深度学习中表现最佳，同时发现类别不平衡对正面情感召回率产生了负面影响。
AI.motivation: 消费者评论对品牌认知和商业策略具有重要影响，尤其在零售咖啡等服务驱动型行业。现有研究缺乏对经典机器学习和深度学习方法在真实世界消费者情感分析场景下的系统性比较评估，因此需要建立一个对比框架来指导实际应用中的模型选择。
AI.method: 从ConsumerAffairs收集超过700条星巴克评论，经过预处理和探索性数据分析识别时间和地理位置模式。将星级评分二值化生成情感标签（4-5分为正面，1-3分为负面），得到显著不平衡的数据集。评估五种机器学习分类器（Logistic Regression、SVM、Decision Tree、Random Forest、Naive Bayes）和五种深度学习模型（LSTM、RNN、Bidirectional LSTM、GRU、CNN），使用准确率、精确率、召回率和F1分数评估性能。
AI.result: SVM在机器学习模型中取得最高准确率91.0%；Bidirectional LSTM在深度学习模型中表现最强，并在未见数据上表现出良好的泛化能力。研究还发现类别不平衡问题对多个模型的正面情感召回率产生了负面影响。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为零售咖啡行业提供了经典机器学习和深度学习方法在真实世界消费者情感分析中的对比评估，强调了在客户体验分析中合理选择模型和进行预处理的重要性。

title: RealisticTritonBench: A Benchmark for Triton-Kernel Generation in Real-World AI Frameworks
summary: In modern AI frameworks, GPU kernels are key to overall system performance. Combining usability, portability, and near-handwritten CUDA performance, Triton is widely adopted for implementing GPU kernels. Recent advances show the potential of large language models (LLMs) to automatically generate Triton kernels, reducing the manual effort required from expert kernel developers. Several benchmarks evaluate LLM-generated Triton kernels. However, they suffer from three key limitations: (1) they restrict tasks to PyTorch-to-Triton translation, failing to reflect the diversity and complexity of real-world Triton tasks; (2) they evaluate only individual-kernel performance rather than end-to-end performance, the core criterion for real-world deployment in AI frameworks; and (3) they rely on manually written evaluation scripts for individual kernels, which may contain flaws that models can exploit to bypass correctness checks and obtain inflated scores. To address these limitations, we introduce RealisticTritonBench, the first benchmark to derive Triton kernel generation tasks from real-world pull requests in popular AI frameworks, enabling realistic, production-like evaluation. RealisticTritonBench systematically extracts PRs that modify Triton kernels from popular open-source AI frameworks and transforms them into generation tasks with concrete engineering contexts. Each task takes a natural language requirement as input and requires a corresponding Triton kernel implementation, with a complete and reproducible evaluation environment. Unlike prior benchmarks focused on isolated kernel performance, RealisticTritonBench integrates generated kernels into their original frameworks and evaluates them using end-to-end tests, enabling a more faithful assessment. We evaluate leading LLMs on RealisticTritonBench and find that they still struggle with real-world Triton kernel generation tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RealisticTritonBench，第一个从真实AI框架的pull request中提取Triton内核生成任务的基准测试，克服了现有基准在任务多样性、端到端评估和验证可靠性方面的三大局限。
AI.motivation: 现有评估LLM生成Triton内核的基准存在三个关键缺陷：(1)仅局限于PyTorch-to-Triton翻译，未反映真实Triton任务的多样性和复杂性；(2)只评估单个内核性能而非端到端性能，而后者才是AI框架实际部署的核心标准；(3)依赖可能含有缺陷的手写评估脚本，模型可利用这些缺陷绕过正确性检查并获取虚高分数。
AI.method: RealisticTritonBench从流行的开源AI框架中系统性地提取修改Triton内核的PR，并将其转化为带有具体工程上下文的生成任务。每个任务以自然语言需求为输入，要求生成对应的Triton内核实现，并提供完整可复现的评估环境。与以往只关注孤立内核性能的基准不同，该基准将生成的内核集成回原始框架，并使用端到端测试进行评估。
AI.result: 在RealisticTritonBench上评估了领先的LLM，发现它们在真实世界Triton内核生成任务上仍然表现困难。
AI.conclusion: RealisticTritonBench提供了更真实、更贴近生产环境的Triton内核生成评估，揭示了现有LLM在解决真实世界Triton内核生成任务方面的不足，为未来研究指明了方向。

title: Auditing Frame-Level AUC in Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection: Granularity, Resolution, and Scene Bias
summary: Frame-level area under the ROC curve (AUC) is the dominant evaluation metric for weakly supervised video anomaly detection (WSVAD). Its standard form measures whether an anomalous frame outranks a normal frame drawn from anywhere in the test set. We refer to this comparison as pooled AUC, since it aggregates frame pairs across test videos regardless of source. Pooled AUC therefore credits both event localization and differences between video sources. We audit this protocol on UCF-Crime across recent state-of-the-art models spanning different backbone families. Holding each model's frame scores fixed, we read them under three pairing granularities: global, per anomaly category, and within each video, then repeat the same three-granularity readout on zero-shot scores computed from the models' internal representations. We assess ranking reliability with a paired video bootstrap. Three findings follow. First, pooled AUC does not reliably predict within-video anomaly localization: models with similar pooled scores exhibit large localization differences and rank reversals under stricter granularities. Second, at the benchmark's test-split size, pooled AUC lacks the resolution to support state-of-the-art margins reported in the field. Within each backbone family, it resolves no comparison at those margins, while within-video AUC resolves several over identical predictions. Learned representations further reveal that within-video anomaly structure and detector localization are decoupled. Third, on normal footage alone, every model we examine separates videos by recording properties, such as resolution and color encoding, indicating that scene sensitivity is shared across the setting rather than specific to any architecture. We publicly release a granularity-aware protocol computable from existing predictions and scene-factor annotations for UCF-Crime.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地审计了弱监督视频异常检测（WSVAD）中广泛使用的池化AUC评估协议，指出其未能可靠地反映帧级（视频内）异常定位性能。作者在UCF-Crime基准上对多种SOTA模型进行了三项粒度的配对比较（全局、按异常类别、视频内），并通过对数级自举统计证明：池化AUC在测试集规模下缺乏分辨率以支撑所报告的性能差距；视频内AUC能在相同预测上区分更多比较；模型的表示中视频内异常结构与检测器定位是解耦的；此外所有模型在正常片段上都能根据录制属性（分辨率、色彩编码）区分视频，表明场景敏感性是该设置下的共性而非架构特性。作者发布了粒度感知的评估协议和场景因子标注。
AI.motivation: WSVAD领域的标准评估指标——池化AUC——可能掩盖了模型在帧级异常定位上的真实能力差异，因为它在跨视频聚合帧对时既度量了事件定位也度量了视频源之间的差异。现有文献中报告的SOTA差距可能缺乏统计分辨率支撑，需要系统性地审计这一协议。
AI.method: 在UCF-Crime上对多个SOTA模型（覆盖不同骨干架构）进行审计：固定模型的帧分数，在三种配对粒度（全局/按异常类别/视频内）下重新评估；同时对模型内部表示计算零样本分数执行相同的三粒度读法；使用配对视频自举（paired video bootstrap）评估排序可靠性。
AI.result: 三个主要发现：（1）池化AUC不能可靠预测视频内异常定位，相似池化分数的模型在更严格粒度下表现出显著定位差异和排名反转；（2）在测试集规模下，池化AUC缺乏分辨率支撑文献中的SOTA差距，骨架家族内无法解析这些边际差异，而视频内AUC能解析多个；（3）所有模型都能依据录制属性（分辨率、色彩编码）在正常片段上分离视频，表明场景敏感性是该设置下的共有属性。
AI.conclusion: 现有WSVAD评估协议（池化AUC）在帧级异常定位评估上不可靠且缺乏统计分辨率。建议采用粒度感知的评估协议（尤其是视频内AUC），并注意场景因子（如录制属性）对模型评分的系统性影响。作者公开发布了可计算的粒度感知协议及相关场景因子标注，供社区复现和扩展。

title: Evolutionary tracks of giant planets formed by disk instability
comment: Accepted for publication in A&A, 13 pages, 13 figures
summary: The evolution of giant planets depends on their formation history. While several evolutionary models self-consistently link planet formation by core accretion to long-term evolution, such models for planets formed by disk instability are lacking. We simulate the evolution of giant planets formed by disk instability and follow their evolution including the pre-collapse phase, dynamical collapse, and long-term contraction in a unified numerical framework. The evolution is simulated using the MESPA code with modifications that allow us to model gas clumps in the pre-collapse phase. We consider masses between 1 and 12 Jupiter masses and metallicities ranging from 0.5 to 2 times the protosolar value. We confirm that the pre-collapse timescale strongly depends on the planetary mass, and that after dynamical collapse the objects reach a state of long-term contraction which lasts for billions of years. We show that metallicity is a major source of uncertainty in mass estimates derived from the age-luminosity relations. For the metallicity range considered here, we find that for a given measurement of age and luminosity the difference in the inferred mass can be up to 1.5 Jupiter masses. We find that our evolution tracks predict masses that are consistent with the measured dynamical mass constraints for HR 8799 e, AF Lep b, Beta Pic b and Beta Pic c. We also show that both core accretion and disk instability can lead to very similar long-term evolutionary tracks. The agreement between our models and dynamical mass measurements suggests that disk instability remains a viable formation pathway for giant exoplanets. The luminosity evolution alone cannot distinguish between the two formation pathways. Finally, we suggest that planetary metallicity must be taken into account when inferring the masses of young giant planets from their luminosities, as it significantly affects their evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在统一数值框架下模拟了由盘不稳定性形成的巨行星的完整演化过程，包括塌缩前阶段、动力学塌缩和长期收缩。研究发现金属丰度是年龄-光度关系推断行星质量的主要不确定性来源（可达1.5木星质量），并验证了盘不稳定性和核吸积两条形成路径可以产生相似的长周期演化轨迹。模型预测的质量与HR 8799 e、AF Lep b、Beta Pic b和Beta Pic c的动力学质量约束一致，表明盘不稳定性仍是巨行星形成的可行途径。
AI.motivation: 核心吸积形成的巨行星已有自洽的演化模型，但盘不稳定性形成的行星缺乏类似的演化模型。为评估盘不稳定性作为巨行星形成路径的可行性，需要建立统一的演化框架来模拟这类行星从形成到长期演化的全过程，特别是塌缩前阶段和后续收缩阶段的行为。
AI.method: 使用改进的MESPA代码在统一数值框架中模拟盘不稳定性形成的巨行星演化，涵盖塌缩前（pre-collapse）气体团块、动力学塌缩和长期收缩三个阶段。考虑1至12木星质量的参数范围，金属丰度从原恒星值的0.5到2倍。通过模拟演化轨迹，将其与年龄-光度关系以及已知系外行星的动力学质量约束进行对比验证。
AI.result: 确认塌缩前的时间尺度强烈依赖于行星质量；动力学塌缩后物体进入可维持数十亿年的长期收缩状态。金属丰度是年龄-光度关系质量推断的主要不确定性来源，在所考虑的金属丰度范围内，给定年龄和光度时质量推断差异可达1.5木星质量。演化轨迹预测的质量与HR 8799 e、AF Lep b、Beta Pic b和Beta Pic c的动力学质量测量一致。核吸积和盘不稳定性可产生非常相似的长周期演化轨迹，仅凭光度演化无法区分两种形成路径。
AI.conclusion: 盘不稳定性仍是巨行星形成的可行途径，模型与动力学质量测量的一致性支持了这一结论。仅依赖亮度演化无法区分两种形成路径，因此推断年轻巨行星质量时必须考虑行星金属丰度的影响，因为它显著影响行星演化。

title: Maximally chaotic competition for attention in the cultural domain
comment: main paper: 16 pages, appendices: 8 pages, supplementary material: 13 pages
summary: Memory is a key determinant when cultural items compete for attention and, consequently, for success, as in the case of songs on a music chart. For modeling, one adds memory to Lotka-Volterra models, the reference for Markovian competitive processes. Here we treat memory in terms of an exponential moving average, finding that it leads to an extended region of winnerless chaos characterized by log-normal popularity statistics in trailing top-k charts. Importantly, the observed log-normal behavior collapses to a power-law distribution when the feedback dynamics is fast on the scale of the charting period. This result is in agreement with the observed statistics of real-world music charts (e.g., Billboard and Spotify). In a chaotic state, the size of the largest Lyapunov exponent is a measure of how unpredictable the system is. We find that the largest Lyapunov exponent varies strongly as a function of parameters in the phase where winnerless chaos is stable. Interestingly, the sets of parameters obtained by comparing simulations with real-world cultural-item dynamics extracted from Google Books and Google Trends, movies, Reddit, Wikipedia, Twitter, and scientific publications, are located close to the points in parameter space where the largest Lyapunov exponent reaches its local maximum, namely, close to the point of maximal unpredictability. This result suggests that cultural competitive processes are maximally chaotic when memory is a key determinant.

AI.tldr: 本文将记忆机制（指数滑动平均）引入Lotka-Volterra竞争模型，发现记忆会导致"无胜者混沌"区域，其尾部热门榜单呈现对数正态分布，但在快速反馈动力学下退化为幂律分布，与Billboard和Spotify等真实音乐榜单统计一致。进一步研究发现，真实文化竞争系统（如Google Books、Google Trends、电影、Reddit、Wikipedia、Twitter及科学出版物）的参数均位于最大Lyapunov指数局部极大值附近，即处于最大不可预测点，表明当记忆起关键作用时，文化竞争过程呈现最大混沌性。
AI.motivation: 文化产品（如歌曲）在注意力竞争中，记忆是决定其成败的关键因素。已有研究用Lotka-Volterra模型描述马尔可夫竞争过程，但该模型缺乏记忆机制。本文旨在通过引入记忆扩展该模型，解释现实中文化榜单的流行度统计特征（如对数正态分布），并探究记忆在文化竞争混沌动力学中的作用。
AI.method: 在Lotka-Volterra竞争模型中引入指数滑动平均形式的记忆机制；通过分析扩展后的系统动力学，研究其混沌行为与流行度统计分布；计算最大Lyapunov指数评估系统不可预测性；将模型与真实世界文化数据（音乐榜单、Google Books、Google Trends、电影、Reddit、Wikipedia、Twitter、科学出版物）进行参数对比。
AI.result: 记忆机制的引入产生了无胜者混沌区域，其尾部热门榜单流行度呈对数正态分布；当反馈动力学相对榜单周期较快时，分布退化为幂律，与Billboard和Spotify等真实音乐榜单数据一致。最大Lyapunov指数在参数空间中强烈变化，而真实文化系统参数落在其局部极大值附近，即最大不可预测点。
AI.conclusion: 文化竞争过程在记忆起决定作用时倾向于处于最大混沌（最大不可预测）状态。该发现表明，记忆不仅是文化竞争中的重要因素，而且系统似乎"选择"了最大混沌的参数区域，揭示了文化竞争动力学中记忆与不确定性之间的深层关联。

title: Sci-Surf: Navigating Scientific Literature Discovery through Human Feedback and Intelligent Summarizatio
summary: The rapid growth of scientific publications makes it increasingly difficult for researchers to identify relevant new studies and effectively comprehend them. Existing academic discovery platforms typically rely on static topic subscriptions or embedding-based similarity and provide only abstracts or short summaries, offering limited support for nuanced intent modeling and in-depth paper summarization. We present Sci-Surf, an intent-centric knowledge discovery system that integrates feedback-driven personalized recommendation with multi-modal blog-style paper digestion. Our approach refines user intent representations through LLM-based user profiling, while generating structured summaries that synthesize textual and visual information from full papers. The demo presents an end-to-end academic discovery pipeline and demonstrates measurable improvements in both recommendation quality and digestion quality through real-user evaluations. Specifically, the integration of verbalized profiles led to a 10.4% average improvement in predictive alignment with real-world user preferences throughout a month-long online evaluation.

AI.tldr: Sci-Surf是一个意图驱动的学术知识发现系统，将基于反馈的个性化推荐与多模态博客式论文消化相结合，通过LLM用户画像细化意图表示，并生成综合论文文本与视觉信息的结构化摘要。真实用户评估显示，引入语言化画像后，在为期一个月的在线评估中预测对齐平均提升了10.4%。
AI.motivation: 科学出版物快速增长使研究者难以识别和深入理解相关新研究。现有学术发现平台依赖静态主题订阅或嵌入相似度，且仅提供摘要或简短概述，无法支持细粒度意图建模和深度论文总结。
AI.method: 提出了Sci-Surf系统，包含两个核心模块：(1) 基于LLM的用户画像推理，从用户反馈中提炼语言化意图表示，用于个性化推荐；(2) 多模态博客式论文消化，生成综合论文文本与视觉信息的结构化摘要。系统通过反馈驱动不断细化用户意图。
AI.result: 通过真实用户评估验证了端到端学术发现管线的有效性。语言化用户画像的引入在为期一个月的在线评估中，使预测与真实用户偏好的对齐平均提升了10.4%，同时在推荐质量和消化质量上均有可测的改进。
AI.conclusion: Sci-Surf展示了意图中心范式在学术发现系统中的潜力，即通过LLM驱动的用户画像和多模态摘要生成来同时提升推荐精准度和内容消化深度，为下一代学术知识发现工具提供了可行设计方向。

title: HarmoniDPO: Video-guided Audio Generation via Preference-Optimized Diffusion
summary: Video-to-audio (V2A) generation faces significant challenges in achieving precise temporal synchronization and high perceptual quality due to the complex, ambiguous relationship between visual and auditory cues. Existing methods typically compress video inputs into single feature representations, leading to significant loss of temporal dynamics and fine-grained visual information. These approaches also rely on reconstruction-based training objectives that poorly correlate with human perceptual judgments of audio quality and appropriateness. We propose HarmoniDPO, a novel framework that integrates preference-based optimization into diffusion-based V2A generation to address these limitations. (1) Our approach leverages a dual video representation: combining global context with frame-wise features to preserve temporal dynamics and semantic detail. (2) Inspired by reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), HarmoniDPO employs online Direct Preference Optimization (online-DPO) to fine-tune a diffusion-based V2A model from preference judgments, enhancing perceptual quality and alignment. (3) Additionally, we introduce Dual-scale Diffusion Search (DDS), a test time scaling algorithm that adaptively optimizes output fidelity during inference. Experiments demonstrate that HarmoniDPO outperforms state-of-the-art methods in audio-video synchronization and subjective audio quality, offering a robust solution for generating realistic, human-preferred audio from video.

AI.tldr: HarmoniDPO 是一个面向视频到音频（V2A）生成的新框架，通过引入基于偏好的优化来克服现有方法在时间同步和感知质量上的不足。该框架结合了双视频表征（全局上下文+逐帧特征）保留时间动态与语义细节，采用在线直接偏好优化（online-DPO）微调扩散模型以对齐人类感知偏好，并引入双尺度扩散搜索（DDS）作为测试时缩放算法进一步优化输出保真度。实验表明其超越了现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: V2A生成面临两个核心挑战：一是视频输入被压缩为单一特征表示，导致时间动态和细粒度视觉信息的显著丢失；二是基于重建的训练目标与人类对音频质量和适配性的主观感知判断相关性差。现有方法在这两方面均有不足，因此需要新的框架以同时改善时间同步和感知质量。
AI.method: (1) 采用双视频表征，融合全局上下文与逐帧特征，以同时保留时间动态和语义细节；(2) 受RLHF启发，引入在线直接偏好优化（online-DPO）对基于扩散的V2A模型进行偏好微调，以提升感知质量和视听对齐；(3) 提出双尺度扩散搜索（DDS）作为测试时缩放算法，在推理阶段自适应优化输出保真度。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，HarmoniDPO在音频-视频同步性和主观音频质量方面均优于现有最先进方法，能够生成更真实、更符合人类偏好的视频伴生音频。
AI.conclusion: HarmoniDPO通过将偏好优化整合进扩散式V2A生成，有效解决了时间同步和感知质量问题，为从视频生成符合人类偏好且高质量音频提供了稳健的解决方案。

title: Scalable Multi-Agent Maze Traversal with Local Communication
comment: This manuscript has been accepted for publication in the proceedings of the World Symposium on the Algorithmic Foundations of Robotics (WAFR 2026), to be published by Springer in the Springer Proceedings in Advanced Robotics (SPAR) series
summary: Cave networks, pipe systems, and similar maze-like environments pose significant challenges for multi-agent navigation in unknown settings with limited communication. We propose a distributed algorithm that enables agents to collectively traverse an unknown, possibly cyclic graph. Agents enter sequentially at a designated start node and are tasked to localize and reach an undisclosed goal while avoiding collisions. They coordinate via local communication using leader-follower relationships and leader switching. At any moment in time, exploration is performed by only one of the agents, which runs a single-agent maze solver. We prove that the algorithm is complete, that its makespan is asymptotically equivalent (in the number of agents) to that of an optimal full-knowledge strategy, and derive its time and space complexity. Simulations with up to $625$ agents show a decreasing average sum-of-fuels as the number of agents increases and demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms a naïve baseline in which all agents independently execute the single-agent solver.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分布式多智能体导航算法，使智能体在未知、可能含环的图环境中集体遍历并定位目标，通过领导者-跟随者关系和领导者切换协调，仅单个智能体执行单智能体迷宫求解器进行探索。算法被证明完备，其makespan在智能体数量上渐近等价于全知最优策略，并给出了时间和空间复杂度。
AI.motivation: 洞穴网络、管道系统等迷宫式环境对未知环境下的多智能体导航构成重大挑战，尤其是在通信受限情况下。现有方法难以同时兼顾未知环境探索、多智能体协调和避碰，需要一种在通信受限条件下仍能高效完成集体导航的分布式算法。
AI.method: 提出一种分布式算法：智能体在指定起始节点顺序进入未知可能含环的图，通过局部通信建立领导者-跟随者关系并支持领导者切换。任意时刻仅有一个智能体执行单智能体迷宫求解器进行探索，其余智能体通过跟随关系协同移动，避免碰撞并最终到达未公开的目标节点。
AI.result: 证明算法完备性，其makespan在智能体数量上渐近等价于具有全知信息的最优策略；推导了时间和空间复杂度。仿真实验最多支持625个智能体，结果显示随着智能体数量增加，平均总燃料消耗（sum-of-fuels）下降，且该方法优于所有智能体独立执行单智能体求解器的朴素基线方案。
AI.conclusion: 该分布式算法在未知迷宫环境中实现了多智能体的高效集体导航，理论上保证完备性和渐近最优性，仿真验证了其扩展性和相对于朴素基线方法的优势，适用于洞穴、管道系统等通信受限的迷宫式场景。

title: Benchmark-Based Comparative Assessment of Publicly Benchmarked Indian Foundation Models: A Capability and Evaluation-Maturity Framework
summary: Governments increasingly fund indigenous foundation models to strengthen national AI capability, digital sovereignty, and multilingual computing. Assessing the progress of such national ecosystems is complicated by inconsistent benchmark reporting, proprietary evaluation methodologies, and rapidly evolving model releases. This paper presents a structured, benchmark-based comparative assessment of publicly benchmarked Indian foundation models against global frontier and comparable-scale models, across eight capability domains: general-purpose reasoning, coding and software engineering, agentic AI and computer use, cybersecurity, vision and image understanding, video and multimodal understanding, scientific research, and Indic language capability. Using only publicly reported benchmark results, we find that Indian models achieve strong scores on established benchmarks such as MMLU and MATH-500. However, these benchmarks are now widely regarded as saturated, and frontier developers no longer report them. Indian models participate far less frequently in newer, agentic, and domain-specialized evaluations. Benchmark participation is also highly uneven across Indian organizations. Among the models surveyed, Sarvam AI reports the broadest benchmark coverage by a substantial margin. We propose an exploratory four-dimension Benchmark Maturity Index (BMI), scoring each capability domain on standardization, participation, independent verification, and national coverage. We show that the BMI refines, and in some cases revises, the maturity judgments that a purely descriptive review would produce. We argue that many apparent capability gaps in the public record cannot be distinguished, on available evidence, from evaluation-ecosystem gaps. This has direct implications for how national AI programs should design monitoring and funding criteria.

AI.tldr: 该论文对印度公开基准测试的基础模型（foundation models）进行了结构化比较评估，覆盖八个能力域（通用推理、编程、智能体AI、网络安全、视觉、视频多模态、科学研究、印度语能力），并提出一个四维"基准成熟度指数"（BMI），用于评估各能力域的标准化、参与度、独立验证和国内覆盖程度。研究指出印度模型在饱和基准（如MMLU、MATH-500）上表现好，但参与新版/智能体/领域专项评测的频率明显较低，且不同机构参与度极不均衡。作者论证许多表面上的能力差距实际上是评测生态差距，这对国家AI项目的监测与资助标准设计有直接影响。
AI.motivation: 各国政府日益资助本土基础模型以强化国家AI能力、数字主权和多语言计算，但评估这类国家生态系统的进展面临基准报告不一致、专有评测方法和模型快速迭代等挑战，缺乏系统的评估框架来衡量国家层面的AI进展。
AI.method: 仅使用公开报告的基准测试结果，对印度基础模型与全球前沿模型及同等规模模型在八个能力域进行对比评估；提出一个四维"基准成熟度指数"（BMI），从标准化、参与度、独立验证、国家覆盖四个维度对每个能力域打分，并与纯描述性评估结果进行对照。
AI.result: 印度模型在MMLU、MATH-500等已被广泛认为饱和的基准上得分很高，但前沿开发者已不再报告这些基准。印度模型在新兴的智能体类和领域专项评测上的参与度明显较低；各印度组织间的基准参与度也极不均衡，其中Sarvam AI的基准覆盖范围远超其他机构。BMI显示其对成熟度的判断能细化甚至修正纯描述性评估的结论。
AI.conclusion: 公开记录中的许多"能力差距"在现有证据下无法与评测生态系统缺失造成的差距相区分。这意味着国家AI项目在设计和制定监测与资助标准时，必须区分真正的能力短板与评测覆盖不足，BMI可作为更可靠的国家级AI成熟度评估工具。

title: CoQui: A Coordinate-Conditioned Quantum Implicit Generative Adversarial Network for End-to-End Image Generation
summary: Quantum generative adversarial networks (QGANs) have attracted increasing attention for image generation using parameterized quantum circuits. Existing amplitude-based approaches face two key limitations: pixel locations are typically encoded by computational-basis indices or address qubits, causing quantum resources to grow with image resolution; meanwhile, jointly decoding many pixels from normalized quantum states introduces probability competition among pixels and limits precise pixel-wise control. To address these issues, we reformulate quantum image generation as coordinate-conditioned implicit function learning. Our method takes spatial coordinates and latent variables as inputs, uses a classical embedding network to generate input-dependent circuit parameters, and evaluates a variational quantum circuit at each coordinate. Pixel intensities are directly obtained from the expectation value of a dedicated color qubit, and a complete image is generated by querying all spatial coordinates. This design decouples image resolution from address-qubit requirements and avoids shared probability-normalization constraints across pixels. We further design a specialized variational quantum circuit to provide structural inductive bias for coordinate-conditioned generation. Simulated experiments on two benchmark datasets show that our method outperforms FRQI-based generation and PQWGAN in visual and quantitative quality while using fewer qubits, and also achieves better generation quality than the corresponding classical baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种坐标条件隐式函数学习的量子图像生成方法，通过空间坐标和潜变量输入、经典嵌入网络生成电路参数、变分量子电路在每个坐标处评估来生成图像，解耦了图像分辨率与地址量子比特需求，避免了像素间共享概率归一化约束。
AI.motivation: 现有基于振幅的量子生成对抗网络(QGAN)在图像生成中存在两个关键缺陷：一是像素位置通常由计算基索引或地址量子比特编码，导致量子资源随图像分辨率增长；二是从归一化量子态联合解码多个像素会产生像素间概率竞争，限制了对每个像素的精确控制。
AI.method: 将量子图像生成重新表述为坐标条件隐式函数学习。以空间坐标和潜变量为输入，使用经典嵌入网络生成依赖于输入的电路参数，在每个坐标处评估变分量子电路。像素强度直接从专用颜色量子比特的期望值获得，通过查询所有空间坐标来生成完整图像。同时设计了专门化的变分量子电路以提供坐标条件生成的结构性归纳偏置。
AI.result: 在两个基准数据集上的模拟实验表明，该方法在视觉质量和定量评估上优于基于FRQI的生成方法和PQWGAN，同时使用更少的量子比特，并且生成质量优于相应的经典基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过坐标条件隐式函数学习框架，有效解决了振幅型QGAN中量子资源随分辨率增长和像素间概率竞争的问题，实现了更高效、更精确的量子图像生成。

title: Warping Earth Observations for better ice labeling in the Marginal Marginal Ice Zone
summary: Multimodal satellite imagery provides complementary information for Earth Observation, but accurately combining heterogeneous sensors remains challenging in dynamic environments. Fast-changing regions, such as the Antarctic marginal ice zone, cannot fully exploit multimodal information from different satellite sensors because surface features move between image acquisitions. This spatial and temporal mismatch challenges effective perceptual grounding, violating the assumption of pixel-level correspondence that underpins most multimodal reasoning and downstream classification pipelines. Antarctic sea ice provides a challenging benchmark due to the rapid, heterogeneous drift of individual ice floes and the differing responses of sea ice to radar, visible and thermal sensing modalities. Accurate, dense supervision of sea ice remains scarce because generating pixel-wise labels requires time-consuming expert interpretation of noisy data, leading to historical reliance on coarse-resolution maritime ice charts for model training. This paper presents a novel architecture based on mutual information warping to align multi-satellite (Sentinel-1 and MODIS platforms) multimodal (visible, thermal, radar) satellite scenes. To demonstrate the approach, we introduce a sparse expert-labeled dataset of 2,088 pixel-wise annotations (7,046 expert point classifications) located at the ice-water margin interface across 43 scenes. Our results demonstrate that spatially grounding and aligning modalities prior to segmentation improves classification accuracy, and enables accurate, dense sea ice segmentation from sparse point-wise supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于互信息( mutual information)warping的新型架构，用于对齐多卫星（Sentinel-1和MODIS）多模态（可见光、热红外、雷达）影像，以解决南极边缘冰带中冰体漂移导致的像素级失配问题。作者引入了一个包含2,088个像素级标注的稀疏专家数据集，实验表明在分割前进行空间对齐与模态配准可提升分类精度，并实现从稀疏点级监督中学习稠密海冰分割。
AI.motivation: 多模态卫星影像可提供互补的地球观测信息，但在动态环境中（如南极边缘冰带），由于冰体在不同卫星过境之间快速漂移，导致像素级对应关系被破坏，传统多模态推理和分类流程的这一前提假设失效，因此亟需解决时空失配问题。
AI.method: 提出基于互信息warping的架构对齐多卫星多模态影像（Sentinel-1与MODIS）；引入包含43个场景、2,088个像素级标注（7,046个专家点分类）的稀疏专家标注数据集，标注位于冰-水交界区域；在分割前对模态进行空间对齐与配准。
AI.result: 空间对齐与模态配准后再进行分割能提升分类精度，并能在仅有点级稀疏监督的条件下实现准确的稠密海冰分割。
AI.conclusion: 在动态环境下，多模态卫星影像的空间对齐是有效利用多传感器信息的前提；稀疏的点级专家监督结合对齐策略可替代传统依赖粗分辨率冰图的稠密标注，为海冰分割提供更高效、更准确的方案。

title: D3D-GEN: Robot-Aware Domain-Grounded Interactive 3D World Generation for Social Robotics
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, and 5 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
