summary: Training and validation of Embodied AI for social navigation critically depends on realistic simulation environments, yet many current approaches fail to find a balance between realism and simulability. We propose D3D-GEN, a novel world generation system that combines a domain agent with a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline grounded in that domain. Our system enables users to rapidly generate domain-grounded, fully interactive 3D worlds by automating both the collection of domain knowledge and the synthesis of realistic floorplans and object placements, without dependence on any fixed 3D model database. Given a domain description prompt, the research agent collects publicly accessible domain-specific data and constructs a persistent domain database. Using this database, our RAG pipeline generates plausible floorplans and object placements by dynamically querying a user-provided semantic database, which can be easily extended or modified. The output is a fully interactive 3D world loadable by the popular simulators Isaac Sim and Gazebo. With our approach, we have built databases for several common domains (indoor residential, hospital, office) and generated dozens of distinct, plausible simulation environments for each domain. We present D3D-GEN with a local web frontend that facilitates rapid, interactive world generation for robot simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出D3D-GEN，一个结合领域智能体与检索增强生成（RAG）管道的世界生成系统，能够快速生成领域基础、完全交互式的3D仿真世界，不依赖固定3D模型数据库，支持Isaac Sim和Gazebo等仿真器。
AI.motivation: 具身智能（Embodied AI）社交导航的训练和验证高度依赖逼真的仿真环境，但现有方法难以在真实性与可仿真性之间取得平衡，且多依赖固定模型数据库，限制了生成世界的多样性和泛化能力。
AI.method: D3D-GEN包含两部分：一是领域智能体，自动收集公开可访问的领域特定数据并构建持久化的领域数据库；二是基于该领域数据库的RAG管道，通过动态查询用户提供的可扩展语义数据库来生成合理的楼层平面图和物体布局。系统集成于本地Web前端，输出可直接加载到Isaac Sim和Gazebo的交互式3D世界。
AI.result: 已在多个常见领域（室内住宅、医院、办公室）构建了数据库，并为每个领域生成数十个不同的、合理的仿真环境。
AI.conclusion: D3D-GEN通过自动化的领域知识收集与RAG驱动的世界合成，实现了快速、灵活且无需固定3D模型数据库的交互式3D世界生成，为具身智能的社会导航仿真提供了高效解决方案。

title: ATOM: Geometry-Aware Microgesture towards Object-Agnostic Tangible Interaction
summary: This paper presents ATOM, an integrated framework towards agnostic and tangible object interactions with microgestures. Our goal is to support microgesture interactions across different everyday objects, with the capability to automatically leverage the geometric affordance of each object. We formulate a fingertip-aware detection pipeline to leverage generative 2D and 3D models for geometry enhancement and refinement. We then introduce a usability-based method to prioritize the detected elements based on their ergonomic suitability for interactions. Building on this foundation, we further develop an AR system to transform everyday handheld objects into tangible user interfaces with 0D, 1D, and 2D microgesture interactions. Across transitions among everyday cooking objects of varying shapes and sizes, ATOM outperformed ablation baselines in task completion, usability (SUS), and workload (NASA-TLX). A further study with 10 objects demonstrates ATOM's generalizability across objects and grasps, highlighting its potential towards fluid, object-agnostic tangible interaction in real-world AR scenarios.

AI.tldr: ATOM是一个集成框架，通过指尖感知的检测流程和基于可用性的元素优先级排序方法，实现跨日常物品的微手势物物交互，在AR环境中将手持物品转化为0D、1D和2D的物性用户界面，并显著优于消融基线。
AI.motivation: 现有微手势交互通常局限于特定物体或固定界面，缺乏跨不同日常物体的通用性。作者旨在支持不同日常物体上的微手势交互，并自动利用每个物体的几何可供性，实现物体无关的物性交互。
AI.method: 提出了感知指尖的检测流程，利用生成式2D和3D模型进行几何增强与细化；引入基于可用性的方法，根据人体工效学适宜性对检测元素进行优先级排序；在此基础上开发AR系统，将日常手持物体转化为支持0D、1D和2D微手势交互的物性用户界面。
AI.result: 在跨不同形状和尺寸的日常烹饪物体的转换场景中，ATOM在任务完成率、可用性（SUS）和工作负荷（NASA-TLX）方面均优于消融基线。额外10个物体的研究验证了ATOM在物体和抓取方式上的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: ATOM展示了在真实AR场景中实现流畅、物体无关的物性交互的巨大潜力，为日常物品向交互界面的转变提供了有效的技术途径。

title: Enhancing Visual Domain Robustness in Behaviour Cloning via Saliency-Guided Augmentation
comment: Accepted at the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) 2024
summary: In vision-based behavior cloning (BC), conventional image augmentations such as Random Crop and Color Jitter often fall short under substantial visual domain shifts, including changes in shadows, distractors, and backgrounds. Superimposition-based augmentations, which blend in-domain and out-of-domain images, have shown promise for improving generalization in computer vision, but their suitability for BC remains uncertain because task-critical semantics, spatiotemporal relationships, and agent-target interactions must be preserved. To address this, we introduce RoboSaGA, a Saliency-Guided Augmentation method within the superimposition family tailored for vision-based BC. RoboSaGA dynamically adjusts augmentation intensity at the pixel level using policy-driven saliency, enabling aggressive augmentation in task-irrelevant regions while preserving task-critical information. It integrates seamlessly into existing architectures without requiring structural modifications or additional learning objectives. Experiments in both simulated and real-world settings show that RoboSaGA preserves in-domain performance while substantially improving robustness to visual domain shifts, including distractor and background changes, as well as lighting and shadow variations. Code is available at https://github.com/Zheyu-Zhuang/RoboSaGA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RoboSaGA，一种基于显著性引导的叠加式数据增强方法，用于视觉行为克隆。它通过策略驱动的显著性在像素级别动态调整增强强度，在任务无关区域进行激进增强，同时保留任务关键信息，以提升模型对视觉域偏移（阴影、干扰物、背景变化）的鲁棒性，且无需修改网络结构或增加额外学习目标。
AI.motivation: 视觉行为克隆中，传统图像增强（如随机裁剪、颜色抖动）在显著视觉域偏移下泛化能力不足；叠加式增强虽在通用视觉任务中有前景，但在行为克隆场景下需保留任务关键语义、时空关系及智能体-目标交互，直接套用存在风险，因此需要一种能区分任务相关与无关区域的增强方法。
AI.method: RoboSaGA属于叠加式增强家族，利用策略驱动的显著性图在像素级别动态调节增强强度：对任务无关区域施加强烈增强，对任务关键区域保持弱增强，从而在丰富视觉多样性的同时不破坏关键信息。该方法可无缝集成到现有行为克隆架构中，无需结构改动或额外学习目标。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界实验中，RoboSaGA在保持域内性能的同时，显著提升了对视觉域偏移的鲁棒性，包括干扰物、背景、光照与阴影变化等场景。
AI.conclusion: RoboSaGA验证了显著性引导的像素级自适应增强对视觉行为克隆域泛化的有效性，兼顾域内保真与域外鲁棒性，且具有良好的即插即用特性。

title: Urban logistics dynamics: a user-centric approach to traffic modelling and kinetic parameter analysis
summary: Efficient urban logistics requires a comprehensive understanding of traffic dynamics, particularly as it pertains to kinetic parameters influencing energy consumption and trip duration estimations. While real-time traffic information is increasingly accessible, current high-precision forecasting services embedded in route planning often function as opaque 'black boxes' for users. These services, typically relying on AI-processed counting data, fall short in accommodating open design parameters essential for management studies, notably within Supply Chain Management. This work revisits the modelling of traffic conditions in the context of city logistics, emphasizing its significance from the user's point of view, with two focuses. Firstly, the focus is not on the vehicle flow but on the vehicles themselves and the impact of the traffic conditions on their driving behaviour. This means opening the range of studied indicators, beyond vehicle speed, to describe extensively the kinetic and dynamic aspects of the driving behaviour. To achieve this, we leverage the Art.Kinema parameters designed to characterizing driving cycles. Secondly, this study examines how the driving context (i.e., exogenous factors to the traffic flow) determine the mentioned driving behaviour. Specifically, we explore how accurately the kinetic behaviour of a vehicle can be predicted based on a limited set of exogenous factors, such as time, day, road type, orientation, slope, and weather conditions? To answer this question, statistical analysis was conducted on real-world driving data, which include high-frequency measurements of vehicle speed. A Factor Analysis and a Generalized Linear Model have been established to link kinetic parameters with independent categorical contextual variables. The results include an assessment of the adjustment quality and of the robustness of the models, as well as an overview of the models' outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文从用户视角重新审视城市物流中的交通条件建模，利用Art.Kinema参数描述车辆驾驶行为的运动学特征，并通过因子分析和广义线性模型探讨如何基于有限的外生驾驶环境因素（如时间、日期、道路类型、坡度、天气等）预测车辆的运动学行为，旨在为供应链管理研究提供开放可解释的预测模型。
AI.motivation: 现有高精度交通预测服务（如路径规划中的实时信息）对用户而言是"黑箱"，其依赖AI处理的计数数据无法容纳管理研究（尤其是供应链管理）所需的开放设计参数。因此需要一个可解释的、从车辆个体而非交通流角度出发的交通条件建模方法。
AI.method: 1) 利用Art.Kinema参数框架来全面描述车辆驾驶行为的运动学和动力学方面，指标超出单一车速；2) 基于真实驾驶数据（高频车速测量），选取有限的外生环境变量（时间、日期、道路类型、朝向、坡度、天气）作为自变量；3) 采用因子分析（Factor Analysis）和广义线性模型（GLM）建立运动学参数与分类情境变量之间的关联模型；4) 对模型拟合质量和稳健性进行评估。
AI.result: 研究给出了所建立模型的拟合优度评估结果、模型稳健性评估结果，以及模型输出的概述，展示了基于有限外生因素预测车辆运动学行为的可行性和预测精度。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了通过有限的可解释外生情境因素即可较为准确地预测车辆在城市物流中的运动学行为，为供应链管理提供了一个开放、透明、可参数化的交通条件建模途径，弥补了现有"黑箱"预测服务的不足。

title: From Overlooked to Explored: Recovering Item Relations via Mixture of Perspectives for Sequential Recommendation
comment: Accepted at CIKM 2026 full research papers track
summary: Capturing user preference from a user's interaction sequence is the central challenge of Sequential Recommendation (SR). This preference intuitively emerges from inter-item relations: each item transition reflects a preference embedded in the relations between items, making the faithful capture of these relations essential for accurate recommendation. For this reason, self-attention is dominant in sequential recommendation for its ability to compute pairwise item interactions, yet our empirical analysis reveals that it consistently suffers from similarity bias across various types of transformer-based SR models: dot-product attention scores disproportionately favor similar items, systematically overlooking heterogeneous relations with meaningful preference signals and directly limiting recommendation performance. To address this, we propose PRISM (Perspective-based Relational Insight Synthesis Module), a module that re-examines item relations from multiple perspectives. PRISM employs K Perspective Lenses to calibrate attention from distinct viewpoints, combining an Affinity View that refines homogeneous relations and a Contrast View that exposes heterogeneous ones suppressed by similarity bias, enabling the model to capture the full spectrum of user preferences. Extensive experiments on seven real-world benchmarks demonstrate that PRISM consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/327aem/PRISM/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRISM模块，通过多视角透镜（亲和视角与对比视角）校准自注意力中的相似性偏差，从而同时捕捉同质和异质物品关系，在七个真实基准上超越现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: 序列推荐的核心挑战是从交互序列中捕捉用户偏好，而偏好本质上源于物品间的关系。尽管自注意力因其能计算两两物品交互而成为主流，但实证分析发现点积注意力分数存在相似性偏差，过度偏向相似物品，系统性忽视了含有偏好信号的有意义异质关系，从而限制了推荐性能。
AI.method: 提出PRISM（基于视角的关系洞察合成模块），采用K个视角透镜从不同角度校准注意力。该模块包含两个关键视图：亲和视图（Affinity View）用于精炼同质关系，对比视图（Contrast View）用于暴露被相似性偏差抑制的异质关系，从而使模型能够捕捉完整的用户偏好光谱。
AI.result: 在七个真实世界基准数据集上的大量实验表明，PRISM持续优于最先进（SOTA）的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: PRISM通过多视角注意力校准有效解决了自注意力固有的相似性偏差问题，能够更全面地捕捉物品间关系中的用户偏好，为序列推荐提供了更准确的建模方案。

title: ResPCC: A Loss-Resilient Neural Point Cloud Codec over Lossy Networks
summary: Point cloud compression (PCC) is critical for efficient storage and transmission of 3D data. While recent learning-based PCC methods achieve good rate-distortion (R-D) performance, they generally rely on ideal transmission conditions. In practice, packet loss is a common issue and can severely distort latent features, causing coordinate drift and geometric degradation. To address this challenge, we present ResPCC, the first end-to-end neural point cloud codec designed to offer intrinsic resilience against data loss. Our framework is loss-rate-aware and adapts to diverse packet loss conditions. At the encoder, we introduce a Condition-Adaptive Latent Modulation (CALM) module to adjust latent feature distributions according to the perceived loss rate, as well as a Spatial-Channel Interleaving (SCI) mechanism that transforms channel-wise data extinction into spatially scattered element-wise missing patterns. At the decoder, we develop a Mask-Aware Graph-based Latent Restoration (MGLR) module, followed by a Dictionary-based Refinement (DBR) stage to recover corrupted features and align them with canonical priors. Evaluations on ShapeNet and SemanticKITTI under 5\% to 30\% packet loss rates show that ResPCC consistently delivers superior stability and R-D performance over baselines. Our framework maintains high reconstruction fidelity under lossy conditions, providing a reliable solution for 3D data transmission over practical networks. Code is available at https://github.com/starrynight314/ResPCC.

AI.tldr: ResPCC是首个端到端神经点云编解码器，专为应对传输丢包场景设计。它通过编码端的Condition-Adaptive Latent Modulation (CALM)和Spatial-Channel Interleaving (SCI)机制，以及解码端的Mask-Aware Graph-based Latent Restoration (MGLR)和Dictionary-based Refinement (DBR)模块，在5%-30%丢包率下实现了优于基线方法的稳定性与率失真性能。
AI.motivation: 现有学习型点云压缩方法在理想传输条件下表现良好，但实际网络中普遍存在的丢包问题会严重破坏潜特征，导致坐标漂移和几何退化。现有方法缺乏对数据丢失的固有鲁棒性，因此需要设计一个能够感知丢包率并自适应恢复的点云编解码框架。
AI.method: ResPCC提出三个核心模块：1) CALM模块在编码端根据感知到的丢包率调制潜特征分布；2) SCI机制将通道维度的数据丢失转化为空间上分散的元素级缺失模式；3) MGLR模块在解码端通过掩码感知的图神经网络恢复损坏特征，随后用DBR阶段将恢复后的特征与典型先验对齐。
AI.result: 在ShapeNet和SemanticKITTI数据集上，在5%到30%的丢包率条件下，ResPCC相比基线方法在重建保真度和率失真性能上均表现出一致的优越性和稳定性。
AI.conclusion: ResPCC为实际网络场景下的3D数据传输提供了可靠解决方案，填补了神经点云编解码器在抗丢包鲁棒性方面的空白，展现了在恶劣传输条件下保持高重建保真度的能力。

title: Air Quality Station Simulation via LSTM and Attention-Based Modelling
comment: Preprint prepared as an extension to the conference article at https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-031-97313-0_20, which describes some features of the proposed model. The preprint includes more tests and better concept explanations
summary: Poor air quality in urban areas is driven by a complex chain of processes and presents a significant public health concern. To better understand and control the mechanisms that determine air quality, cities deploy networks of measurement stations, and launch initiatives for collecting denser data about the concentration of pollutants in the atmosphere. Extracting insights from the stations relies on their reliable and uninterrupted operation. However, hardware is susceptible to faults and black- outs that may result in data unavailability, which affects the overall quality of analyses. In this paper, we present a deep-learning model, called SATADL, which can infer complex relations and output multiple-hour-ahead air-quality forecasts. The goal of the model is to simulate the mea- surements of an unresponsive station until its operation is restored. The architecture of the model, which allows it to extract information from different aspects of the data, is described in detail and a careful examination of all of its components is provided. We demonstrate the performance of SATADL on four sets of air quality stations from around the world, by using it to simulate the concentration of PM10 for periods of hypothetical failures of one of the measurement stations, lasting for as long as 48 hours. A selection of baseline and published deep learning models were trained and used as a benchmark. The results show that SATADL per- forms better across different prediction windows, for both coefficient of determination and root mean squared error, demonstrating its suitability as a virtual proxy station.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为SATADL的深度学习模型，用于在空气质量监测站出现故障或断电期间，模拟其测量数据，输出多小时的空气质量预报（如PM10浓度），以充当"虚拟代理站"。该模型在全球四组空气质量站数据上进行了验证，最多模拟48小时的缺失数据，结果表明其在预测精度（决定系数和均方根误差）上优于多种基线和已发表的深度学习模型。
AI.motivation: 城市空气质量监测依赖测量站的可靠运行，但硬件容易发生故障或断电，导致数据不可用，影响空气质量分析的完整性和质量。因此需要一种能够模拟故障站点测量数据的方法，以在站点恢复前提供连续的虚拟代理测量，保障分析工作的连续性。
AI.method: 提出名为SATADL的深度学习架构，从数据的不同维度提取信息以推断复杂关系，输出多步超前（multi-hour-ahead）的空气质量预测。模型通过假设施测站故障的场景，最长模拟48小时的PM10浓度，并与多种基线及已发表的深度学习模型进行对比基准测试。
AI.result: SATADL在全球四组空气质量站数据上，对于不同预测时间窗口，在决定系数（R²）和均方根误差（RMSE）两个指标上均优于基准模型和已发表的深度学习模型，证明了其作为虚拟代理站的适用性和优越性。
AI.conclusion: SATADL是一种有效且可靠的虚拟代理站方案，能够在空气质量监测站故障期间提供高质量的模拟测量数据，有助于维持城市空气质量分析的连续性和可靠性。

title: Statistics of Solar Filament Mass based on CHASE Sun-as-a-star Spectroscopic Observations
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures. Accepted for publication in The Astrophysical Journal Letters
summary: Filaments are cool and dense plasmas suspended in the hot corona of the Sun and other stars. Accurately estimating their masses is of great significance for understanding subsequent eruptions and induced space weather effects, but it remains hindered by their intrinsic geometric uncertainties, particularly in spatially unresolved stellar observations. To test and calibrate the methods for estimating the masses of stellar filaments, we conduct a statistical Sun-as-a-star analysis of solar filaments, utilizing full-disk H$α$ spectroscopic observations from the Chinese H$α$ Solar Explorer (CHASE). A total of 1346 filaments, covering a period from January 2024 to October 2025, are identified via a machine-learning segmentation model. We construct their virtual sun-as-a-star spectra by spatially integrating the filament regions and then obtain their optical parameters by cloud-model fitting. Upon correcting projection effects, we establish a representative three-dimensional morphological scaling of length, apparent width, and line-of-sight depth ($L:W_{\rm app}:D_{\rm LOS} \approx 4.5:1:1.7$), with a median filament depth of about 8000 km. Interestingly, the Sun-as-a-star estimated mass shows high consistency with the resolved intrinsic mass across the full sample, with a log-space regression slope of 1.07. As the first large-sample Sun-as-a-star study of solar filaments, our results provide empirical constraints on filament geometries and masses, offering a critical reference for estimating stellar filament masses based on H$α$ spectroscopy.

AI.tldr: 本文利用CHASE卫星的全日面Hα光谱观测，对1346个太阳暗条进行了太阳-as-a-star统计研究，建立了三维形态尺度比例（L:W_app:D_LOS ≈ 4.5:1:1.7），并发现太阳-as-a-star质量估计与实测内禀质量高度一致（log空间回归斜率为1.07），为恒星暗条质量估计提供了关键参考。
AI.motivation: 暗条是太阳及其他恒星日冕中的致密低温等离子体，准确估计其质量对理解后续爆发及空间天气效应至关重要。然而，暗条固有的几何不确定性（尤其在空间不可分辨的恒星观测中）严重阻碍了质量估计的准确性，因此需要对恒星暗条质量估计方法进行测试和校准。
AI.method: 利用CHASE卫星的全日面Hα光谱观测，通过机器学习分割模型识别了2024年1月至2025年10月期间的1346个暗条。将暗条区域进行空间积分构建虚拟太阳-as-a-star光谱，通过云模型拟合获得光学参数，并校正投影效应后建立了三维形态尺度关系。
AI.result: 建立了暗条三维形态尺度比例L:W_app:D_LOS ≈ 4.5:1:1.7，暗条中值深度约8000 km。太阳-as-a-star估计质量与实测内禀质量在全体样本中高度一致，log空间回归斜率为1.07。
AI.conclusion: 作为首个大样本太阳暗条的太阳-as-a-star研究，该结果为暗条几何和质量的估计提供了经验约束，为基于Hα光谱估计恒星暗条质量提供了关键参考依据。

title: Located but Not Releasable: Silent Gate Inversion and Bounded Linear Release
summary: A growing body of work reports that language models represent task-relevant latent structure that they fail to use. Whether such structure, once located, can be converted into behavior is a separate question that is rarely tested end to end. We submit the complete pipeline -- detect, localize, and release -- to a fully preregistered stress test on a 25.7M transformer trained on causal-evidence discrimination, where a known suppression phenomenon (latent causal structure present but behaviorally unused) has previously been documented. Every threshold, claim template, and decision-tree branch was hashed and archived before any corresponding data existed. Three findings. (i) Localization succeeds: interventions at observation-evidence channels of mid layers restore target behavior on otherwise-suppressed worlds (paired release advantages $0.563$ and $0.854$, 97.5% CIs excluding zero; best-site release rate $0.889$). (ii) Gating fails out of distribution: a detector calibrated to trigger on zero out-of-distribution calibration worlds triggers on 6.9-7.3% of held-out in-distribution generations and on zero of the 2,400 held-out generations that actually need it -- a complete inversion that silently reduces the gated pipeline to its base model. (iii) Linear release is capped: removing the gate and injecting a per-instance linear direction unconditionally yields a monotone dose-response that plateaus far below the preregistered release margin (intercept $0.382 \to 0.311 \to 0.264$ vs. threshold $\le 0.08$); per-instance adaptivity adds less than $\pm 0.03$. The failure is doubly located: the detector is OOD-inverted, and the entire family of linear release directions at this site and resolution is bounded away from sufficiency. The two failures are dissociable, and neither overturns localization. Every number traces to a hashed artifact in the released audit chain.

AI.tldr: 该论文对"检测-定位-释放"完整管线（先定位潜在因果结构、再将其转化为行为）进行了完全预注册的压力测试。测试对象是一个2.57M参数的transformer，在因果证据判别任务上训练，且已知存在"潜在因果结构已存在但行为上未使用"的抑制现象。结果发现三点：(i)定位成功——对中间层观测证据通道的干预能恢复目标行为；(ii)门控机制在分布外彻底失效——检测器完全倒置，在真正需要释放的场景上触发率为零，导致门控管线静默退化为基座模型；(iii)线性释放存在上限——无条件注入每实例线性方向时剂量-反应曲线单调增加但在预设释放阈值下方就饱和，每实例自适应仅增加不到±0.03。两种失败可分离，均不推翻定位的成功结论。
AI.motivation: 已有大量研究表明语言模型表征中存在与任务相关的潜在结构但未被模型行为使用。然而，这种结构一旦被定位后能否被转化为实际行为，是一个很少被端到端检验的独立问题。本文旨在对这一完整转化管线进行严格的压力测试。
AI.method: 在2.57M参数的因果证据判别transformer上，对"检测(detect)-定位(localize)-释放(release)"完整管线进行全预注册测试。预先哈希并归档所有阈值、声明模板和决策树分支。在已知存在抑制现象的中间层观测证据通道上进行干预实验，检验门控检测器与线性释放路径的行为。
AI.result: (i)定位成功：中间层观测证据通道的干预恢复目标行为，配对释放优势为0.563和0.854（97.5%置信区间排除0），最佳位点释放率为0.889。(ii)门控机制分布外失效：检测器在零个分布外校准世界上触发，却在6.9-7.3%的分布内生成上触发，且在需要释放的2,400个held-out生成上触发率为零——完全倒置，使门控管线静默退化为基座模型。(iii)线性释放受限：无条件注入线性方向的剂量-反应曲线单调增加但在预设释放阈值（≤0.08）下方饱和（截距从0.382降至0.311再降至0.264），每实例自适应的增益不足±0.03。
AI.conclusion: 两种失败模式（检测器OOD倒置、线性释放方向族不充分）是可分离的，且均不推翻定位的成功结论。任何企图将潜在结构转化为行为的管线，其检测与释放环节都可能独立失效，即便定位完全成功。所有数字均可追溯至发布审计链中的哈希归档工件。

title: TD-VAD: Breaking Visual Dependence in Video Anomaly Detection with Text-Driven Learning
summary: Visual data is typically a prerequisite for training existing video anomaly detection (VAD) methods. However, obtaining sufficient annotated anomaly data for training is challenging and not scalable due to the rarity of anomaly data and the wide variety of abnormal events. In this work, we advocate that the effectiveness of treating texts as video sequences for the VAD model and propose a novel Text-Driven Video Anomaly Detection (TD-VAD) approach to break visual dependence. In contrast to the anomaly video data, text descriptions of abnormal events are easy to collect, and their class labels can be directly derived. Specifically, our method utilizes video-like text descriptions with temporal characteristics generated by LLM to train a VAD model, without any reliance on target-domain anomaly data. To capture the long- and short-range temporal logic of events, we design the event evolution causal attention module to model contextual dependencies across time. During inference, considering the domain gap between the texts and video sequences, we use the frozen CLIP encoder to extract embeddings of video frames to align the text modality while retaining crucial visual information. Comprehensive experiments on two large-scale VAD datasets, XD-Violence and UCF-Crime, demonstrate that our method outperforms prior one-class and unsupervised VAD methods by a large margin.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TD-VAD方法，利用LLM生成的带时序特征的文本来训练视频异常检测模型，完全摆脱对目标域异常视频数据的依赖，在XD-Violence和UCF-Crime两个大规模数据集上大幅超越以往的一类分类和无监督VAD方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视频异常检测方法依赖大量标注的异常视频数据作为训练前提，但异常事件稀有且种类繁多，获取充足且可扩展的标注数据极其困难且成本高昂。相比之下，异常事件的文本描述易于收集且类别标签可直接获得，因此有必要探索以文本替代视频来训练VAD模型的可行性。
AI.method: 该方法利用LLM生成带有时间特性的视频似文本描述来训练VAD模型，不使用任何目标域异常数据。设计了事件演化因果注意力模块（event evolution causal attention module）来建模跨时间的上下文依赖，以捕捉事件的长程和短程时序逻辑。推理阶段，鉴于文本与视频序列之间的域差距，使用冻结的CLIP编码器提取视频帧嵌入以对齐文本模态，同时保留关键的视觉信息。
AI.result: 在两个大规模VAD数据集XD-Violence和UCF-Crime上的综合实验表明，该方法在性能上大幅超过先前的一类分类（one-class）和无监督（unsupervised）VAD方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文将视频异常检测的训练数据从视频模态拓展到文本模态，验证了文本驱动VAD的可行性和有效性，为缓解异常数据稀缺问题提供了新的思路。

title: VOLA: Improving Open-World Driving by VLM-Based Semantic Attribute Prediction
summary: Driving in the real world is open-world: a car may encounter a fallen mattress, a deer, or other objects outside its training data. Naming them is not enough. The system must know how to treat each region: can it drive over it, and how severe would a collision be? We therefore shift scene perception from category labels to dense action-relevant attributes, where each pixel is labeled by how it should affect motion rather than by object name. We instantiate this general formulation with two ordered attributes: 7-rank drivability and 5-rank vulnerability. We read Qwen3.5 image-token hidden states directly as a spatial semantic representation. A lightweight boundary-aware decoder then turns this coarse token grid into sharp full-resolution attribute maps. The whole process requires neither autoregressive text generation nor an external mask model such as SAM. We train on dense attribute labels built in CARLA and test transfer to real scenes and to novel obstacles never seen in training. We compare with vision-only segmenters trained on the same attributes and prompted VLM segmenters. Our model matches strong vision-only segmenters on familiar categories and improves transfer to real open-world anomalies, reaching 69.4% mean vulnerability-rank recall versus 57.1% for the best vision-only baseline and 53.9% for the best prompted VLM baseline. These results show that VLM image tokens provide useful semantic cues for transferring driving attributes to objects outside the training vocabulary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将场景感知从类别标签转向稠密的动作相关属性（可行驶性与脆弱性），利用VLM图像token的隐藏状态直接作为空间语义表征，通过轻量级边界感知解码器生成高分辨率属性图，无需自回归文本生成或外部掩码模型。在CARLA中训练并迁移至真实场景和未见过的障碍物，在脆弱性等级召回率上达到69.4%，优于纯视觉分割器和提示VLM分割器。
AI.motivation: 真实世界的驾驶是开放世界的，车辆可能遇到训练数据之外的物体（如掉落的床垫、鹿等）。仅对物体命名不够，系统必须知道每个区域应如何处理：能否驶过，碰撞严重程度如何。传统基于类别标签的场景感知无法应对开放世界中的未知物体。
AI.method: 将场景感知从类别标签重新定义为稠密动作相关属性，每个像素标注其对运动的影响而非物体名称。具体采用两个有序属性：7级可行驶性和5级脆弱性。直接读取Qwen3.5图像token的隐藏状态作为空间语义表征，用轻量级边界感知解码器将粗粒度token网格转换为高分辨率属性图。整个流程无需自回归文本生成或SAM等外部掩码模型。在CARLA中构建稠密属性标签进行训练。
AI.result: 在熟悉类别上匹配强视觉分割器；迁移到真实开放世界异常时，达到69.4%的平均脆弱性等级召回率，优于最佳纯视觉基线的57.1%和最佳提示VLM基线的53.9%。
AI.conclusion: VLM图像token能为驾驶属性向训练词汇之外的物体迁移提供有用的语义线索，验证了从类别标签转向动作相关属性表征这一范式的有效性。

title: UniSwap: Streaming Audio-Visual Identity Swapping for Talking Videos
summary: Talking-video character replacement requires coordinated transfer of appearance and voice while preserving the source motion, scene, linguistic content, and audio-video timing. Existing methods use separately optimized models for the two modalities, making audio-visual consistency difficult to enforce. We present UniSwap, the first framework for streaming joint audio-visual identity replacement in talking videos. Given a source video, a reference image, and a reference voice clip, UniSwap transfers the reference appearance and vocal timbre within a single audio-visual diffusion transformer while preserving the source content and dynamics. To address the scarcity of aligned cross-identity training pairs, we introduce a swap-and-reconstruct pipeline that removes visual and vocal identity from real clips and uses the original clips as reconstruction targets. Starting from a bidirectional backbone, we progressively adapt the model through In-context Pretraining for joint replacement, Conditional Streaming Adaptation for block-causal KV-cached generation, and Efficient Self-forcing DMD for mitigating exposure bias and reducing sampling from 30 to 3 denoising steps per block. Efficient Multi-LoRA Switching enables the three DMD roles to share a single frozen backbone. Feature-RoPE Decomposition keeps cached positions within the training range, supporting stable long-form inference. Experiments demonstrate strong audio-visual synchronization, competitive identity preservation, efficient streaming, and stable long-form generation.

AI.tldr: UniSwap是首个用于视频中流式联合音视频身份替换的框架，在单一音视频扩散Transformer中同时传递参考外观和声音音色，并通过swap-and-reconstruct管道及多项优化技术实现高效的流式生成和长序列稳定推理。
AI.motivation: 现有的说话视频身份替换方法对视觉和语音两个模态使用分别优化独立模型，导致音视频一致性难以保证。此外，跨身份对齐训练对的稀缺是联合训练的主要障碍。
AI.method: UniSwap引入了swap-and-reconstruct训练管道，从真实剪辑中移除视觉和声音身份并以原剪辑为重建目标；采用双向骨干网络，逐步通过内向预训练(In-context Pretraining)进行联合替换、条件流式适配(Conditional Streaming Adaptation)实现块因果KV缓存生成、高效自强制DMD(Efficient Self-forcing DMD)缓解曝光偏差并将每块去噪步数从30降至3；通过高效多LoRA切换(Efficient Multi-LoRA Switching)使三种DMD角色共享单一冻结骨干，特征RoPE分解(Feature-RoPE Decomposition)保持缓存位置在训练范围内以支持长序列推理。
AI.result: 实验表明UniSwap在音视频同步、身份保持、流式效率和长序列生成稳定性方面均表现优异。
AI.conclusion: UniSwap通过统一的音视频扩散Transformer架构和多项针对性的训练与推理优化，有效解决了说话视频中跨模态身份替换的协同问题，实现了高质量的流式联合音视频身份替换。

title: G0.5: One Autoregressive Stream for Robot Reasoning and Action
summary: The prevailing recipe for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models couples a pretrained VLM with a separately trained flow-matching action expert. This makes the VLM a context encoder rather than a decision-maker. We introduce G0.5, a pretrained autoregressive VLA in which a single transformer decoder emits reasoning and action tokens under a single objective. Three components make this tractable at foundation-model scale: a learnable cross-embodiment action tokenizer that maps heterogeneous robot actions into a shared vocabulary; a native chain-of-thought stream interleaving task decomposition, object grounding, and action hints with action tokens; and a visual memory module that injects multi-second history through the vision encoder. Because reasoning and action share a single set of weights, the pretrained VLM's capabilities carry over to physical behavior: the model follows instructions closely, and prompts directly steer action granularity, task horizon, and out-of-distribution scene handling without further training. Pretrained on a large collection of robot datasets together with VQA samples, G0.5 surpasses state-of-the-art models across 7 independent regimes: real-world fine-tuning on R1lite and R1pro robots (76.7\% vs.\ 53.3\% for $π_{0.5}$ and 24.4\% for GR00T-N1.7), the 2025 BEHAVIOR Challenge on 50 long-horizon household mobile manipulation tasks using a generalist policy (31.4\% vs.\ 26.3\% for $π_{0.5}$ and 26.1\% for the challenge winner), DROID post-training followed by zero-shot transfer to an unseen environment and objects (82.5\%), a language-following Pick-and-Place benchmark, LIBERO (98.9\%), RoboTwin 2.0 (93.3\%), and SimplerEnv-Bridge (87.3\%).

AI.tldr: G0.5是一种预训练的回归式视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，通过单一Transformer解码器在统一目标下同时生成推理与动作token，替代了传统的"预训练VLM+独立流匹配动作专家"架构，在7项独立基准上超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型通常将预训练VLM作为上下文编码器，动作生成由单独训练的动作专家完成，导致VLM并未真正参与决策。作者希望让VLM本身成为决策者，使预训练的语言能力直接迁移到物理行为控制。
AI.method: 提出三个关键组件：1）可学习的跨具身动作分词器（cross-embodiment action tokenizer），将异构机器人动作映射到共享词表；2）原生思维链流（native chain-of-thought stream），在动作token之间交织任务分解、目标接地与动作提示；3）视觉记忆模块（visual memory module），通过视觉编码器注入多秒历史信息。推理与动作共享同一套权重，在机器人数据集与VQA样本上联合预训练。
AI.result: 在7个独立任务上全面超越SOTA：R1lite/R1pro真实微调76.7%（对比π0.5的53.3%与GR00T-N1.7的24.4%）、2025 BEHAVIOR挑战31.4%（对比26.3%/26.1%）、DROID后训练零样本迁移82.5%、LIBERO 98.9%、RoboTwin 2.0 93.3%、SimplerEnv-Bridge 87.3%。提示可直接控制动作粒度、任务时域与OOD场景处理，无需额外训练。
AI.conclusion: G0.5证明了让VLM在单一目标下同时承担推理与动作生成的可行性，预训练VLM的语言推理能力可以有效迁移到物理决策中，且通过提示即可适应不同任务需求，为构建真正的端到端具身智能决策模型提供了新范式。

title: High-dimensional Multi-objective Bayesian Optimization with Learned Variable Interactions
summary: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) is effective in identifying the Pareto fronts for expensive black-box problems. However, most current MOBO approaches are limited to low-dimensional decision space due to its exponential sampling complexity. This paper presents decision variable interaction analysis-based MOBO, ViaMOBO, a generic framework for expensive multi-objective problems with high-dimensional decision space. The key idea of ViaMOBO is that it utilizes a variable interaction analysis model to determine whether the decision space can be completely or partially divided, and then performs local Bayesian optimization in the divided decision subspaces. Through the variable analysis model, it can be derived whether the objectives in black-box problems are separable, partially separable, or non-separable based on the potential independent or interdependent relationships among decision variables without any strong assumptions. We compare ViaMOBO with the state-of-the-art MOBO methods on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks. The experimental results demonstrate that ViaMOBO outperforms other related MOBO baselines in approximating the Pareto front of high-dimensional expensive multi-objective problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ViaMOBO，一个基于决策变量交互分析的多目标贝叶斯优化框架，用于解决高维昂贵黑箱多目标优化问题。该框架通过变量交互分析模型判断决策空间是否可完全或部分分解，并在分解后的子空间中进行局部贝叶斯优化，从而克服传统MOBO在高维空间中的指数级采样复杂度问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的大多数多目标贝叶斯优化（MOBO）方法受限于低维决策空间，因为其采样复杂度随维度呈指数增长。高维昂贵黑箱多目标问题的优化需要一种能够处理高维决策空间的新方法。
AI.method: ViaMOBO的核心思想是：首先利用变量交互分析模型判断决策空间是否可以完全或部分分解；然后根据分析结果确定目标函数是可分离、部分可分离还是不可分离的；最后在分解后的决策子空间中执行局部贝叶斯优化。该方法不需要对问题做任何强假设，而是基于决策变量之间的潜在独立或相互依赖关系来自动推导目标函数的可分性结构。
AI.result: 在合成基准和真实世界基准上，将ViaMOBO与最先进的MOBO方法进行了比较。实验结果表明，ViaMOBO在逼近高维昂贵多目标问题的Pareto前沿方面优于其他相关MOBO基线方法。
AI.conclusion: ViaMOBO通过变量交互分析实现决策空间的分解，有效解决了高维场景下MOBO的维度灾难问题，在Pareto前沿逼近质量上优于现有方法，为高维昂贵多目标优化提供了通用且有效的解决方案。

title: STAR: A Spatial-Topology Aware Routing Framework for Generalizable 3D Scene Understanding
comment: The third author is the corresponding author
summary: Constructing a unified 3D scene understanding model has long been hindered by the topological discrepancies across sensor modalities. While applying the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture is a flexible approach for multi-domain 3D understanding, we observe that conventional feature-only MoE routers may underrepresent local sampling topology under semantic supervision, making expert allocation difficult when semantic consistency coexists with geometric heterogeneity. To overcome this challenge, we propose STAR (Spatial-Topology Aware Routing Framework). Specifically, we introduce a multi-attribute self-supervised pre-training branch, covering topological and textural variations, to anchor cross-domain structural priors. Building upon this, we design a domain-aware expert branch with two mechanisms: Domain-Spatial-Guided Routing (DSR), which captures local topological variations from spatial context, and Entropy-controlled Dynamic Allocation (EDA), which adjusts the number of activated experts according to routing uncertainty. Together, these branches combine stable cross-domain representation learning with adaptive expert allocation. Extensive experiments across various tasks, encompassing both indoor and outdoor scenes, demonstrate the effectiveness of STAR. It achieves 80.1% mIoU on the ScanNet validation set and 77.2% mIoU on S3DIS, consistently improving over strong baselines. Code is available at our project page (https://xmw666.github.io/STAR/).

AI.tldr: 提出STAR（空间-拓扑感知路由框架），一种统一3D场景理解模型，通过多属性自监督预训练分支锚定跨域结构先验，并设计域感知专家分支（包含DSR路由机制和EDA动态分配机制），解决多模态3D理解中MoE架构下特征路由无法表征局部采样拓扑的问题。在ScanNet和S3DIS上分别达到80.1%和77.2% mIoU。
AI.motivation: 统一3D场景理解模型长期受限于不同传感器模态间的拓扑差异。虽然MoE架构是处理多域3D理解灵活方案，但传统仅基于特征的路由器在语义监督下可能无法充分表征局部采样拓扑，导致在语义一致性与几何异质性并存时专家分配困难。
AI.method: STAR包含两个核心分支：(1) 多属性自监督预训练分支，覆盖拓扑和纹理变化，用于锚定跨域结构先验；(2) 域感知专家分支，包含两种机制——Domain-Spatial-Guided Routing (DSR)从空间上下文捕获局部拓扑变化，以及Entropy-controlled Dynamic Allocation (EDA)根据路由不确定性动态调整激活专家数量。
AI.result: 在多种任务和室内外场景上的大量实验验证了STAR的有效性。在ScanNet验证集上达到80.1% mIoU，在S3DIS上达到77.2% mIoU，均优于强基线。
AI.conclusion: STAR通过将稳定的跨域表示学习与自适应的专家分配相结合，有效解决了多模态3D场景理解中拓扑差异带来的挑战，并在室内外场景中取得显著性能提升。

title: HUGIN: Enhancing Vision-Language Planning for Autonomous Logistics Sorting
summary: Autonomous logistics sorting systems (ALSS) are an important industrial application of embodied AI, which requires joint planning over spatially disjoint camera views. We formulate this setting as Joint Multi-Scene Understanding (JMSU). With open-world visual understanding and task-planning capabilities, vision-language models (VLMs) are promising candidates for JMSU. However, directly applying existing VLMs to JMSU is non-trivial due to scarce cross-scene supervision and attention dispersion caused by long visual context in JMSU. To address these challenges, we propose HUGIN, a training framework with two complementary components. Endogenous Data Augmentation recombines verified atomic facts under operating constraints, while Global Context Ranking aligns the instruction representation more strongly with the complete visual context than with a partial visual context. To support ongoing research, we construct a high-quality industrial sorting dataset and benchmark named SortingBench from four layouts of autonomous logistics sorting systems. Across five open VLMs, HUGIN consistently outperforms matched baselines; for example, the accuracy on SortingBench of Qwen3-VL-8B increases from 63.6% to 78.8%. Additional experiments verify the effectiveness of each component and JMSU's spillover benefits in embodied tasks. Deployment tests involving more than 15,000 packages support the practical viability of VLM-based planning for autonomous logistics sorting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HUGIN训练框架以应对自主物流分拣系统(JMSU)中跨场景视觉理解与任务规划的挑战，通过内源数据增强和全局上下文排序两大组件提升VLM性能，并在自主构建的SortingBench基准上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 自主物流分拣系统(ALSS)是具身AI的重要工业应用，需要跨多个空间分离的摄像机视角进行联合规划。现有VLM直接应用于此面临两个核心挑战：跨场景监督信号稀缺，以及长视觉上下文导致的注意力分散。因此需要一个专门的训练框架来解决这些问题。
AI.method: 提出HUGIN训练框架，包含两个互补组件：(1) 内源数据增强(Endogenous Data Augmentation)——在操作约束下重组已验证的原子事实生成训练数据；(2) 全局上下文排序(Global Context Ranking)——使指令表征与完整视觉上下文的对齐强于与部分视觉上下文的对齐。此外构建了SortingBench数据集，覆盖四种自主物流分拣系统布局。
AI.result: 在五个开源VLM上，HUGIN一致优于匹配的基线。例如Qwen3-VL-8B在SortingBench上的准确率从63.6%提升至78.8%。消融实验验证了各组件的有效性，JMSU在具身任务中展现出溢出效益。超过15000个包裹的部署测试支持了基于VLM规划的实际可行性。
AI.conclusion: HUGIN框架有效解决了JMSU场景下VLM应用的两大难题，通过数据增强与上下文对齐机制显著提升了多场景联合理解与规划能力，并经大规模部署验证了其在工业自主物流分拣系统中的实用价值。

title: AgenticTwin: An Agentic LLM Framework Integrated with Digital Twin for Anomaly Detection
summary: Digital twins are increasingly used to monitor and simulate the behavior of cyber-physical systems. Even with skilled operators, interpreting anomalies detected within digital twin pipelines is challenging, as the sheer complexity and volume of raw sensor data make thorough analysis difficult. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) offer promising capabilities for reasoning and explanation, yet their integration into digital twin-driven anomaly analysis remains underexplored. In this work, we propose AgenticTwin, an agentic framework that integrates LLM-driven reasoning with a digital twin-based anomaly detection pipeline. The framework grounds LLM-generated explanations in outputs from a digital twin-driven anomaly classifier and enables human operators to ask relevant natural-language questions about the system. Beyond the framework itself, we introduce a benchmark-oriented evaluation pipeline constructed over synthetic anomalies injected into a real-world weather sensor dataset, enabling controlled generation of operator queries over anomaly events. We further evaluate the feasibility of deploying lightweight, open-source LLMs for practical cyber-physical environments. Experimental results demonstrate that structured agent collaboration and knowledge-grounded reasoning improve diagnosis quality, contextual retrieval, and mitigation quality across diverse possible anomaly scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgenticTwin，一个将LLM驱动的推理与基于数字孪生的异常检测流水线相结合的智能体框架，使操作员能够通过自然语言查询理解复杂系统中的异常。作者还在真实天气传感器数据上构建了基准评估流水线，并通过实验证明结构化智能体协作和知识接地推理能提升诊断质量、上下文检索和缓解质量。
AI.motivation: 数字孪生虽广泛用于监控信息物理系统，但即使由熟练操作员操作，解释数字孪生流水线中检测到的异常仍然极具挑战性，因为原始传感器数据的复杂性和体量使得深入分析困难。尽管LLM在推理和解释方面展现出潜力，但其在数字孪生驱动的异常分析中的集成尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: (1) 提出AgenticTwin，一个集成LLM推理与数字孪生异常检测流水线的智能体框架，将LLM生成的解释锚定在数字孪生驱动异常分类器的输出上，并支持操作员以自然语言提问。(2) 构建基于基准的评估流水线，在真实世界天气传感器数据上注入合成异常，实现异常事件上操作员查询的受控生成。(3) 评估在实际信息物理环境中部署轻量级、开源LLM的可行性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，结构化智能体协作与知识接地推理在不同可能异常场景下均能改善诊断质量、上下文检索效果以及缓解质量。
AI.conclusion: AgenticTwin证明了LLM驱动的智能体框架可以有效集成到数字孪生异常检测流程中，通过知识接地和智能体协作提升异常诊断与缓解能力，且轻量级开源LLM具备在该类实际环境中部署的可行性。

title: Is Per-Agent Policy Composition Safe? Rethinking Successor-Feature Transfer in Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Many reinforcement learning systems, from fleet management to traffic signal control, must serve an objective that changes dynamically after deployment, and retraining a policy for each new objective is prohibitively expensive. For a single agent, this problem is well understood: successor features with generalized policy improvement, together with their universal extension, recombine a library of learned policies into a policy for any new objective, with a guarantee that the result is never worse than any policy in the library. However, multi-agent transfer has received far less attention, and the common practice of letting each agent recombine its own library independently inherits the recipe but not the guarantee. We prove that this independent composition can produce joint behavior strictly worse than every policy in the library, because recombining teammates changes the environment each agent faces and invalidates the values it relies on, a failure with no single-agent counterpart. We further show that the only unconditionally safe fixed rule is synchronized composition, which moves the whole team to one jointly trained policy but cannot serve objectives that assign different goals to different agents. To attain safety and flexibility at once, we propose MA-USFA, a hierarchical method with two layers: a lower layer of universal successor feature approximators that predicts each agent's successor features while conditioned on its teammates' objectives, and an upper composer that selects, across agents, which library entry each agent should follow and supplies the cross-agent correction a per-agent value cannot represent. Trained once over the distribution of objectives, it is applied at deployment with no per-task adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多智能体强化学习中目标动态变化后的策略迁移问题，证明了独立逐智能体重组策略库会产生比库中所有策略都更差的联合行为，提出MA-USFA分层方法，通过下层通用后继特征逼近器与上层组合器实现安全且灵活的多目标部署。
AI.motivation: 许多强化学习系统（如车队管理、交通信号控制）在部署后目标会动态变化，而针对每个新目标重新训练策略成本过高。单智能体场景下，后继特征与广义策略改进（含通用扩展）已有成熟方案及性能保证；但多智能体迁移问题研究不足，常见的各智能体独立重组自有策略库的做法虽沿用了配方却丢失了保证。
AI.method: （1）理论层面：证明独立组合由于重组队友会改变每个智能体面对的环境、破坏其依赖的价值函数，可能产生严格劣于库中所有策略的联合行为（该失败在单智能体中没有对应情况）；并证明唯一无条件安全的固定规则是同步组合，但它无法服务给不同智能体分配不同目标的场景。（2）算法层面：提出MA-USFA分层方法，下层为通用后继特征逼近器，在条件于队友目标的条件下预测每个智能体的后继特征；上层为组合器，跨智能体选择每个智能体应遵循的库条目，并提供单智能体价值无法表示的跨智能体修正。训练一次后可直接部署，无需逐任务适配。
AI.result: 论文从理论上揭示了多智能体独立策略库重组的安全失效机理，论证了同步组合的唯一安全性及其灵活性局限，并提出MA-USFA方法兼顾安全性与灵活性，可一次训练、直接部署于动态目标场景。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体目标迁移需要在安全与灵活之间取得平衡：同步组合安全但只能服务统一目标，独立组合灵活但可能失效。MA-USFA通过分层架构（下层后继特征预测+上层跨智能体组合与修正）同时实现了安全性和对不同智能体目标的灵活支持，且无需部署后重新训练。

title: A Frequency-Space Terahertz Transceiver Chip for Multi-Agent Communications and Spatial Awareness
summary: Future indoor embodied-intelligence systems require scalable hardware platforms that support both high-capacity multi-agent connectivity and mutual spatial awareness. The terahertz (THz) spectrum offers abundant bandwidth and inherent spatial selectivity for integrated sensing and communication (ISAC); however, conventional phased arrays and programmable metasurfaces rely on dense beamforming networks, element-level control, or external THz illumination, making scalable multibeam operation challenging. Here, we report a fully integrated 208-258GHz 65-nm CMOS THz transceiver chip that monolithically integrates broadband front ends with heterogeneous leaky-wave metasurface (HLM) apertures within a 1.5mm by 4.9mm area. The HLM generates strongly dispersive leaky modes, enabling 75 degree frequency-controlled beam scanning with only four meta-atoms. Co-design of frequency-domain and spatial-domain mixing achieves spectrally clean frequency-to-space mapping for spatial-frequency division multiple access (SFDMA) communication. The THz chip demonstrates multi-agent simultaneous transmission and reception, two-dimensional localization, and sensing-enhanced communication, providing a scalable hardware platform for future THz embodied-intelligence networks.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一款208-258GHz、65nm CMOS工艺的全集成太赫兹收发芯片，在1.5mm×4.9mm面积内单片集成宽带前端与异构漏波超表面（HLM）孔径，仅用四个超原子即可实现75°频率控制的波束扫描，并通过频域与空域混频的协同设计实现频谱纯净的频率-空间映射，支持空分频分多址（SFDMA）通信，展示了多智能体同时收发、二维定位及感知增强通信能力，为未来太赫兹具身智能网络提供了可扩展硬件平台。
AI.motivation: 室内具身智能系统需要同时支持大容量多智能体连接和相互空间感知的可扩展硬件平台。太赫兹频谱虽然具有丰富的带宽和固有的空间选择性，但传统的相控阵和可编程超表面依赖密集波束赋形网络、单元级控制或外部太赫兹照明，使得可扩展多波束操作面临严峻挑战。
AI.method: 该芯片采用65nm CMOS工艺，单片集成宽带射频前端与异构漏波超表面（HLM）孔径。HLM产生强色散的漏波模式，仅用四个超原子即可实现75°的频率控制波束扫描。通过频域与空域混合的协同设计，实现频谱纯净的频率-空间映射，进而支持SFDMA通信。
AI.result: 芯片在208-258GHz频段工作，单片面积仅1.5mm×4.9mm。实现了75°频率控制波束扫描、多智能体同时收发、二维定位以及感知增强通信等多功能演示。
AI.conclusion: 该太赫兹芯片为未来太赫兹具身智能网络提供了一种可扩展的硬件平台，克服了传统波束成形方案在可扩展多波束操作上的瓶颈，融合了通信与感知能力。

title: Towards Terabit/$λ$/s Multidimensional Silicon Photonic Engine
summary: Increasing artificial intelligence (AI) workloads drive co-packaged optics (CPO), which integrates optical engines with electronic components. Optical interconnects can extend transmission distances and reduce latency, allowing distributed clusters in AI factories to operate as a unified computational unit. However, escalating data throughput necessitates greater parallelization of light within ultracompact form factors while maintaining stringent energy efficiency and latency constraints. Here, we present a multidimensional silicon photonic engine that achieves a communication capacity exceeding 1.8 terabit/s/lambda/s. By monolithically integrating transceivers, spatial and polarization (de)multiplexers, and optical signal processors on a single chip, we eliminate bulky discrete (de)multiplexers and power-hungry digital signal processing (DSP). In experiments, the photonic engine can be self-configured to identify two, four, or six concurrent spatial and polarization channels per fiber while mitigating dynamic channel crosstalk. Compared with the state-of-art DSP, our approach achieves >5,000-fold reductions in both power consumption and processing latency at a MIMO processing order of six. Furthermore, we demonstrate full-duplex, modulation-format-transparent inter-chip communication over 300-meter fiber. These results represent a paradigm shift for optical engines in future high-performance computing and AI-driven data centers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多维硅光子引擎，通过单片集成收发器、空间与偏振（解）复用器及光信号处理器，实现超过1.8 Tbit/s/λ/s的通信容量，免除了体积庞大的分立（解）复用器和功耗高的DSP，相对DSP在功耗和处理时延上实现超5000倍降低，并演示了300米光纤上的全双工、调制格式透明芯片间通信。
AI.motivation: AI工作负载激增推动共封装光学（CPO）发展，需要光学互连在超紧凑形态因子内实现更高的光并行度，同时保持严格的能效和时延约束。传统方案依赖庞大的分立（解）复用器和功耗高的DSP，难以满足AI工厂扩展需求。
AI.method: 提出一种多维硅光子引擎，在单片上集成收发器、空间与偏振（解）复用器和光信号处理器，替代分立（解）复用器与数字信号处理（DSP）。该引擎可自配置识别每根光纤上2、4或6个并发空间/偏振通道，并缓解动态通道串扰。实验在MIMO处理阶数为6时，与最先进DSP相比，实现功耗和处理时延均降低超过5000倍。
AI.result: 该光子引擎实现超过1.8 Tbit/s/λ/s的通信容量；相比DSP在MIMO阶数6时功耗和处理时延均降低超5000倍；演示了300米光纤上的全双工、调制格式透明芯片间通信。
AI.conclusion: 该工作代表了未来高性能计算和AI数据中心光学引擎的范式转变，展示了全光多维复用处理替代电子DSP的巨大潜力。

title: CLAIM: Leading Open-domain Active Clarification of Large Language Models with Uncertainty Measurement
summary: In open-domain human-computer interaction scenarios, large language models (LLMs) frequently encounter user queries that are ambiguous or incomplete. In such cases, directly producing an answer often leads to overgeneralized, erroneous, or low-information responses. In contrast, asking clarifying questions can substantially improve interaction quality. However, existing approaches still rely heavily on manually annotated data or preference alignment to address two fundamental challenges: when clarification is necessary, and which aspect of the query should be clarified. This reliance incurs high annotation costs and limits generalization. To address these challenges, we propose CLAIM, an uncertainty-driven framework for active clarification learning in open-domain settings. CLAIM eliminates the need for explicit human preference annotations by quantifying query uncertainty through the entropy induced by answer disagreements across multiple models. This uncertainty signal is then used to construct high-quality synthetic data, enabling the training of a unified clarification decision model through a combination of supervised learning and reinforcement learning. Specifically, we propose an entropy-driven synthetic data generation pipeline that integrates entropy-based uncertainty estimation with semantic clustering and reasoning-based judgments, enabling reliable automatic annotation of clarification requirements. To train CLAIM, we formulate the clarification process as a structured decision generation problem and adopt a training paradigm that combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO). Experimental results demonstrate that CLAIM can learn stable and generalizable clarification strategies without relying on manually labeled data, offering a low-cost and robust solution for proactive understanding in real-world open-domain interactions with LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出了CLAIM框架，一种不确定性驱动的主动澄清学习框架，通过量化查询的不确定性（基于多模型答案分歧的熵）自动生成高质量合成数据，无需人工偏好标注，结合监督学习和强化学习训练统一的澄清决策模型，在开放域人机交互场景中实现低成本、稳健的澄清策略。
AI.motivation: 开放域人机交互中，LLM常遇到模糊或不完整的用户查询，直接回答会产生过度泛化、错误或低信息量的响应，而提出澄清问题能显著提升交互质量。但现有方法依赖人工标注数据或偏好对齐来解决两个核心挑战（何时需要澄清、澄清哪个方面），标注成本高且泛化能力受限。
AI.method: CLAIM通过多模型答案分歧计算熵来量化查询不确定性，消除对显式人工偏好标注的依赖；提出熵驱动的合成数据生成管线，结合熵不确定性估计、语义聚类和基于推理的判断实现自动标注；将澄清过程建模为结构化决策生成问题，采用SFT与GRPO相结合的混合训练范式。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，CLAIM无需依赖人工标注数据即可学习稳定且可泛化的澄清策略，为开放域LLM交互中的主动理解提供了低成本且鲁棒的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: CLAIM验证了不确定性驱动的方法可以替代人工标注来实现主动澄清学习，有效解决澄清的时机选择和方面选择两大挑战，在降低成本的同时保证策略的稳定性和泛化性，为真实开放域场景中的LLM交互提供了实用且可扩展的框架。

title: MBA: Multimodal Benchmark and Agents for Real-World Business Ideation
summary: Agentic systems powered by large language models (LLMs) have opened new opportunities for business ideation. Yet existing approaches remain confined to a text-only paradigm, despite the inherently multimodal nature of real-world contexts. We thus introduce MBA-Bench, the first multimodal benchmark for training and evaluating business ideation agents, comprising 30K samples across six domains, each domain characterized by distinct visual cues not fully conveyed by text alone. Concretely, we automatically caption images and employ GPT-4o to generate five reference ideas for each of three business questions through retrieval query generation, market evidence retrieval, and evidence-augmented synthesis. Following prior work, we evaluate agents across six business-oriented criteria using MLLM-as-a-Judge. To consider settings where criteria are hidden or disclosed, we present MBA-b and MBA-k for blind and known, respectively. We train both with two novel reward objectives---creativity and feasibility---while MBA-k further optimizes the six disclosed criteria for eight in total. Both are trained via LoRA-based supervised fine-tuning followed by group relative policy optimization with these setting-specific rewards. For extensive experiments on MBA-Bench, we set up two baselines accommodating either captions only or multimodal inputs, with the latter nearing closed-source performance on several metrics. MBA-b and MBA-k outperform caption baselines by 63.9% and 77.1%, and multimodal baselines by 25.6% and 35.8%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MBA-Bench，这是首个用于训练和评估商业创意智能体（business ideation agents）的多模态基准，包含30K样本、六个领域。作者还提出了两个经LoRA-SFT和GRPO训练的智能体MBA-b（盲评）和MBA-k（已知标准），分别通过创造性与可行性奖励优化，在评测中大幅超越纯文本和多模态基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于大语言模型的智能体系统在商业创意生成方面仍局限在纯文本范式，而真实世界场景本质上是多模态的（包含视觉线索），文本无法完整传达这些信息。因此需要一个多模态基准来更好地训练和评估商业创意智能体。
AI.method: （1）构建MBA-Bench：自动为图像生成标题，用GPT-4o通过检索查询生成、市场证据检索和证据增强合成三步生成每个商业问题的5个参考创意。（2）提出两个智能体：MBA-b（评判标准对智能体隐藏）和MBA-k（标准已知），分别用创造性和可行性两个奖励目标训练，MBA-k额外优化六个披露标准共八个目标。（3）训练流程：LoRA监督微调 + 分组相对策略优化（GRPO）及设定特定的奖励函数。（4）评估：使用MLLM-as-a-Judge按六个商业导向标准评测。
AI.result: MBA-b和MBA-k相比纯文本标题基线分别提升63.9%和77.1%，相比多模态基线分别提升25.6%和35.8%；多模态基线在某些指标上接近闭源模型表现。
AI.conclusion: 多模态信息对商业创意生成至关重要，通过针对性的奖励设计和策略优化，专用智能体在商业创意任务上显著超越通用基线，验证了多模态基准和任务定制训练的有效性。

title: Topology-Aware Query Selection for Surgical Instrument Instance Segmentation
comment: Preprint. Main manuscript and supplementary material included. Code and reproducibility materials: https://github.com/yqjyzzz/structured-instance-set-selection
summary: Accurate foreground masks can still form an incorrect surgical-instrument instance set: duplicate, fragmented, merged, missed, or empty-frame predictions may preserve favorable pixel overlap while violating object identity and count. Final query selection is therefore a relational, variable-cardinality problem rather than a collection of independent candidate decisions. We evaluate topology-aware query selection, which represents the nonempty candidates of a fixed Mask2Former as a complete graph, learns relational candidate and pair representations, predicts set cardinality, and solves an exact structured subset problem. The formal comparison is the complete relational path versus a node-feature-matched path; it evaluates the combined effect of pairwise geometry, message passing, and the additional relational-path capacity, not an isolated component. On the sealed 22-case source test, all three discovery seeds supported instance-set performance improvement with segmentation fidelity and predefined technical-safety preservation: instance F1 increased by 0.0504--0.0612 and positive-frame set-failure rate decreased by 0.0848--0.1060. Direct ROBUST-MIPS transfer reproduced the complete result in all three seeds. Endoscapes supported only one of three seeds and therefore did not establish stable direct transfer. Taken together, the results support a bounded conclusion: the evaluated complete path improved coherent instance-set construction from fixed Mask2Former candidates in specified native-instance contracts, while stable cross-domain transfer and component-specific effects remain unestablished.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将最终前景掩码的查询选择视为关系性、可变基数的集合问题，而非独立候选决策。作者将固定Mask2Former的非空候选构建为完整图，学习关系型候选与配对表示，预测集合基数，并求解精确的结构化子集问题。在封闭的22例源测试中，三种发现种子均提升了实例集性能（实例F1提升0.0504–0.0612，正帧集合失败率降低0.0848–0.1060），ROBUST-MIPS直接迁移完全复现了结果，但Endoscapes仅支持三种种子之一，跨域稳定迁移未获确立。
AI.motivation: 高精度的前景掩码仍可能产生错误的器械实例集合（重复、碎片化、合并、遗漏或空帧预测），这些错误在保持良好像素重叠的同时违反对象身份和计数约束。最终查询选择本质上是关系性、可变基数的集合问题，而非独立候选决策的简单堆叠，这促使作者探索拓扑感知的查询选择方法。
AI.method: 将固定Mask2Former的非空候选表示为完整图，学习关系型候选表示和配对表示，预测集合基数，并求解精确的结构化子集问题。形式比较是完整关系路径与节点特征匹配路径之间的对比，评估成对几何、消息传递及关系路径容量的综合效应。
AI.result: 在封闭的22例源测试上，三种发现种子均支持实例集性能提升，同时保持分割保真度和预定义技术安全性：实例F1提升0.0504–0.0612，正帧集合失败率降低0.0848–0.1060。ROBUST-MIPS直接迁移在三种种子中完全复现结果；Endoscapes仅支持三种种子之一，未建立稳定的直接迁移。
AI.conclusion: 该完整路径在特定原生实例契约下，从固定Mask2Former候选中改善了连贯实例集合的构建；但跨域稳定迁移及各组件的独立效应尚未确立，因此结论是有限的。

title: Foresight Without Seeing: Latent Futures for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) couple future visual prediction with robot action generation, enabling policies to model how the physical world evolves during interaction. Existing WAMs differ in how predictive dynamics are exposed to the action pathway. Explicit-future WAMs provide direct access to predicted scene evolution, but incur substantial inference costs from iterative video denoising. In contrast, direct-policy WAMs efficiently predict actions from the current observation but lack an explicit inference-time interface for exposing predictive dynamics to the Action DiT. To bridge this gap, we propose ForeWAM, a dynamics-conditioned direct-policy WAM that provides predictive context for action generation without decoding future videos. At its core, Future-KV performs a single Video DiT prefill over the current visual latent and stochastic future slots, and reuses the resulting layer-wise key-value states throughout action denoising. We further introduce dynamics registers supervised by a frozen latent action teacher, encouraging the implicit future states to capture interaction-induced transitions such as object motion, contact changes, and task progress. Ground-truth future observations and the teacher are used only during training; deployment requires neither and performs no future video generation. Without embodied robot data pretraining, the standard and accelerated variants of ForeWAM achieve average success rates of 96.7% and 96.9% on LIBERO, respectively. The standard variant further achieves 61.6% success on LIBERO-Plus. These results demonstrate that direct-policy WAMs can retain efficient action prediction while exposing predictive dynamics to the action pathway without explicitly generating future observations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ForeWAM，一种动力学条件的直接策略世界行动模型（WAM），通过Future-KV机制在不解码未来视频的情况下，将预测性动力学上下文暴露给Action DiT，实现高效的动作生成，在LIBERO基准上达到96.7%/96.9%（标准/加速变体）的平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有世界行动模型在预测动力学暴露方式上存在权衡：显式未来WAM虽能提供直接的场景演变预测，但迭代视频去噪带来高昂推理成本；而直接策略WAM虽然动作预测高效，但缺乏显式推理时接口来将预测动力学暴露给Action DiT。作者旨在弥合这一差距，在保持动作生成效率的同时仍能为动作路径提供预测性动力学上下文。
AI.method: ForeWAM的核心是Future-KV机制：对当前视觉潜变量和随机未来槽执行单次Video DiT预填充，并在整个动作去噪过程中复用得到的逐层键值状态。同时引入由冻结的潜在动作教师监督的动力学寄存器，促使隐式未来状态捕获交互引发的转变（如物体运动、接触变化和任务进度）。真值未来观测和教师仅在训练阶段使用，部署时无需两者且不生成未来视频。
AI.result: 无需具身机器人数据预训练，ForeWAM标准变体和加速变体在LIBERO上分别达到96.7%和96.9%的平均成功率；标准变体在LIBERO-Plus上取得61.6%的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 直接策略WAM可以在保持高效动作预测的同时，将预测性动力学暴露给动作路径，而无需显式生成未来观测，从而弥合了高效推理与动力学可解释性之间的鸿沟。

title: Learning from Online User Feedback for Shopping Agents
summary: Large language model-based shopping agents are increasingly deployed in real-world e-commerce platforms, generating massive amounts of user interaction logs that provide valuable supervision for improving these agents. However, existing approaches primarily rely on offline training signals, such as user-item interactions or synthetic preference data, while largely overlooking the rich supervision contained in users' natural conversational feedback. Moreover, the available online feedback is heterogeneous, sparse, and noisy, making it difficult to transform into reliable learning signals automatically. To address these challenges, we propose LOFA, a framework that enables shopping agents to learn directly from real online interaction logs without human annotation. LOFA combines reinforcement learning over verifiable purchase outcomes with feedback-aware on-policy distillation, which identifies users'in-dialogue directives and converts them into dense token-level supervision. These complementary objectives capture both collaborative behavioral patterns and user-specific preferences. Extensive experiments on real-world e-commerce logs demonstrate that LOFA consistently improves recommendation quality, response helpfulness, and user-satisfaction alignment over strong baselines, highlighting the effectiveness of learning shopping agents from real online user feedback.

AI.tldr: LOFA是一个从真实在线电商交互日志中学习购物代理的框架，结合基于可验证购买结果的强化学习与反馈感知的在线蒸馏，无需人工标注即可将用户对话反馈转化为密集的token级监督信号，显著提升推荐质量和用户满意度。
AI.motivation: 现有购物代理的训练主要依赖离线信号（如用户-商品交互或合成偏好数据），忽视了用户自然对话反馈中蕴含的丰富监督信息。同时在线反馈具有异质性、稀疏性和噪声大的特点，难以自动转化为可靠的学习信号。这两方面挑战促使了LOFA的提出。
AI.method: LOFA包含两个互补的训练目标：(1) 基于可验证购买结果的强化学习，捕获协作行为模式；(2) 反馈感知的在线蒸馏，识别用户对话中的指令并将其转换为密集的token级监督，捕捉用户特定偏好。
AI.result: 在真实电商日志上的大量实验表明，LOFA在推荐质量、响应帮助性和用户满意度对齐方面均一致性地优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: LOFA证实了从真实在线用户反馈中学习购物代理的有效性，为无需人工标注即可利用在线交互日志改进购物代理提供了可行的框架。

title: How Can Driving World Models Do Counterfactual Prediction?
summary: Driving world models are often interpreted as counterfactual simulators for observed driving episodes: given a factual driving log, they are asked what would have happened under an alternative ego action. In this paper, we identify a fundamental mismatch between this goal and direct action-conditioned prediction. The direct prediction uses the shared history and the alternative action but not the factual continuation observed after that history. It can therefore generate a plausible future without preserving what actually happened in this episode. We formalize this gap using the causal recipe of abduction, action, and prediction and study it in a setting with a short time horizon, where the alternative ego action does not alter how surrounding agents evolve. To make the gap measurable, we construct a controlled simulation benchmark with factual outcomes and matched counterfactual outcomes. Across two representative world models, direct predictions fail to match the counterfactual ground truth, supporting our analysis. As a constructive check of this analysis, we introduce a deliberately simple, training-free pipeline that moves observed evidence into the counterfactual view and lets the frozen model complete what remains unknown. Even this simple construction raises the overall recovered fraction substantially and reduces perceptual distance to the matched counterfactual on both models. We hope this work draws attention to this gap and motivates better counterfactual prediction methods for driving world models.

AI.tldr: 本文指出驾驶世界模型作为反事实模拟器时存在根本性缺陷：直接动作条件预测只利用共享历史和替代动作，忽略了事实后续延续，因此无法保证生成的反事实结果与真实发生的驾驶事件一致。作者通过因果"溯因-动作-预测"框架形式化这一差距，构建受控仿真基准进行量化验证，并提出一个训练自由的简单管线（将观测证据移入反事实视角，让冻结模型补全未知部分），显著提升了反事实恢复率和感知一致性。
AI.motivation: 驾驶世界模型的核心应用场景是对给定驾驶日志进行反事实推演（即"如果将来的动作不同会怎样"），但研究者发现直接的动作条件预测与这一目标存在根本性不匹配——预测器只看到共享历史和替代动作，没有用到事实段落在历史之后实际发生的延续，因此可能生成看似合理但并未发生在该具体驾驶事件中的未来。这一差距从未被系统形式化和量化，作者希望揭示并推动更好的反事实预测方法。
AI.method: 1) 使用因果"溯因-动作-预测"（abduction-action-prediction）框架形式化直接预测与正确反事实推断之间的差距；2) 在短时间窗口设定下（替代 ego 动作不影响周围智能体演化）构造受控仿真基准，包含事实结果和匹配的反事实结果；3) 在两个代表性世界模型上进行评估，验证直接预测无法匹配反事实基准；4) 提出一个训练自由的简单管线：将观测证据迁移到反事实视角，再让冻结模型补全剩余未知部分，作为建设性的验证。
AI.result: 在两个代表性世界模型上，直接动作条件预测均未能匹配反事实地面真值，证实了作者的分析。即使采用该简单且训练自由的管线（将观测证据移入反事实视图），也能在两个模型上显著提高整体恢复比例并降低与匹配反事实之间的感知距离。
AI.conclusion: 直接动作条件预测无法真正实现驾驶世界模型的反事实模拟目标，需要专门关注反事实推断的建模改进；本文的证据迁移式简单管线表明即使不重训模型也能显著改善反事实一致性，希望以此激励更好的反事实预测方法。

title: Video2Track: From Real-World Interaction Videos to Steerable Adversarial Closed-Track Testing for Automated Driving Systems
summary: Closed-track testing plays a fundamental role in the verification and validation of automated driving systems (ADS), particularly for safety-critical scenarios, by enabling reproducible evaluation under controlled conditions. However, most existing approaches still rely on standardized protocols or predefined trajectories, leading to overly scripted interactions and limited ability to reproduce the natural complexity of public-road traffic. To address this limitation, we propose Video2Track, a framework that transfers real-world interactive driving scenarios from videos into steerable adversarial closed-track testing. The framework consists of two tightly coupled modules. The first is a scenario semantic mapping module, which extracts structured semantics from driving videos using a vision-language model and grounds them onto a closed-track topology library via retrieval-augmented generation, thereby identifying compatible map segments and interaction anchors. The second is a dynamic interactive testing module, which conditions on the grounded topology and anchors to generate diverse multi-agent trajectories through a conditional diffusion model, while regulating interaction intensity via a Stackelberg game with a parameterized adversarial objective. Closed-track experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework can faithfully reproduce representative real-world interaction scenarios and generate executable scenario variants with controllable risk levels and interaction styles, providing a scalable approach for realistic and steerable ADS validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Video2Track框架，将从真实驾驶视频中提取的交互场景转移到可操控的对峙式封闭测试道测试中，通过视觉语言模型进行场景语义映射，并结合条件扩散模型和Stackelberg博弈生成可控风险与交互风格的多智能体轨迹，实现真实且可引导的自动驾驶系统验证。
AI.motivation: 现有封闭测试道测试大多依赖标准化协议或预定义轨迹，交互过于脚本化，难以复现真实公共道路交通的自然复杂性，缺乏将真实驾驶场景转移到封闭测试道进行可复现、可操控验证的有效方法。
AI.method: Video2Track框架包含两个紧密耦合的模块：（1）场景语义映射模块，利用视觉语言模型从驾驶视频中提取结构化语义，并通过检索增强生成将其映射到封闭测试道拓扑库中，识别兼容的地图片段和交互锚点；（2）动态交互测试模块，基于映射的拓扑和锚点，通过条件扩散模型生成多样化的多智能体轨迹，并利用带参数化对抗目标的Stackelberg博弈调控交互强度。
AI.result: 封闭测试道实验表明，该框架能够忠实复现具有代表性的真实世界交互场景，并生成具有可控风险等级和交互风格的可执行场景变体，为真实且可引导的自动驾驶系统验证提供了可扩展的方法。
AI.conclusion: Video2Track为自动驾驶系统验证提供了一种从真实视频到封闭测试道的可扩展场景转移框架，在保持场景真实性的同时实现了交互风险与风格的可操控性，填补了现有封闭测试方法在复杂交互场景再现方面的空白。

title: CookVoice: Unified Framework for Style Controllable Multi-Modal Human Voice Generation
summary: Human voice generation has made rapid progress in speech generation, singing voice generation, voice cloning, and voice editing. However, most existing systems are designed for specific tasks and often rely on task-dependent architectures, control signals, or autoregressive decoding, limiting fine-grained controllability and inference efficiency. In this paper, we propose CookVoice, a unified framework for multimodal, multi-style, and multi-task human voice generation. CookVoice decomposes the human voice into three key factors: content, prosody, and style, enabling both speech and singing voice generation within a unified model. To achieve precise and flexible controllability, we design a flexible alignment strategy that maps text, style, and prosody control signals onto the frame-level of spectrogram. This design allows CookVoice to support a wide range of tasks, including text-to-speech, text-to-singing voice, style-controllable generation, voice mimicry, voice conversion, and voice editing. Experimental results show that CookVoice achieves generation quality comparable to existing Text-to-Speech and text-to-singing voice baselines, while providing stronger style and prosody controllability. Moreover, CookVoice achieves comparable performance to large-scale baselines with only 43.51 million parameters and efficient inference using as few as 4 ODE steps, making it a practical solution for real-world human voice generation applications. Demo page is available at https://haoweilou.github.io/CookVoice/.

AI.tldr: CookVoice是一个统一的多模态、多风格、多任务人类语音生成框架，将人声分解为内容、韵律和风格三个关键因素，通过灵活的帧级对齐策略支持语音合成、歌声合成、风格可控生成、声音模仿、声音转换和声音编辑等多种任务，仅需4351万参数和最少4个ODE步即可实现与大规模基线相当的生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有语音生成系统大多针对特定任务设计，依赖任务特定的架构、控制信号或自回归解码，导致细粒度可控性和推理效率受限。作者希望构建一个统一的框架，同时支持语音和歌声生成，并提供更强的可控性与高效的推理能力。
AI.method: CookVoice将人声分解为内容、韵律和风格三个关键因素，在统一模型中支持语音与歌声生成。设计了一种灵活的对齐策略，将文本、风格和韵律控制信号映射到频谱图的帧级别，从而实现对生成过程的精确和灵活控制，支持包括TTS、歌声合成、风格可控生成、声音模仿、声音转换和声音编辑在内的多种任务。
AI.result: 实验表明CookVoice实现了与现有TTS和歌声合成基线相当的生成质量，同时提供更强的风格和韵律可控性。仅以4351万参数和最少4个ODE步数的高效推理，即可达到与大规模基线相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: CookVoice通过统一的分解式建模和帧级对齐策略，在多种语音生成任务上实现了质量与可控性的平衡，并以轻量化的参数规模和高效的推断步骤展现了良好的实际应用潜力。

title: A Hybrid Framework of Vision Transformer and Gated Recurrent Unit for Detection of Mosquito Diseases
summary: Identifying dengue virus-infected mosquitoes from control mosquitoes is a major challenge in analyzing mosquito locomotion behavior due to the small size and complexity of the video background. Conventional AI methods are often unable to extract accurate features from video frames and produce erroneous features. In this study, a three-step framework is introduced: first, mosquitoes are identified and the background is removed using the YOLO 11M model, then visual features are extracted using the Vision Transformer (ViT), and finally the videos are classified with a convolutional GRU (ConvGRU) classifier. A comparative analysis of different models, including Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), and their convolutional versions showed that the ConvGRU model achieved the best performance; it achieved 88.88% accuracy, 84.45% precision, 82.82% recall, and 82.81% F1 score. These results demonstrate that combining convolutional models with sequence-based networks, especially in the ConvGRU model, allows the simultaneous extraction of precise spatial features and long-term temporal dependencies from mosquito movements. Finally, the proposed framework provides a reliable solution for analyzing mosquito behavior in complex environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个三阶段框架用于从对照蚊子中识别登革热病毒感染蚊子：使用YOLO 11M模型识别蚊子并去除背景，利用Vision Transformer (ViT)提取视觉特征，最后通过卷积GRU (ConvGRU)分类器对视频进行分类。对比RNN、LSTM、GRU及其卷积版本，ConvGRU表现最佳，准确率88.88%，精确率84.45%，召回率82.82%，F1分数82.81%。
AI.motivation: 由于蚊子体型小且视频背景复杂，从对照蚊子中识别登革热病毒感染蚊子的运动行为分析面临重大挑战。传统AI方法难以从视频帧中提取准确特征，产生错误特征，因此需要一种更可靠的框架来准确分类。
AI.method: 提出三阶段框架：(1) 使用YOLO 11M模型识别蚊子并去除视频背景；(2) 利用Vision Transformer (ViT)提取视觉特征；(3) 使用卷积GRU (ConvGRU)分类器对视频进行分类。同时对比了RNN、LSTM、GRU及其卷积变体的性能。
AI.result: ConvGRU模型在所有对比模型中表现最佳，达到88.88%准确率、84.45%精确率、82.82%召回率和82.81% F1分数。
AI.conclusion: 将卷积模型与序列网络相结合，尤其是ConvGRU模型，能够同时从蚊子运动中提取精确的空间特征和长期时间依赖关系。该框架为在复杂环境中分析蚊子行为提供了可靠解决方案。

title: RoadWeaver: Large-Scale Lane-Level HD Map Generation from Scratch for Autonomous Driving Simulation
summary: Autonomous driving simulation requires diverse and scalable lane-level HD maps to support long-horizon evaluation across complex road networks. Existing approaches either rely on handcrafted or reconstructed real-world maps, which limits scalability, or generate only local road structures rather than complete HD maps. We present RoadWeaver, a coarse-to-fine framework for from-scratch generation of diverse, large-scale HD maps. RoadWeaver first synthesizes a global road layout, expands it into a connected road network, and then constructs lane-level geometry with topologically consistent lane connectivity. Experimental results show that RoadWeaver achieves a 99.8\% reachability, a 10.7\% dead-end ratio, and an endpoint alignment error of 0.24 m. Compared with SOTA generation methods, it reduces endpoint alignment error by 94.4\% while generating complete HD maps in 1.39--3.50 s. The generated maps can be directly deployed in driving simulators, providing scalable simulation environments for future closed-loop evaluation of autonomous driving systems. The training code and an out-of-the-box implementation of RoadWeaver will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RoadWeaver，一个从零生成多样化、大规模车道级HD地图的粗到细框架。它先合成全局道路布局，扩展为连通道路网络，再构建具有拓扑一致性的车道级几何结构。实验表明其可达率99.8%、死端比例10.7%、端点对齐误差0.24 m，相比SOTA方法将端点对齐误差降低94.4%，且生成完整HD地图仅需1.39-3.50秒。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶仿真需要多样且可扩展的车道级HD地图以支持复杂路网上的长时程评估，但现有方法要么依赖手工或重建的真实地图（可扩展性受限），要么只能生成局部道路结构而非完整的HD地图。
AI.method: RoadWeaver采用粗到细（coarse-to-fine）的三阶段流程：首先合成全局道路布局，然后将其扩展为连通的道路网络，最后构建具有拓扑一致车道连通性的车道级几何结构。
AI.result: 可达率99.8%，死端比例10.7%，端点对齐误差0.24 m；相比SOTA生成方法，端点对齐误差降低94.4%，生成完整HD地图耗时仅1.39-3.50秒，可直接部署于驾驶仿真器。
AI.conclusion: RoadWeaver能够高效生成完整、大规模且拓扑一致的HD地图，为自动驾驶系统的闭环评估提供可扩展的仿真环境，代码与实现将随论文公开发布。

title: Testing Covarying Coupling Constants (CCC) against the full SPARC rotation-curve sample: a like-for-like comparison with MOND and NFW
comment: 16 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables, a montage of 165 galaxy rotation curves as supplementary material. Comments are welcomed
summary: The Covarying Coupling Constants (CCC) framework, developed to account for high-redshift JWST observations, contains a mechanism -- a covarying-constant effective mass field keyed to local density -- that modifies galactic dynamics without particle dark matter. We test it against the full Spitzer Photometry and Accurate Rotation Curves (SPARC) sample of 175 disc galaxies, extending an earlier study of a few objects. Working in an inverse formulation, in which each model predicts the baryonic rotation curve from the observed one, we compare CCC against Modified Newtonian Dynamics (MOND) and one- and two-parameter Navarro-Frenk-White (NFW) haloes on identical footing, using the reduced $χ^2_ν$. We show that the published sharp density turn-off in the earlier study is unphysical and replace it with a smooth transition -- the density-space analogue of the MOND interpolating function, introducing no new parameter. One-parameter smooth-CCC then performs comparably to galaxy-by-galaxy fitted MOND (the lower $χ^2_ν$ in 56 per cent of galaxies, mean $χ^2_ν$ of 2.58 versus 2.65; the paired difference is not significant), while two-parameter NFW shows a substantially broader fit-quality distribution and a larger tail of poor or boundary-limited fits (mean $χ^2_ν\approx 7$). The CCC turn-off density is not universal (scatter 0.82 dex) and correlates with galaxy size, qualitatively consistent with a spherical reconstruction applied to flattened disc systems. Recast as an acceleration, however, $a_t = V_{\rm flat}^2/R_t$ has scatter 0.33 dex (on the 91-galaxy resolved subset) -- matching the MOND scale $a_0$ (0.34 dex) -- and comparable magnitude of order $2 \times 10^{-10}$ m/s$^2$, with its size correlation removed. Though not designed for galactic dynamics, CCC describes rotation curves as well as galaxy-by-galaxy fitted MOND.

AI.tldr: 本文在完整的SPARC样本（175个盘状星系）上检验协变耦合常数（CCC）框架，将其旋转曲线预测能力与MOND以及单/双参数NFW晕在同等条件下比较。作者指出现有研究中的尖锐密度截止是非物理的，并引入平滑过渡（密度空间的MOND插值函数类似物）而不引入新参数。结果表明单参数平滑CCC与逐星系拟合的MOND性能相当（平均χ²ν为2.58对2.65），优于双参数NFW（平均χ²ν≈7）。CCC的转折加速度a_t的散布（0.33 dex）与MOND尺度a₀（0.34 dex）相当，量级约为2×10⁻¹⁰ m/s²，且消除了尺寸相关性。
AI.motivation: CCC框架最初为解释JWST高红移观测而提出，其通过依赖局部密度的协变常数有效质量场来修改星系动力学，无需粒子暗物质。此前仅对少数星系做过测试，本文将其系统性地应用于完整SPARC样本，与主流替代方案（MOND和NFW晕）进行公平对比，并修正了先前研究中非物理的尖锐密度截止问题。
AI.method: 采用逆问题方法：每个模型由观测到的旋转曲线预测重子旋转曲线。在完全相同的条件下，使用约化χ²ν比较三种模型：单参数平滑CCC、逐星系拟合的MOND、以及单/双参数NFW晕。将原研究中非物理的尖锐密度截止替换为平滑过渡函数（密度空间的MOND插值函数类似物），不引入额外参数。
AI.result: 单参数平滑CCC在56%的星系中给出更低χ²ν，平均χ²ν为2.58 vs MOND的2.65（配对差异不显著）。双参数NFW的拟合质量分布更宽且有更多差/边界受限拟合（平均χ²ν≈7）。CCC转折密度非普适（0.82 dex散布）且与星系尺寸相关（可由扁平盘系统的球对称重建定性解释）；但重写为加速度a_t = V_flat²/R_t后，散布降至0.33 dex（91个可解析星系子集），与MOND尺度a₀的0.34 dex相当，量级约2×10⁻¹⁰ m/s²，尺寸相关性消失。
AI.conclusion: 尽管CCC并非为星系动力学而设计，但它描述旋转曲线的能力与逐星系拟合的MOND相当，且优于双参数NFW晕。CCC的转折密度虽非普适常数，但转化为加速度后与MOND的a₀在散布和量级上惊人地一致，暗示CCC与MOND之间存在深层联系。

title: From Synthesis to Removal: Physics-Grounded Reflection Simulation and Diffusion-Based Video Dereflection
summary: Videos captured through glass often contain reflections that degrade visual quality and interfere with downstream vision tasks. Although single-image reflection removal has been extensively studied, video reflection removal remains largely underexplored due to the lack of paired video data, temporally coherent removal models, and dedicated evaluation benchmarks. We present a closed-loop framework that unifies physics-grounded reflection simulation, diffusion-based video dereflection, and benchmark evaluation. Our S2R-Synthesis pipeline generates paired reflected and reflection-free videos by performing physics-grounded augmentation in the structure space and rendering realistic reflected videos with a trained video diffusion renderer; the augmentation models key glass-related effects including roughness-induced blur, thickness-induced ghosting, and reflectance variation. Based on the synthesized data, we introduce S2R-Removal, the first diffusion-based video reflection removal model, which adapts a pretrained video diffusion prior through reflection-aware latent adaptation and one-step pixel-geometric refinement, recovering the clean transmission in a single denoising step. We further build S2R-Bench, the first benchmark for video reflection removal, supporting both full-reference evaluation and real-world human perceptual assessment. Experiments on S2R-Bench and multiple public image benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and faster inference than even non-diffusion baselines, and validate the effectiveness of S2R-Synthesis. Project page: https://codingwzp.github.io/VideoDereflection_S2R.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个闭环框架S2R，包含三个部分：S2R-Synthesis用于物理驱动的反射视频仿真与数据生成，S2R-Removal是首个基于扩散模型的视频反射去除模型，S2R-Bench是首个视频反射去除基准评测集。实验表明该方法在多个基准上达到SOTA性能，且推理速度甚至快于非扩散基线。
AI.motivation: 视频反射去除长期未被充分探索，主要受限于三个瓶颈：缺乏成对的视频数据（单图反射去除已被广泛研究但视频领域缺少数据集）、缺乏时间一致性的去除模型、缺乏专门的评测基准。现有方法无法有效处理玻璃反射带来的视觉质量下降问题。
AI.method: 提出闭环框架S2R：(1) S2R-Synthesis：在结构空间进行物理驱动的数据增强，模拟玻璃相关效应（粗糙度导致的模糊、厚度导致的鬼影、反射率变化），并用训练好的视频扩散渲染器生成逼真的成对反射视频；(2) S2R-Removal：首个基于扩散模型的视频反射去除模型，通过反射感知的潜在空间适配和单步像素-几何细化来适应预训练的视频扩散先验，在单次去噪步骤中恢复干净的透射内容；(3) S2R-Bench：首个视频反射去除基准，同时支持全参考评估和真实世界的主观感知评估。
AI.result: 在S2R-Bench和多个公开图像基准上的实验表明，该方法达到SOTA性能，推理速度甚至快于非扩散基线方法，并验证了S2R-Synthesis数据生成管道的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过统一仿真、去除和评测三个环节，首次系统性地解决了视频反射去除问题，证明了物理驱动的合成数据与扩散模型的结合能够高效且高质量地完成视频去反射任务。

title: Spatially Resolving the Pre-Thermal Anatomy of a Driven Bosonic Fluid
summary: Understanding how coherently driven quantum many-body systems redistribute energy prior to thermal equilibrium remains a central challenge in many-body physics. Here, we utilize nitrogen-vacancy (NV) magnetometry to perform micron-scale spatial imaging of room-temperature magnon dynamics in a yttrium iron garnet (YIG) thin film. We resolve a hierarchy of discrete parametric scattering events that serve as deterministic stepping stones toward thermalization. By applying a two-tone wave-mixing protocol, we first isolate the elementary four-magnon interaction and extract its coupling strength via the spatial growth of the scattering product. We then drive the system with an intense single-frequency excitation near ferromagnetic resonance, revealing that magnon-magnon interactions trigger a spontaneous, multi-generation scattering cascade. We demonstrate that in each generation, the dominant scattering channels correspond to one of the out-scattered magnons being in the slow magnon regime, reminiscent of the enhancement of optical nonlinearities in slow light systems. We capture this dynamics quantitatively using a near field magnonics framework and extract the cascade order and nonlinear coefficients directly from power-dependent frequency shifts. By revealing the multi-stage dynamical process through which monochromatic injected magnons evolve toward equilibrium, our work establishes spatially resolved magnonics as a powerful platform for visualizing non-equilibrium many-body kinetics.

AI.tldr: 利用NV磁强计对室温YIG薄膜中的磁振子动力学进行微米级空间成像，解析了从四磁振子相互作用到多代散射级联的参量散射层级，揭示了磁振子向热平衡演化的多阶段动力学过程。
AI.motivation: 相干驱动的量子多体系统在达到热平衡前如何重新分布能量仍然是多体物理中的核心挑战，需要直接的实验手段来可视化这一非平衡动力学过程。
AI.method: 采用氮空位(NV)磁强计对钇铁石榴石(YIG)薄膜进行微米尺度空间成像；通过双频混频协议隔离基本四磁振子相互作用并提取耦合强度；在铁磁共振附近施加强单频激发以触发自发多代散射级联；利用近场磁振子学框架定量捕获动力学，提取级联阶数和非线性系数。
AI.result: 解析了离散参量散射事件的层级结构；隔离了基本四磁振子相互作用并提取耦合强度；观测到多代自发放射级联，每代的主导散射通道涉及慢磁振子区的逸散射磁振子（类似慢光系统中光学非线性增强）；在慢磁振子区域观察到散射增强，并通过近场磁振子学框架定量捕获了动力学过程，提取了级联阶数和非线性系数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了空间分辨磁振子学作为可视化非平衡多体动力学的强大平台，揭示了单色注入磁振子向平衡态演化的多级动力学过程。

title: Boundary-Continuous Cross-Camera RGB Mapping via Hue-Split Model Trees
comment: Accepted to APSIPA ASC 2026. 6 pages, 4 figures
summary: We propose a hue-split model-tree method for boundary-continuous cross-camera RGB mapping. Cross-camera RGB mapping aims to produce consistent color representations across cameras whose recorded RGB values differ due to sensor spectral sensitivities and image-signal processing pipelines. A common chart-based remedy is to estimate a single global affine color correction matrix (CCM), but such a global model cannot capture hue-specific discrepancies between cameras. To capture that behavior, we recursively partitions the source-camera color space along a scalar hue coordinate and builds an model tree that stores an affine CCM at every node. For fitting the node CCMs, we utilize a log-domain error objective. To prevent false contours that arise from hard hue splits, we further introduce a boundary-continuous formulation in which the prediction is obtained by blending the log-domain outputs of all node CCMs along the root-to-leaf path. The path-wise blending weights are optimized under a simplex constraint using both a chart-pair fitting loss and an explicit continuity regularizer defined on deterministic boundary prototype pairs placed just on either side of each learned hue threshold. We conducted an experiment on a Canon EOS-1Ds Mark II to Canon EOS 20D mapping using the Middlebury Registered Color Checker dataset. The results show that hue splitting substantially reduces log-RMSE over a single global affine CCM and that the proposed path blending with boundary prototype regularization simultaneously improves accuracy and suppresses chromaticity gaps at the learned hue thresholds across two illuminants and multiple exposure conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于色调分割的模型树方法，用于跨相机的边界连续RGB映射。通过沿标量色调坐标递归划分源相机色彩空间，在每节点构建仿射颜色校正矩阵（CCM），并利用路径混合与边界原型正则化消除硬分割带来的轮廓伪影，在Canon相机对映射实验中显著降低log-RMSE并抑制色度跳变。
AI.motivation: 传统全局仿射CCM无法捕捉相机间因传感器光谱灵敏度差异和ISP流程导致的色调特异性颜色偏差，需要一种能按色调区分建模的颜色映射方法。
AI.method: 1) 沿源相机色彩空间的标量色调坐标递归划分，构建存储仿射CCM的模型树；2) 使用对数域误差目标拟合节点CCM；3) 提出边界连续公式，将根到叶路径上所有节点CCM的对数域输出进行混合，混合权重在单纯形约束下优化；4) 同时使用图卡对拟合损失和显式连续性正则化器（基于学习阈值两侧的确定性边界原型对）进行优化。
AI.result: 在Canon EOS-1Ds Mark II到Canon EOS 20D的映射实验中（使用Middlebury Registered Color Checker数据集），色调分割相比单一全局仿射CCM大幅降低log-RMSE；所提出的路径混合与边界原型正则化在两种光照和多种曝光条件下同时提升精度并抑制学习色调阈值处的色度间隙。
AI.conclusion: 色调分割的模型树方法能够有效捕捉相机间色调特异性颜色差异，而路径混合和边界原型正则化是消除硬分割伪影、实现边界连续映射的关键，兼顾了精度与视觉连续性。

title: Fine-Tuning Generative Models for Extreme Events via CVaR-Penalized Wasserstein Gradient Flows
summary: We propose CVaR-penalized Generative Particle Algorithm (CVaR-GPA), a robust, tail-agnostic algorithm for fine-tuning generative models to learn heavy-tailed distributions and capture extreme events, requiring no prior knowledge or estimation of the target's tail characteristics. The method is the Wasserstein gradient flow of the Lipschitz-regularized Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence penalized by a Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) discrepancy term: the Lipschitz-regularized KL divergence enables robust learning under minimal assumptions on the target distribution, while the CVaR penalty restores the velocity that otherwise vanishes prematurely in the under-sampled tails. The penalized flow admits a bounded but non-Lipschitz velocity field.
