This departs from the Lipschitz transport maps of standard generators, which preserve the tail behavior of a light-tailed source, and enables transport toward heavier-tailed targets. To define this flow on empirical measures, we derive the first-variation subgradients of CVaR from its Rockafellar-Uryasev representation, valid precisely where the classical density-based formula fails. The particle algorithm CVaR-GPA fine-tunes the output samples of any pre-trained model, without access to its architecture, and runs on an adaptive time horizon set by a kinetic-energy stopping criterion rather than a preset depth. On synthetic isotropic and anisotropic Student-$t$ target distributions, Neal's funnel distribution, and the real-world high-dimensional Fama-French 25 portfolio dataset, CVaR-GPA dramatically improves global and tail accuracy on heavy-tailed targets over the pre-trained baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出CVaR-GPA算法，通过Wasserstein梯度流最小化Lipschitz正则化KL散度与CVaR惩罚项之和，用于将预训练生成模型微调到重尾分布并捕捉极端事件，无需对目标分布尾部有任何先验知识或估计。
AI.motivation: 标准生成模型（如基于Lipschitz传输映射的生成器）从轻尾源分布采样，其Lipschitz性质会保持轻尾行为，难以学习重尾目标分布或捕捉极端事件；且重尾目标在欠采样尾部区域，标准梯度流的粒子速度过早消失，导致尾部学习失效。
AI.method: 将Wasserstein梯度流定义为Lipschitz正则化KL散度与CVaR散度惩罚项之和。Lipschitz正则化KL散度在最小假设下实现稳健学习；CVaR惩罚项恢复在欠采样尾部过早消失的粒子速度。该惩罚流产生有界但非Lipschitz的速度场，突破标准生成器Lipschitz传输映射的限制，实现向更重尾目标的传输。从Rockafellar-Uryasev表示推导CVaR的一阶变分次梯度（在经典密度公式失效处仍然有效），定义经验测度上的流。算法无需访问预训练模型架构，基于动能停止准则的自适应时间范围运行。
AI.result: 在合成各向同性和各向异性Student-t目标分布、Neal's漏斗分布以及真实高维Fama-French 25投资组合数据集上，CVaR-GPA相比预训练基线显著提升了重尾目标的全局精度和尾部精度。
AI.conclusion: CVaR-GPA是一种稳健、尾部无关的生成模型微调算法，能够有效学习重尾分布并捕捉极端事件，同时不需要对目标分布的尾部特征进行先验估计，在合成与真实数据集上均取得显著改进。

title: Generative Semantic Segmentation via an Observable Semantic-Image Interface and Hierarchical Generator Evidence Alignment
summary: Generative semantic segmentation exposes structured predictions as images, but direct color decoding is susceptible to color drift and boundary mixing, whereas latent-feature decoders that predict a separate output distribution may relegate the rendered image to an intermediate visualization. We present Semantic Prism, a conditional semantic-image generation-and-refinement framework with deterministic inference. A diffusion-distilled one-step generator renders a semantic RGB image; per-pixel distances from the rendered colors to a fixed class-color codebook define an explicit probabilistic interface. Hierarchical Generator Evidence Alignment spatially aligns multi-level generator features and uses a zero-initialized output projection to predict an additive residual in the interface logit space, retaining the image-defined interface as the reference for the final distribution. The interface and refined distributions further enable Contextual Interface--Hierarchy Disagreement (C-IHD), a fixed readout for ranking remaining pixel errors without an auxiliary predictor or additional forward pass. On the 500-image Cityscapes validation set, Semantic Prism achieves 72.07% mean intersection over union, 11.39 mIoU points above direct-interface decoding, with 0.41% expected calibration error. Matched-capacity ablations over three seeds support the benefit of jointly aligned multi-level evidence. A separately trained model attains 62.22% mIoU on BDD100K, while the Cityscapes-trained model reaches 46.89\% mIoU under source-frozen transfer to the Adverse Conditions Dataset with Correspondences, without target-domain adaptation. Across all three datasets, C-IHD consistently improves the area under the precision--recall curve for pixel-error ranking over maximum softmax probability on the same segmentation predictions; on ACDC, it raises AUPR from 0.6580 to 0.7557.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Semantic Prism，一个条件语义图像生成与精炼框架，通过扩散蒸馏的单步生成器渲染语义RGB图像，利用颜色到固定类色码本的距离作为显式概率接口，并通过层级生成器证据对齐（HGEA）在接口logit空间中预测加性残差以精炼分布。此外提出C-IHD固定读出器用于像素错误排名，在Cityscapes、BDD100K、ACDC三个数据集上取得了显著效果。
AI.motivation: 生成式语义分割将结构化预测暴露为图像，但直接颜色解码易受颜色漂移和边界混合影响；而潜在特征解码器预测独立输出分布可能将渲染图像降级为中间可视化。现有方法无法同时兼顾生成式渲染的直观性、颜色解码的稳定性以及可靠的概率接口。
AI.method: 1）使用扩散蒸馏的一步生成器渲染语义RGB图像；2）计算渲染颜色到固定类色码本的逐像素距离，构造显式概率接口；3）提出Hierarchical Generator Evidence Alignment（HGEA），空间对齐多层级生成器特征，用零初始化输出投影在接口logit空间中预测加性残差；4）提出Contextual Interface--Hierarchy Disagreement（C-IHD），一种无需辅助预测器或额外前向传播的固定读出器，用于对剩余像素误差进行排序。
AI.result: 在Cityscapes 500张验证集上达到72.07% mIoU，比直接接口解码高11.39个mIoU点，E CE为0.41%。BDD100K上单独训练的模型达62.22% mIoU，Cityscapes训练的模型在ACDC源冻结迁移下达到46.89% mIoU。C-IHD在三个数据集上一致优于最大softmax概率的像素误差排名，在ACDC上将AUPR从0.6580提升至0.7557。
AI.conclusion: Semantic Prism证明了通过保留图像定义的接口作为最终分布参考，同时用对齐的多层级生成器证据精炼logit空间，可以有效兼顾生成式语义分割的直观性与预测精度；C-IHD提供了无需额外训练的可靠的像素级不确定性估计方法。

title: CT-$Δ$Bench: A Benchmark for Longitudinal 3D Medical Imaging Difference Reporting with Vision-Language Models
summary: In medical imaging, the clinical value of Computed Tomography (CT) lies not only in depicting current disease status, but crucially in enabling longitudinal comparison of serial scans to determine disease evolution, a process that underpins response assessment, recurrence detection, and ongoing patient management. Yet, despite this central role of temporal comparison in clinical decision-making, existing medical foundation models remain largely confined to single-study understanding, leaving temporally grounded cross-examination insufficiently addressed. To address this gap, we study longitudinal imaging difference reporting, a task in which a model takes two temporally separated scans from the same patient and generates a clinically meaningful report describing interval changes between them. We introduce CT-$Δ$Bench, a dedicated benchmark for this task with patient-level splitting to prevent information leakage. To better evaluate this task beyond surface-level text similarity, we further develop change-aware metrics specifically designed to capture clinically meaningful longitudinal changes, and conduct an independent physician validation to assess the reliability of the synthesized references and event extraction pipeline. We also compare direct paired-CT reasoning with an indirect two-stage pipeline that first generates single-timepoint reports and then performs textual differencing. Finally, we propose DeltaMed, a baseline model for direct paired-CT difference reporting, and train it on the benchmark training set. Together, these contributions lay the groundwork for temporally aware medical foundation models that better reflect real-world longitudinal clinical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究纵向影像差异报告任务，提出CT-ΔBench基准（含患者级划分防止信息泄露）、针对临床纵向变化设计的change-aware评估指标、独立医师验证流程，并比较直接配对CT推理与间接两阶段管线，最后提出基线模型DeltaMed进行直接配对CT差异报告。
AI.motivation: 现有医学基础模型局限于单次影像（single-study）理解，缺乏对同一患者不同时间点扫描影像的时序交叉比较能力，而纵向比较（如疾病演变、疗效评估、复发检测）恰恰是临床决策中的核心环节，亟待填补这一空白。
AI.method: 1) 提出纵向影像差异报告任务定义；2) 构建CT-ΔBench基准数据集，采用患者级划分防止信息泄露；3) 设计change-aware评估指标以捕捉临床有意义的纵向变化，而非仅依赖表面文本相似度；4) 进行独立医师验证以评估合成参考与事件提取管线的可靠性；5) 对比直接配对CT推理与两阶段管线（先生成单时间点报告再做文本差分）；6) 提出DeltaMed基线模型并训练。
AI.result: 构建了专用的CT-ΔBench基准和change-aware评估体系，通过医师验证确认了合成参考与事件提取管线的可靠性，并对比了直接与间接两种推理范式，训练了DeltaMed基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 这些贡献为具备时序感知能力、更贴近真实世界纵向临床推理的医学基础模型奠定了研究基础。

title: Keep the Future, Drop the Rollout: RIFT for World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) condition robot actions on predicted futures, but iterative video rollout increases deployment latency. We ask whether action generation requires the evolving rollout trajectory or only its future representation. Across four WAMs on all 40 LIBERO tasks, paired closed-loop interventions show that masking or reassigning future-cache values changes execution and reduces success, indicating sensitivity to future values and their assigned positions. For Joint and Cosmos-2, however, replaying one fixed final-clean key/value (K/V) cache nearly preserves unmodified execution, with $1.7$ to $1.9$~cm end-effector average displacement error and $97.9\%$ to $98.2\%$ success. This separates cache consumption from production: these models can reuse a fixed cache but still require iterative rollout to construct it. We therefore propose RIFT (\emph{Rollout-free Imagination via Future Tokens}), which uses learned anticipation tokens to construct a complete future K/V cache in one backbone pass while retaining the original future-read interface. On LIBERO, RIFT achieves $98.8\%$ success, close to rollout-based Joint, IDM, and LingBot-VA at $98.4\%$ to $98.6\%$, while reducing action-chunk latency by $68.2\%$ to $89.1\%$. On RoboTwin~2.0, RIFT reaches $92.9/92.6\%$ on clean/randomized scenes, the highest observed among the evaluated methods. These results support rollout-free future conditioning without iterative video generation at deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RIFT（Rollout-free Imagination via Future Tokens），通过学习的预测标记在一次主干网络前向传播中构造完整的未来K/V缓存，在不进行迭代视频生成的情况下实现未来条件化动作生成，在LIBERO和RoboTwin 2.0基准上达到接近或超越基于rollout基线方法的效果，同时将动作块延迟降低68.2%至89.1%。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAMs）依赖预测未来进行动作条件化，但迭代式视频rollout会引入显著的部署延迟。作者质疑动作生成是否必须依赖逐步展开的轨迹，还是仅需其未来表示即可。这一问题的答案将决定能否在设计部署阶段去除昂贵的迭代视频生成流程。
AI.method: 首先通过成对的闭环干预实验（掩码或重新指定future-cache值）验证未来缓存值及其位置对动作执行的影响。发现对于Joint和Cosmos-2模型，重放固定的最终干净K/V缓存几乎不改变执行（成功率达97.9%-98.2%），从而将缓存消费与缓存生产解耦。基于此洞察，提出RIFT框架，使用学习到的anticipation tokens在一次主干网络前向传播中构造完整未来K/V缓存，同时保留原始的future-read接口。
AI.result: 在全部40个LIBERO任务上，RIFT达到98.8%成功率，接近基于rollout的Joint、IDM和LingBot-VA（98.4%-98.6%），同时将动作块延迟降低68.2%-89.1%。在RoboTwin 2.0上，RIFT在干净/随机化场景分别达到92.9%/92.6%，为评估方法中的最高观测值。此外，干预实验表明Joint和Cosmos-2可以复用固定缓存但构造仍需rollout。
AI.conclusion: 未来条件化动作生成并不需要在部署时进行迭代视频rollout；通过将缓存消费与缓存生产分离，并利用学习到的anticipation tokens一次性构造完整的未来表示，可以在保持高成功率的同时大幅降低延迟。这为无rollout的未来条件化机器人控制提供了可行的新范式。

title: SinoDiff: Physics-Consistent Self-Supervised Diffusion for Unified Low-Dose to Standard-Dose PET Sinogram Recovery
summary: Low-dose positron emission tomography (LD-PET) reduces radiation exposure but leads to poor image quality and hinders diagnostic confidence. Existing supervised LD to standard-dose (SD) PET recovery methods often fail to generalise across dose variations, while dose-agnostic supervised methods require paired LD-SD data. Current self-supervised methods, although more flexible, typically produce inferior results, including loss of anatomical details and oversmoothing pathological features. These pose major limitations for practical applications. To overcome these limitations, we propose SinoDiff, a novel self-supervised, physics-consistent diffusion framework for the recovery of PET sinograms across multiple predefined dose levels. Unlike the noise simulation in traditional diffusion methods, SinoDiff integrates the PET acquisition model into the forward diffusion process via Poisson thinning, enabling physically consistent sampling/modelling of dose-dependent count statistics. During the reverse diffusion process, SinoDiff estimates the incremental change in PET signals from predefined dose levels. Therefore, SinoDiff is a single, unified model that requires no retraining across multiple dose levels. To consider the characteristics of PET sinogram, we incorporate a frequency-domain convolution to capture long-range dependencies across projection angles and detector bins. Experiments on [18F]-FDG and [18F]-FDOPA datasets demonstrate that SinoDiff achieves competitive performance against supervised and self-supervised baselines across multiple dose levels.

AI.tldr: SinoDiff是一个全新的自监督、物理一致的扩散框架，用于跨多个预定义剂量水平的PET正弦图恢复。通过将PET采集模型（泊松细化）集成到正向扩散过程中，实现物理一致的剂量依赖计数统计建模；在逆向过程中估计预定义剂量水平间的PET信号增量，从而无需跨剂量水平重新训练。在[18F]-FDG和[18F]-FDOPA数据集上达到了与监督和自监督基线相当的竞争性能。
AI.motivation: 低剂量PET减少辐射暴露但图像质量差，影响诊断信心。现有监督方法跨剂量泛化能力差且需要配对数据；自监督方法虽灵活但结果较差（丢失解剖细节、过度平滑病理特征）。这些局限性严重阻碍实际应用。
AI.method: SinoDiff提出一个自监督、物理一致的扩散框架：(1) 将PET采集模型通过泊松细化（Poisson thinning）集成到正向扩散过程，替代传统扩散中的噪声模拟，实现物理一致的剂量依赖计数统计建模；(2) 逆向扩散过程中估计预定义剂量水平间PET信号的增量变化，使得单一统一模型无需重新训练即可处理多个剂量水平；(3) 引入频率域卷积以捕获投影角度与探测器bin之间的长程依赖关系，适配PET正弦图的特性。
AI.result: 在[18F]-FDG和[18F]-FDOPA两个PET数据集上，SinoDiff在多个剂量水平下达到了与监督和自监督基线相当的竞争性能，同时保持了物理一致性和无需重训练的灵活性。
AI.conclusion: SinoDiff通过将PET采集物理模型融入扩散过程，成功克服了现有LD-PET恢复方法在跨剂量泛化、配对数据依赖和自监督性能不佳等方面的局限性，提供了一个统一、物理自洽且无需重训练的多剂量PET正弦图恢复方案。

title: From Prompting to Behavioral Alignment: Personalized LLM Judges for Recommendation Evaluation
summary: Traditional offline recommendation evaluation relies heavily on complex, manually maintained feature pipelines that are difficult to scale. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising alternative by predicting user engagement directly from raw text logs, empirical analysis in this study identifies a critical failure mode termed bidirectional rationalization. In a zero-shot setting, LLMs are found to convincingly argue for both positive and negative user engagement outcomes on the exact same item with identical evidence, highlighting the unreliability of off-the-shelf LLMs in predicting user engagement. To resolve this, we develop and apply a sequential behavioral alignment framework pairing fine-tuning with preference optimization over paired correct and counterfactual rationales. Evaluated on real-world homepage interaction logs, this aligned reasoning approach achieves a 32.19\% lift in Macro-F1 score over the zero-shot baseline and matches the production feature-engineered baseline. The results demonstrate that behavioral alignment mitigates bidirectional rationalization while delivering human-interpretable reasoning traces without manual pipeline overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了LLM在零样本场景下用于离线推荐评估时存在的"双向合理化"失效模式——即LLM对同一物品的相同证据既能论证正向也能论证负向用户参与结果。为此提出顺序行为对齐框架，结合微调与偏好优化，在真实首页交互日志上相比零样本基线提升32.19%的Macro-F1，且匹配生产级特征工程基线。
AI.motivation: 传统离线推荐评估依赖复杂且难以扩展的人工维护特征管线。LLM虽可通过原始文本日志直接预测用户参与度，但实证发现其存在"双向合理化"这一关键失效模式，即零样本LLM对相同物品和相同证据既能信服地论证正向结果也能论证负向结果，导致开箱即用的LLM在用户参与度预测上不可靠。
AI.method: 提出顺序行为对齐框架：将微调与偏好优化相结合，在成对的正确理由与反事实理由上进行训练。通过行为对齐使模型学习区分有效与无效的推理路径，从而抑制双向合理化。
AI.result: 在真实首页交互日志上评估，对齐推理方法相比零样本基线在Macro-F1上实现32.19%的提升，并匹配生产级特征工程基线的性能。
AI.conclusion: 行为对齐能够缓解双向合理化问题，同时交付人类可解释的推理轨迹，且无需人工管线开销，为LLM替代传统推荐评估管线提供了可行路径。

title: Test-Time Hallucination Control in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Object Hallucination in large vision-language models (LVLMs), where models generate non-factual content about input images, remains a critical barrier to their reliability in real-world applications. Existing mitigation strategies can be categorized into training-based and training-free methods. Training-based methods often achieve strong performance but are costly, requiring extensive computational resources, large-scale data, and time-consuming fine-tuning. Training-free approaches are particularly appealing due to their efficiency. However, existing training-free methods either require multiple decoding rounds, which adds computational overhead, or modify internal states in a model-specific way that risks degrading pretrained knowledge. We propose Test-Time Hallucination Mitigation (TTH) method, a novel training-free method that addresses both limitations. TTH introduces a token-validator module, implemented as a zero-shot Multi-Modal Classifier (MMC), to generate auxiliary logits grounded in the input image. These logits are fused with the original LVLM outputs at the token level for object tokens selected from a candidate pool. An entropy-based weighting scheme is then applied to enable robust and accurate predictions. Extensive experiments across multiple LVLM families and diverse benchmarks demonstrate that TTH consistently improves accuracy and robustness, underscoring its generalizability and practical effectiveness. Code is released at https://github.com/Mehran-TAM/TTH

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为TTH（Test-Time Hallucination Mitigation）的免训练幻觉缓解方法，通过引入零样本多模态分类器作为token验证器，在推理阶段融合辅助logits来抑制大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的对象幻觉，兼顾了计算效率与通用性。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在生成时会产生对象幻觉（生成与输入图像不符的内容），严重制约其可靠性。现有缓解策略中，基于训练的方法性能好但成本高昂（计算资源、大规模数据、微调耗时）；免训练方法虽然高效，但要么需要多轮解码增加计算开销，要么以模型特定的方式修改内部状态而有损预训练知识。因此亟需一种既能保持效率又能广泛适用的免训练缓解方法。
AI.method: 提出测试时幻觉缓解（TTH）方法，属于免训练方法。核心组件是一个token验证器，由零样本多模态分类器（MMC）实现，用于生成与输入图像对齐的辅助logits。这些辅助logits在token级别上与原始LVLM输出进行融合（仅针对从候选池中选择的对象token），并通过基于熵的加权方案来确保预测的鲁棒性和准确性。
AI.result: 在多个LVLM家族和多样化基准上的大量实验表明，TTH方法在准确性和鲁棒性方面均取得了一致的改进，验证了其良好的泛化能力和实际有效性。
AI.conclusion: TTH作为一种免训练的测试时幻觉缓解方法，通过零样本多模态分类器融合辅助logits并结合熵加权，有效解决了现有免训练方法计算开销大和模型特异性修改的局限，在多个LVLM上展现出通用性与实际应用价值。

title: Estimating the perturbed utility route choice model with trip-level data
summary: We provide an estimator for the perturbed utility route choice (PURC) model that works with data at the level of individual trips. The estimator is a nested fixed-point algorithm that combines an upper bias-corrected linear regression problem with a lower individual-level perturbed utility maximization problem. We establish the statistical properties of the microPURC estimator and confirm these results with an experiment using simulated data. Finally, we demonstrate the estimator in practice using a large real-world dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对扰动效用路径选择（PURC）模型的估计器，该估计器适用于个体出行级别数据，采用嵌套固定点算法结合上偏差校正线性回归与个体级扰动效用最大化问题，并验证了其统计性质及实际应用效果。
AI.motivation: 现有PURC模型的估计方法通常需要聚合级别的数据，无法充分利用个体出行级别的信息。作者旨在开发一种能够在个体出行数据上有效估计PURC模型的估计器，以提升模型估计的精度和实用性。
AI.method: 提出微PURC（microPURC）估计器，采用嵌套固定点算法：上层为偏差校正的线性回归问题，下层为个体级别的扰动效用最大化问题。通过这种嵌套结构同时估计模型的参数。
AI.result: 建立了microPURC估计器的统计性质，并通过模拟数据实验验证了理论结果。此外，在大规模真实世界数据集上展示了估计器的实际应用效果。
AI.conclusion: microPURC估计器能够有效地在个体出行数据上估计PURC模型，具备良好的统计性质，并通过模拟与真实数据验证了其可行性和有效性。

title: Herding End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Neuro-Symbolic Safety Guards
summary: Modern end-to-end driving agents can achieve high average performance yet still violate basic traffic rules that a human driver would never miss. The reason is structural: they learn statistical patterns rather than the physical conditions that guarantee safe driving, leaving their decision-making process opaque and safety constraints unenforced. We introduce a neuro-symbolic safety guard, a lightweight module that attaches to the final command interface of an already-trained agent. Immediately before a command reaches the vehicle, it checks the command against explicit safety rules and, only when necessary, replaces it with the nearest safe alternative. Each intervention is directly executable and traceable to the rule that triggered it, while the guard itself requires no retraining and adds no learned component. Evaluated on the long-tail benchmarks Fail2Drive and Bench2Drive using the state-of-the-art TransFuser v6 (TFv6) as a case study, the guard improves Success Rate by 15% and reduces safety-critical collisions by up to 53%, while preserving the original Driving Score.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种神经符号安全护栏（neuro-symbolic safety guard），作为轻量级模块附加在已训练好的端到端驾驶代理的命令接口上。该模块在任何指令到达车辆前，用显式安全规则检查指令，必要时替换为最近的安全替代方案。无需重训练、无新增学习组件，每个干预都可执行且可追溯到触发它的规则。在Fail2Drive和Bench2Drive长尾基准上以TransFuser v6为案例，成功率达15%提升，安全关键碰撞减少最高53%，同时保持原有驾驶分数。
AI.motivation: 现代端到端驾驶代理虽然平均性能高，但仍会违反人类驾驶员绝不会忽略的基本交通规则。根本原因在于结构性缺陷：它们学习的是统计模式而非保证安全驾驶的物理条件，导致决策过程不透明且安全约束无法强制执行。
AI.method: 引入神经符号安全护栏：一个轻量级模块，附加到已训练代理的最终指令接口上。在指令到达车辆前，基于显式安全规则检查指令，仅在必要时用最近的安全替代方案替换。护栏无需重训练，不添加任何学习组件，每次干预都可执行且可追溯到触发规则。
AI.result: 在Fail2Drive和Bench2Drive长尾基准上以TransFuser v6（TFv6）作为案例验证：成功率提升15%，安全关键碰撞减少最多53%，同时保留原有驾驶分数。
AI.conclusion: 神经符号安全护栏通过将显式安全规则与学习型驾驶代理相结合，有效弥补了端到端模型在安全约束执行方面的结构性缺陷，在不牺牲驾驶性能的前提下显著提升了安全性和决策可解释性。

title: A Perspective on Phase Space Electronic Structure Theory : From Its Surface Hopping Origins Through To Its Future Promise
summary: We trace the history of phase space electronic structure theory (PSEST), high- lighting how this powerful approach emerged from fundamental questions in semi- classical surface hopping dynamics and evolved into an alternative to standard Born- Oppenheimer based electronic structure theory (with moving instead of frozen nuclei). Our goal herein is not to recapitulate the mathematical details of phase space electronic structure calculations, and few equations are presented so as to maximize readability. Instead, our goal is to provide intuition for those new to the field both (i) regarding the physics present when solving the Schrodinger equation in a non-inertial frame as well as (ii) regarding why PSEST is a necessary step forward towards understanding chemical problems involving spin (with limited practical alternatives). We further high- light some of the many open questions in this fast developing area, which will hopefully inspire new practitioners in this field. This intuitive perspective lacks many equations and is meant to complement (rather than replace) the more technical review given in Bian et al, Chem. Phys. Rev. 7, 011303 (2026)

AI.tldr: 本文追溯了相位空间电子结构理论（PSEST）的发展历史，阐述了它如何从半经典表面跳跃动力学的基础问题中演化而来，成为基于Born-Oppenheimer近似的标准电子结构理论（使用移动而非冻结的原子核）的替代方案。文章以直觉化、少公式的方式向新入行者介绍在非惯性参考系中求解薛定谔方程所涉及的物理，以及PSEST在理解涉及自旋的化学问题中的必要性。
AI.motivation: 为PSEST领域的新入行者提供直观理解，填补标准电子结构理论在处理涉及自旋的化学问题时的局限性，同时补充Bian等人发表的更技术性综述文章。
AI.method: 采用非技术性的直觉化叙述方式，少用方程，重点阐述物理直觉，追溯PSEST的历史发展脉络，并列举该快速发展的领域中的开放问题。
AI.result: 本文是一篇偏重直觉和历史的视角性文章，展示了PSEST如何从半经典表面跳跃动力学的起源演化为一套独立的电子结构理论框架，并指出了该领域面临的若干开放问题。
AI.conclusion: PSEST是理解涉及自旋的化学问题的必要理论发展方向，该领域仍有许多开放问题等待新研究者探索，本文作为一篇互补性文章有利于吸引新实践者进入该领域。

title: COGENT: Counterfactual Gaussian Explanations for Volumetric Medical Images
summary: Explainability is essential for deploying deep learning models in high-stakes medical applications. Existing explainability methods for volumetric imaging predominantly operate in voxel space, overlooking the structured representations introduced by recent advances in 3D scene modeling. We present COGENT (Counterfactual Gaussian Explanations), a framework that generates counterfactual explanations directly in the parameter space of Gaussian-based volumetric representations. Built upon MedGS and the Sybil lung cancer risk prediction model, COGENT optimizes selected Gaussian primitives through a differentiable rendering pipeline, enabling gradients from the downstream predictor to identify representation components that most influence model decisions. Unlike conventional pixel- or voxel-level attribution methods, our approach formulates explainability as a counterfactual optimization problem over an explicit 3D scene representation, producing sparse and spatially localized explanations while preserving anatomical consistency. We evaluate COGENT on lung CT scans using quantitative comparisons with existing explainability methods together with qualitative analysis by medical experts. The results demonstrate that representation-space counterfactual optimization provides clinically meaningful explanations while offering a new perspective on interpreting volumetric deep learning models.

AI.tldr: 提出COGENT框架，在基于高斯的三维体积表示参数空间中生成反事实解释，用于医学体积深度学习模型的可解释性分析。
AI.motivation: 现有医学体积成像的可解释性方法主要在体素空间操作，忽略了三维场景建模中引入的结构化表示。需要一种能够利用显式三维场景表示来生成更具解剖学一致性和临床意义的解释方法。
AI.method: 基于MedGS和Sybil肺癌风险预测模型，通过可微渲染管线优化选定的高斯基元，利用下游预测器的梯度来识别影响模型决策的表示组件。将可解释性定义为显式三维场景表示上的反事实优化问题。
AI.result: 在肺部CT扫描上，通过定量比较现有可解释性方法和医学专家的定性分析进行评估。结果表明表示空间的反事实优化能提供临床有意义的解释。
AI.conclusion: 表示空间的反事实优化为解释体积深度学习模型提供了新视角，生成的解释具有稀疏性、空间局部性和解剖一致性，具有临床价值。

title: Top-down Traffic Scenario Generation via Joint Initial-Goal Diffusion and Trajectory Infilling
comment: Accepted for publication at the IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC), 2026
summary: Robust traffic simulators are crucial for developing and testing autonomous vehicles to reduce the costly, labor-intensive real-world data collection process and the need for physical presence on the road. However, existing simulators require agents' initial states to generate trajectories, which limits scalability and diversity due to restrictions on the given initial states. While data-driven agent initialization has been widely studied, the generated initial states are not interpretable in terms of why the agents are initialized at those specific locations. Given known initial states, trajectory generation is also a challenging problem, as the model must learn the variability of the destination and how agents should reach it over time. In this paper, we propose TrafficDiffuser, a top-down traffic scenario generation framework that generates high-level traffic scenarios, defined by initial and goal state pairs, by jointly modeling them. The high-level scenario generation makes initial states better interpretable and reduces trajectory generation into as simple as an infilling problem. We demonstrate how the generated high-level traffic scenarios can be used, including constraining based on different trajectory modes and integrating them with existing trajectory generation models. We conduct extensive experiments on the Argoverse 2 motion prediction dataset to evaluate how well the generated outputs capture real-world distributions. In addition to generating goal states, TrafficDiffuser outperforms the next-best approach for agent initialization, reducing speed distribution distance by 55.3% and the off-road rate by 2.8%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TrafficDiffuser，一个自顶向下的交通场景生成框架，通过联合建模初始状态和目标状态对来生成高层交通场景，使初始状态更具可解释性，并将轨迹生成简化为插值问题。在Argoverse 2数据集上的实验表明，该方法在速度分布距离上比次优方法降低55.3%，离路率降低2.8%。
AI.motivation: 现有的交通模拟器需要预定义的智能体初始状态才能生成轨迹，这限制了可扩展性和多样性；虽然已有数据中心化的智能体初始化方法，但生成的初始状态缺乏可解释性（即无法解释为何智能体在特定位置初始化）。此外，给定初始状态后的轨迹生成也面临目标可变性和到达方式学习的挑战。
AI.method: 提出TrafficDiffuser框架，采用自顶向下的方式生成高层交通场景，即联合建模初始状态和目标状态对。该方法使初始状态更具可解释性，并将轨迹生成简化为插值填充问题。框架支持基于不同轨迹模式进行约束，并可集成到现有轨迹生成模型中。
AI.result: 在Argoverse 2运动预测数据集上进行大量实验验证生成输出对真实世界分布的捕捉效果。在生成目标状态的同时，TrafficDiffuser在智能体初始化方面优于次优方法，速度分布距离降低55.3%，离路率降低2.8%。
AI.conclusion: TrafficDiffuser通过联合建模初始状态和目标状态对，成功实现了可解释的、更贴近真实分布的交通场景生成，既能提升初始化质量，又能与现有轨迹生成模型无缝集成。

title: Gaze Target Estimation Anywhere with Concepts
comment: CVPR 2026 Code and Benchmark are aviliable at https://github.com/IrohXu/GazeAnywhere and https://huggingface.co/datasets/IrohXu/Gaze-Co-Benchmark
summary: Estimating human gaze targets from images in-the-wild is an important and formidable task. Existing approaches primarily employ brittle, multi-stage pipelines that require explicit inputs, like head bounding boxes and human pose, in order to identify the subject of gaze analysis. As a result, detection errors can cascade and lead to failure. Moreover, these prior works lack the flexibility of specifying the gaze analysis task via natural language prompting, an approach which has been shown to have significant benefits in convenience and scalability for other image analysis tasks. To overcome these limitations, we introduce the Promptable Gaze Target Estimation (PGE) task, a new end-to-end, concept-driven paradigm for gaze analysis. PGE conditions gaze prediction on flexible user text or visual prompts (e.g., "the boy in the red shirt" or "person in point [0.52, 0.48]") to identify a specific subject for gaze analysis. This approach integrates subject localization with gaze estimation, and eliminates the rigid dependency on intermediate analysis stages. We develop a scalable data engine to generate Gaze-Co (Gaze Estimation with Concepts), a dataset and benchmark of 120K high-quality, prompt-annotated image pairs. We also propose GazeAnywhere, the first model designed for PGE. GazeAnywhere uses a transformer-based detector to fuse features from frozen encoders and simultaneously solves subject localization, in/out-of-frame presence, and gaze target heatmap estimation. GazeAnywhere achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple PGE benchmarks, setting a strong baseline for this new problem even on a difficult out-of-domain, real-world clinical dataset. GazeAnywhere is open-sourced in github.com/IrohXu/GazeAnywhere.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种全新的、基于概念驱动的"可提示注视目标估计"(PGE)任务范式，通过自然语言或视觉提示指定注视分析对象，端到端地同时完成主体定位、画面内外判断和注视目标热图估计。作者构建了Gaze-Co数据集（120K提示标注图像对）并提出了GazeAnywhere模型，采用基于Transformer的检测器融合冻结编码器特征，在多个PGE基准上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有注视目标估计方法依赖多阶段、脆弱的流水线（需要头部边界框、人体姿态等显式输入），检测错误会级联放大导致失败；且缺乏通过自然语言提示灵活指定注视分析任务的能第，限制了可扩展性和便捷性。
AI.method: 1) 定义PGE任务：基于文本或视觉提示（如"穿红衣服的男孩"或指定坐标点）定位注视主体并进行注视目标估计。2) 构建可扩展数据引擎生成Gaze-Co数据集（120K高质量提示标注图像对）。3) 提出GazeAnywhere模型：使用Transformer-based检测器融合冻结的编码器特征，同时解决主体定位、画面内外存在性判断和注视目标热图估计三个子任务。
AI.result: GazeAnywhere在多个PGE基准上取得SOTA性能，即使在困难的跨域真实临床数据集上也建立了强基线。
AI.conclusion: GazeAnywhere作为首个PGE模型，验证了概念驱动的注视估计范式的有效性，消除了对中间分析阶段的刚性依赖，并为该新问题设立了强大基线。

title: Inverse Theory of Mind Modeling for Content Recommendation: From Web Browsing to Dynamic Intelligent Interfaces
comment: Preprint for conference full paper at 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys '26), Minneapolis, MN, USA
summary: Modern recommender systems treat observed actions as reliable proxies for user preferences, yet interactions often reflect exploration or comparison rather than stable preference expression. As interfaces evolve from static layouts toward generative UIs and immersive extended reality (XR), the need for deeper, modality-agnostic user understanding grows: these adaptive environments must decide not only what to present but where, when, how prominently, and most importantly why a user acts. We propose an Inverse Theory of Mind (IToM) pipeline that reasons backward from observed interactions to infer the beliefs, preferences, and decision-making traits that explain behavior. The pipeline reconstructs each user's decision context, including what was chosen and what alternatives were available, applies LLM-driven counterfactual reasoning to produce evidence-grounded natural-language belief statements, and synthesizes these beliefs through multi-hypothesis abductive inference into a structured user persona. We evaluate on the OPeRA dataset against ground-truth personality assessments, attitudinal surveys, and interview-based personas across four tasks: next action prediction, shopping attitude alignment, Big Five personality inference, and held-out category prediction. Results show that inferred personas match or exceed ground-truth personas and that multi-hypothesis reasoning is essential for accurate personality prediction. We further demonstrate cross-modal transferability with a persona-driven spatial banking application on VisionOS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种逆心智理论（Inverse Theory of Mind, IToM）pipeline，通过从观察到的交互行为反向推断用户的信念、偏好和决策特质，生成结构化用户画像。在OPeRA数据集上，该方法在四项任务上匹配或超过真实用户画像，并展示了跨模态（VisionOS空间银行应用）的可迁移性。
AI.motivation: 现代推荐系统将观察到的行为视为用户偏好的可靠代理，但交互往往反映探索或比较而非稳定的偏好表达。随着界面从静态布局向生成式UI和沉浸式扩展现实（XR）演变，自适应环境不仅需要决定展示什么，还需要决定在哪里、何时、以何种显著性展示，以及最关键的是用户为何行动。因此需要更深层、跨模态的用户理解。
AI.method: 提出IToM pipeline，包含三个核心步骤：(1) 重建每个用户的决策上下文，包括被选项和可用备选项；(2) 应用LLM驱动的反事实推理，生成基于证据的自然语言信念陈述；(3) 通过多假设溯因推理综合这些信念，形成结构化用户画像。
AI.result: 在OPeRA数据集上，基于四类真实标注（人格评估、态度调查、访谈画像）进行四项任务评估（下一动作预测、购物态度对齐、大五人格推断、留出类别预测）。结果显示推断画像匹配或超过真实画像，且多假设推理对准确的人格预测至关重要。此外展示了在VisionOS上基于画像驱动的空间银行应用的跨模态可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 从交互行为进行逆心智推理能够生成与真实用户画像相当甚至更好的用户理解，多假设推理机制是捕获人格复杂性的关键，且该方法具有跨模态可迁移性，适用于生成式UI和XR等新兴交互界面。

title: Dynamics Models for Offline Hyperparameter Selection in Real-World RL
comment: Accepted to the 2026 Reinforcement Learning Conference (RLC)
summary: A key obstacle to deploying reinforcement learning in real-world systems is hyperparameter selection, particularly when simulators are unavailable and online experimentation is costly. Prior work has proposed calibration models trained on offline data to approximate environment dynamics and enable offline hyperparameter selection, but these methods have so far been evaluated only in simple simulated settings. In this paper, we present the first application of calibration models in a real-world industrial setting: a municipal water treatment plant. We evaluate several calibration model approaches, including a k-nearest neighbors model with a Laplacian distance metric, on high-dimensional, non-stationary sensor data for nexting prediction tasks. Our results show that these models can generate realistic long-horizon rollouts and recover meaningful hyperparameter sensitivity trends. We further examine how calibration models scale to year-long datasets, how they support the selection of fine-tuning learning rates for pre-trained agents, and how robust they are under distribution shift. Overall, our findings provide a proof of concept for using offline dynamics models to support RL deployment in real-world environments, while highlighting important practical challenges for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将校准模型（calibration models）应用于真实工业场景——市政水处理厂，验证了离线动力学模型在高维非平稳传感器数据上能够为强化学习（RL）超参数选择提供支持。实验表明，包括带Laplacian距离度量的k近邻模型在内的多种校准方法，能生成逼真的长视距rollout并恢复有意义的超参数敏感性趋势，同时在年规模数据扩展、预训练智能体微调学习率选择和分布偏移鲁棒性方面提供了概念验证及其实践挑战。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在真实系统部署中的关键障碍是超参数选择，尤其在无仿真器且在线实验成本高昂的情况下。已有的校准模型方法仅在简单模拟环境中被评估，尚未在真实工业场景中验证其有效性。
AI.method: 在真实市政水处理厂中，对高维、非平稳的传感器数据进行nexting预测任务，评估多种校准模型方法（包括使用Laplacian距离度量的k近邻模型），并检验模型在年尺度数据集上的扩展性、对预训练智能体微调学习率选择的支撑能力，以及在分布偏移下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 校准模型能够生成真实感强的长视距rollout，并恢复有意义的超参数敏感性趋势；在年规模数据上具备可扩展性，且能在分布偏移条件下保持一定鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为使用离线动力学模型支持RL在真实环境中的部署提供了概念验证，同时揭示了若干重要的实际挑战，为未来研究指明了方向。

title: Apodex Discovery: Reality Benchmarks and Environments for Evaluating and Building Discoverative Artificial Intelligence
summary: Apollo did not reach the Moon merely because its engineers could solve difficult equations. It succeeded by turning a distant ambition into a mission architecture of explicit objectives, simulation, verification, and repeated correction. AI now faces a similar transition: frontier models can solve difficult tasks once the problem, tools, and success criteria are specified, yet consequential real-world challenges rarely arrive in an executable or verifiable form. We introduce Apodex Discovery, a framework for building and evaluating discoverative AI through the heavy-duty solver, a system comprising a foundation model, harness, tools, and control policies that pursues extended, stateful, verifiable investigations. It has three core components. First, a problem-scouting process surveyed 561 industries across 16 sectors, assembled 423 high-value real-world problems, and selected 20 for the initial release. Second, a common environment-task-episode abstraction provides data, tools, constraints, feedback, trajectory recording, and verification of intermediate artifacts and final submissions. Third, HDS6 evaluates Tools, Repair, Alternatives, Coherence, Evidence, and Scope independently of final-task success. In AAV capsid design, Apodex surpassed the published state of the art by 7% across viability, tropism, structure prediction, and generative design. In drug repurposing and reformulation, a task-specific biomedical environment improved the mean normalized prediction score of GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.6-sol by 2.5 and 7.6 points over the same closed-book backbone. Controlled ablations show that the fixed TRACES episode interface enables attribution of performance differences to specific solver components. Apodex Discovery moves AI evaluation beyond predefined benchmarks toward verifiable investigations aimed at genuine discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Apodex Discovery框架，用于构建和评估"发现型AI"（discoverative AI）。该框架包含三个核心组件：问题侦察流程（调研561个行业、420余个高价值问题并筛选出20个）、统一的环境-任务-片段抽象（提供数据、工具、反馈、轨迹记录与验证），以及独立于最终任务成功率的HDS6评估体系（覆盖工具、修复、替代方案、一致性、证据和范围六个维度）。实验表明其在AAV衣壳设计和药物重定位/再配方任务上均超越当前最优水平。
AI.motivation: 与阿波罗登月计划相似，当今AI虽然能在问题、工具和成功标准被明确指定时解决困难任务，但现实世界中的重大挑战很少以可执行或可验证的形式呈现在AI面前。因此需要将AI评估从预定义基准测试扩展到面向真实发现的、可验证的调查性任务上。
AI.method: Apodex Discovery框架的核心是"重型求解器"（HDS6），由基础模型、操作台（harness）、工具和控制策略组成。三个核心组件分别是：(1) 问题侦察：系统化扫描561个行业/16个部门，汇编423个高价值现实问题并筛选20个用于初始发布；(2) 统一环境-任务-片段（EPISODE）抽象：提供数据、工具、约束、反馈、轨迹记录及中间产物和最终提交的验证；(3) HDS6评估体系：独立于最终任务成功，分别评估工具使用、修复能力、替代方案、一致性、证据和范围六个维度。
AI.result: 在AAV衣壳设计中，Apodex在存活性、趋向性、结构预测和生成设计方面比已发表的当前最优结果高出7%。在药物重定位与再配方任务中，专用的生物医学环境使GPT-5.5和GPT-5.6-sol的平均归一化预测得分比相同闭卷基础模型分别提升2.5和7.6个点。受控消融实验表明，固定的TRACES片段接口可以将性能差异归因于特定的求解器组件。
AI.conclusion: Apodex Discovery标志着AI评估范式从预定义基准测试（predefined benchmarks）向可验证调查（verifiable investigations）和真正科学发现的转变，为AI在实际科学与工业问题上的发现能力提供了系统化的构建与评估框架。

title: Dual-Domain Cross-Modal Decoding for Clinical Text-Guided Medical Image Segmentation
comment: Accepted at MICCAI 2026 (Main). Final version to appear in the MICCAI 2026 proceedings
summary: Clinical text can narrow down what to segment, but recent text-guided designs emphasize spatial alignment while overlooking frequency content that governs texture and boundaries. We propose Dual-Domain Cross-Modal Decoding (DD-CMD) for clinical text-guided pulmonary infection segmentation, integrating two complementary forms of language guidance during decoding. In the spatial domain, Text-Guided Spatial Cross-Attention (TGSA) aligns multi-scale visual tokens with text semantics and updates features through gated residual fusion. In the frequency domain, Spectral-Text Adaptive Modulation (STAM) applies a 2D DCT to compute learnable band-energy statistics and predicts text-conditioned FiLM parameters to recalibrate decoder channels for frequency-aware decoding. DD-CMD embeds TGSA and STAM into a coarse-to-fine decoder (7x7 to 56x56) and restores full-resolution masks using a lightweight two-stage refinement module. Experiments on QaTa-COV19 and MosMedData+ show that DD-CMD achieves 91.46% Dice / 84.26% mIoU and 81.95% Dice / 69.42% mIoU, respectively, with average gains of +1.96 Dice and +2.67 mIoU over the strongest prior baselines. Code: https://github.com/maklachur/DD-CMD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DD-CMD（双域跨模态解码）方法用于临床文本引导的肺部感染分割，在空间域通过文本引导空间交叉注意力（TGSA）对齐多尺度视觉token与文本语义，在频域通过频谱-文本自适应调制（STAM）利用2D DCT计算频带能量统计并预测文本条件FiLM参数进行频感知解码。在QaTa-COV19和MosMedData+数据集上分别达到91.46% Dice/84.26% mIoU和81.95% Dice/69.42% mIoU，平均比最强基线提升+1.96 Dice和+2.67 mIoU。
AI.motivation: 现有文本引导的医学图像分割方法主要关注空间对齐，忽视了控制纹理和边界的频率信息，导致分割精度受限。作者旨在将空间域和频域的语言引导整合到解码过程中，以更全面地利用临床文本先验信息。
AI.method: DD-CMD包含两大核心模块：(1)空间域TGSA，通过文本引导的空间交叉注意力对齐多尺度视觉token与文本语义，并使用门控残差融合更新特征；(2)频域STAM，应用2D DCT计算可学习的频带能量统计，预测文本条件下的FiLM参数以重校准解码器通道。两者嵌入粗到细解码器（7x7到56x56），并用轻量级两阶段细化模块恢复全分辨率掩码。
AI.result: 在QaTa-COV19上达91.46% Dice/84.26% mIoU，在MosMedData+上达81.95% Dice/69.42% mIoU，平均比最强先验基线提升+1.96 Dice和+2.67 mIoU。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过同时利用空间域和频域两种互补的文本引导方式，DD-CMD有效提升了临床文本引导的肺部感染分割性能，验证了频域信息在文本引导分割中的价值，超越了现有强基线方法。

title: Spectral graph clustering with inhomogeneous latent geometry
summary: We study spectral clustering in the presence of a confounding latent geometry. The leading eigenvectors may then be dominated by the latent geometry rather than by the communities. Nevertheless, we show in a block latent-space model that communities can be recovered from eigenvectors deeper in the spectrum. We analyze the spectral properties of the adjacency matrix through a limiting integral operator and use its structure to develop DBSPEC, a density-based spectral clustering algorithm that requires only approximate localization of the informative eigenvalue and is robust to poor eigenvalue separation. Crucially, this approach handles general latent geometries, overcoming restrictions to homogeneous toroidal models in prior works. Our theoretical predictions for the location of the informative eigenvalue notably align with observations in real-world experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了混合潜在几何存在下的谱聚类问题。在块潜在空间模型中，证明社区可以从谱中更深的特征向量中恢复，并提出DBSPEC算法——一种仅需近似定位信息特征值、对特征值分离不敏感且能处理一般潜在几何的基于密度的谱聚类算法。
AI.motivation: 传统谱聚类在存在混淆性潜在几何时会失效，因为前导特征向量被潜在几何主导而非社区结构。已有方法局限于均匀环面模型，无法处理一般潜在几何，需要更通用的解决方案。
AI.method: 作者在块潜在空间模型中分析邻接矩阵的谱性质，通过极限积分算子来刻画谱结构，据此开发DBSPEC（基于密度的谱聚类算法）。该算法仅需近似定位信息特征值，对特征值分离质量不敏感，可处理一般潜在几何而无需假设特殊的均匀拓扑结构。
AI.result: 理论预测的信息特征值位置与真实世界实验观察结果一致，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 在潜在几何干扰下，社区信息并非仅存于前导特征向量中，而是可以通过谱中更深层次的特征向量恢复；DBSPEC算法为一般潜在几何下的谱聚类提供了稳健且通用的解决方案。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Compositional Localization and Placement Assessment of Catheters and Tubes in Chest X-Rays
summary: Assessing catheter and tube placement on chest X-rays is safety-critical yet tedious and error-prone. Current deep learning methods either classify placement globally -- losing track of which device is where -- or segment all devices into a single mask, making per-device assessment impossible when catheters overlap. We introduce UCompCXR, a compositional framework that detects local catheter fragments, associates them into device instances via graph-based clustering, fuses per-fragment tip predictions through precision-weighted Gaussian estimation, and classifies placement per device. On the RANZCR CLiP dataset (30,083 images, 5-fold patient-level CV with bootstrap CIs), UCompCXR detects 26% more devices than a strong multi-task baseline sharing the same MobileNetV3 backbone, with 75% fewer false positives and well-calibrated tip uncertainty (95% coverage = 0.948). The aggregate tip error rises -- but only because the model finds devices the baseline misses entirely, especially nasogastric tubes. On matched devices, catastrophic localization failures drop substantially. At 2.27M parameters in a single forward pass, the model is deployable on resource-constrained clinical hardware.

AI.tldr: UCompCXR是一个成分组合式框架，用于在胸部X光片上检测和评估导管与管路放置情况。它通过检测局部导管碎片、图聚类将其关联为设备实例、精度加权高斯估计融合尖端预测，并对每个设备进行分类放置评估。在RANZCR CLiP数据集上，相比共享相同MobileNetV3骨干的多任务基线，设备检测率提升26%，假阳性减少75%，尖端不确定性校准良好（95%覆盖率=0.948），且仅2.27M参数，可部署于资源受限的临床硬件。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法在评估胸部X光片导管放置时存在局限：全局分类方法无法定位具体设备位置，而单掩膜分割方法在导管重叠时无法进行逐设备评估。作者旨在解决这一安全关键但繁琐易错的临床任务中"设备级"评估能力缺失的问题。
AI.method: 提出UCompCXR成分组合式框架，包含四个步骤：(1) 检测局部导管碎片；(2) 通过基于图的聚类将碎片关联为设备实例；(3) 通过精度加权高斯估计融合每个碎片的尖端预测；(4) 对每个设备实例进行放置分类评估。
AI.result: 在RANZCR CLiP数据集（30,083张图像，5折患者级交叉验证并带bootstrap置信区间）上，UCompCXR相比共享MobileNetV3骨干的强多任务基线：检测出多26%的设备，假阳性减少75%，尖端不确定性校准良好（95%覆盖率=0.948）。聚合尖端误差有所上升——但仅因为模型发现了基线完全遗漏的设备（尤其是鼻胃管）。在匹配设备上，灾难性定位失败大幅减少。模型仅2.27M参数，单次前向传播即可部署。
AI.conclusion: UCompCXR通过成分组合的方式实现了逐设备级的导管放置评估，在检测能力和定位可靠性上显著优于多任务基线，同时保持轻量级架构适合临床硬件部署。尽管聚合误差看似升高，实则是检测更全面的副产品，具有实际临床应用价值。

title: Uncertainty-Aware and Explainable Ensemble Deep Learning Framework for Multi-Class Skin Lesion Classification
summary: Skin cancer diagnosis from dermoscopic images remains challenging due to high intra-class variability, inter-class similarity, class imbalance, and the limited interpretability of deep learning models. This paper proposes an uncertainty-aware and explainable deep learning framework for multi-class skin lesion classification. The framework combines a vision transformer model (MaxViT-Tiny) with CNN-based models (ConvNeXt-Tiny and EfficientNetV2-B0) through deep ensemble learning. Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout estimates predictive uncertainty and identifies unreliable predictions, while Grad-CAM++, an explainable AI (XAI) technique, provides visual explanations by highlighting lesion regions that influence model decisions. Evaluated on the HAM10000 dataset, the framework achieves 96% accuracy and 99% ROC-AUC under uncertainty-aware filtering (entropy < 1.0, confidence >= 0.7), with macro-average precision, recall, and F1-score of 94%, 95%, and 95%, respectively, and 96% weighted-average scores across all three metrics. The results demonstrate accurate, interpretable, and uncertainty-aware skin lesion classification for trustworthy computer-aided diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合不确定性感知与可解释性的深度学习框架用于多类皮肤病变分类，通过深度集成MaxViT-Tiny、ConvNeXt-Tiny和EfficientNetV2-B0三种模型，并利用MC Dropout估计预测不确定性、Grad-CAM++提供可视化解释。在HAM10000数据集上，在不确定性过滤条件下（熵<1.0，置信度>=0.7）达到96%准确率和99% ROC-AUC，宏平均精确率、召回率和F1分别为94%、95%和95%。
AI.motivation: 皮肤镜图像中的皮肤癌诊断面临类内变异大、类间相似性高、类别不平衡以及深度学习模型可解释性有限等挑战，因此需要更准确且可解释的诊断方法。
AI.method: 采用深度集成学习框架，组合视觉Transformer模型（MaxViT-Tiny）与CNN模型（ConvNeXt-Tiny、EfficientNetV2-B0）进行多类皮肤病变分类；使用MC Dropout估计预测不确定性以识别不可靠预测；采用Grad-CAM++ XAI技术突出影响模型决策的病灶区域，提供视觉解释。
AI.result: 在HAM10000数据集上，经过不确定性感知过滤（熵<1.0，置信度>=0.7）后，框架实现96%准确率和99% ROC-AUC，宏平均精确率、召回率、F1分别为94%、95%、95%，三个指标的加权平均均达96%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了准确、可解释且具有不确定性感知能力的皮肤病变分类，为可信赖的计算机辅助诊断提供了有力支撑。

title: Knowledge-Graph-Guided Retrieval-Augmented LLMs for Explainable Root Cause Analysis in Automotive HiL Validation
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted for publication and oral presentation at the 10th International Conference on System Reliability and Safety (ICSRS 2026), Rome, Italy, November 23--25, 2026
summary: Hardware-in-the-Loop validation of automotive software systems generates large multivariate time-series recordings whose manual analysis is time-consuming and often limited to anomaly detection and fault classification rather than root-cause analysis. Although deep learning methods have shown strong performance in fault detection and classification, they usually require task-specific training or retraining when new fault locations, systems, or operating conditions are introduced. They also tend to treat localization as a classification task, without explicitly representing the spatial and functional relationships between fault locations, sensors, and downstream subsystem effects. This limits their generalizability and their usefulness for engineering root cause analysis and diagnosis. This paper proposes a knowledge-graph-guided retrieval-augmented large language model framework for RCA (root cause analysis) and fault localization in automotive HiL data. The method converts raw time-series recordings into compact diagnostic evidence, enriches this evidence with sensor-to-location and propagation knowledge, and retrieves similar historical cases to support the final reasoning step. The LLM is then used as a decision and explanation layer rather than as a direct time-series classifier, producing a ranked fault-location prediction together with an interpretable RCA explanation. The framework is evaluated on two automotive HiL case studies: an ASM gasoline engine and an electric vehicle system. The best-performing model achieves Top-1 accuracies of 90\% and 94\%, respectively, while recording-level aggregation reaches perfect file-level fault localization in the evaluated subset. These results demonstrate the potential of KG-guided RAG-LLM reasoning for explainable and generalizable HiL RCA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个知识图谱引导的检索增强大语言模型（KG-guided RAG-LLM）框架，用于汽车硬件在环（HiL）测试中多变量时间序列数据的根因分析（RCA）和故障定位。该方法将原始时间序列转换为诊断证据，结合传感器-位置-传播知识，检索历史相似案例，利用LLM作为决策与解释层输出排名的故障位置预测及可解释的RCA说明。在汽油发动机和电动汽车两个HiL案例中，Top-1准确率分别达90%和94%。
AI.motivation: 现有汽车HiL系统验证产生大规模多变量时间序列数据，人工分析耗时且多限于异常检测和故障分类而非根因分析。深度学习方法虽性能好，但需要任务特定的训练或重训练，且将定位视为分类任务，缺乏对故障位置、传感器和下游子系统效应之间空间与功能关系的显式表示，限制了泛化性和工程诊断实用性。
AI.method: 框架包含三个核心步骤：(1) 将原始时间序列记录转换为紧凑的诊断证据；(2) 利用传感器-位置映射和故障传播知识丰富证据（知识图谱引导）；(3) 检索相似历史案例以支持最终推理。LLM作为决策和解释层，而非直接的时间序列分类器，生成排名的故障位置预测及可解释的RCA解释。
AI.result: 在两个汽车HiL案例（ASM汽油发动机和电动汽车系统）上评估，最佳模型Top-1准确率分别达到90%和94%；记录级聚合在评估子集上实现了完美的文件级故障定位。
AI.conclusion: KG引导的RAG-LLM推理框架在可解释性和泛化性方面均展现了用于HiL根因分析的潜力，为汽车软件系统的自动化诊断提供了有效方案。

title: Geometry-Based Compression of Plenoptic Point Clouds
summary: Plenoptic point clouds (PPC) are novel data structures that represent the light from different viewing directions in order to provide a higher degree of realism to regular point clouds. This is achieved by associating each point to multiple colors instead of a single one. Here, we present a method to efficiently compress the attributes of a PPC, consisting of a Karhunen-Loève transform over the color attributes followed by multiple attribute coders with intra prediction capability. This compression scheme can be incorporated within the MPEG's geometry-based PCC (G-PCC) standard, using any of G-PCC's existing solutions for attribute coding. Compression performance assessment using PPCs of different spatial resolutions reveals competitive results in comparison to existing methods, such as RAHT-based or video-based PCC solutions. We believe our coder to be the new state of the art.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于Karhunen-Loève变换的多平面点云(PPC)属性压缩方法，将KLT应用于颜色属性后接多个带帧内预测能力的属性编码器，可集成到MPEG G-PCC标准中，实验结果显示其性能优于RAHT和基于视频的PCC方法，作者声称达到了新的最优水平。
AI.motivation: 多平面点云(PPC)作为一种新型数据结构，通过为每个点关联多个颜色来表示不同视角的光线，从而提供比普通点云更高的真实感。然而，这种多颜色属性带来了更大的数据量，需要高效的压缩方法来处理PPC的属性数据。
AI.method: 该方法首先对颜色属性进行Karhunen-Loève变换(KLT)以去除色彩间的相关性，然后使用多个具备帧内预测能力的属性编码器对变换后的系数进行编码。整个压缩方案可以嵌入MPEG的G-PCC标准框架中，并可复用G-PCC现有的任意属性编码方案。
AI.result: 在不同空间分辨率的PPC数据上进行压缩性能评估，结果表明该方法相比现有的RAHT和基于视频的PCC方案具有竞争力的性能表现。作者声称该编码器达到了当前最优水平。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明KLT结合多个预测型属性编码器能够有效压缩PPC属性数据，并且可以与G-PCC标准兼容，为PPC压缩提供了新的最优方案。

title: Hardware-Aware Deployment of Joint SAR Compression and Despeckling on FPGA
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing (TGRS). 11 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables
summary: Next-generation Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) missions will generate data far faster than they can downlink, making onboard data reduction essential for near-real-time Earth observation. Learned Image Compression (LIC) offers better rate-distortion performance than handcrafted codecs used operationally today, and recent work shows that simultaneously despeckling and compressing SAR imagery enables better representation capacity while unlocking higher compression rates. These methods, however, have yet to be confronted with the strict power, compute, and operational constraints of spaceborne systems. In this work, we bridge this gap by deploying a joint SAR Despeckling and Data Compression (DDC) framework on an embedded ZCU102 FPGA-based platform, introducing model adaptations that respect the accelerator's fixed-point arithmetic and limited set of supported operations. We evaluate four model topologies across precision levels and across CPU, GPU, and FPGA platforms, revealing several findings with direct design implications. We find that replacing conventional GDN activation functions with plain ReLU improves quality on SAR, suggesting that design principles established for compression of natural images do not necessarily transfer to SAR imagery. In addition, we demonstrate that residual blocks offer little representational benefit for ten times the compute, and show that the FPGA is the most energy-efficient of the platforms tested. Together, these results set a functioning edge deployment workflow and an evidence-based starting point for onboard SAR compression. The code is available at https://github.com/CedricLeon/SAR_DDC_FPGA.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将联合SAR去斑与数据压缩（DDC）框架部署到基于ZCU102的嵌入式FPGA平台上，验证了其在星载系统严格功耗和计算约束下的可行性。研究发现ReLU替代GDN激活函数能提升SAR图像质量、残差块性价比低、FPGA是测试平台中能效最优的。
AI.motivation: 下一代SAR任务产生的数据远超下行链路传输能力，星载数据压缩对近实时对地观测至关重要。虽然已有工作表明联合去斑与压缩的LIC方法优于传统编解码器，但这些方法尚未经过星载系统严格功耗、计算和操作约束的验证，存在从算法到实际部署的鸿沟。
AI.method: 将联合SAR去斑和数据压缩（DDC）框架部署于基于ZCU102 FPGA的嵌入式平台，针对加速器的定点算术和有限支持操作集进行模型适配。评估四种模型拓扑结构，跨精度级别以及CPU、GPU、FPGA三种平台进行对比实验。
AI.result: 发现用ReLU替代传统GDN激活函数在SAR图像上提升了质量；残差块以十倍计算量仅带来极少的表示能力增益；FPGA在测试平台中能效最高。
AI.conclusion: 建立了可用的边缘部署工作流程，为星载SAR压缩提供了基于证据的设计起点，表明面向自然图像压缩的设计原则不一定能迁移到SAR图像场景。

title: Glance, Scrutinize, and Think: Advancing Video Anomaly Detection from Training-Free to Agentic Reasoning
comment: 34 pages, 8 figures, 8 tables. Journal extension of our AAAI 2026 paper (arXiv:2507.21507)
summary: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) aims to identify anomalous events and localize their temporal intervals. Existing approaches exhibit a "when-what" dissociation: traditional DNN-based methods localize when anomalies occur but lack semantic understanding, whereas LLM-based methods explain what happens but neglect precise temporal grounding. We attribute this to the absence of a unified reasoning paradigm. Inspired by how humans inspect surveillance videos - glancing globally to form temporal hypotheses, scrutinizing suspicious segments, and thinking iteratively to correct errors - we study this global-to-local paradigm from two perspectives. We first propose Glance then Scrutinize (GtS), a training-free framework using static and dynamic textual guidance for coarse-to-fine anomaly grounding and understanding, balancing accuracy and speed. To break the ceiling imposed by frozen external modules, we further propose a tool-augmented agentic VAD method, where a multimodal large language model learns to invoke a video cropping tool, inspect densely resampled frames, and self-correct mislocalized hypotheses, via cold-start supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning with a joint answer-grounding reward. For training and evaluation, we extend our prior VAGU benchmark into VAGU-T (Video Anomaly Grounding, Understanding, and Thinking), comprising 7,567 real-world videos over 21 anomaly categories with human-validated grounding, explanations, QA pairs, and chain-of-thought tool-calling traces. We further introduce JeAUG, a metric jointly evaluating semantic interpretability and temporal precision. Experiments show that GtS substantially surpasses training-free baselines, while the agentic model delivers both higher accuracy and faster inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种全局到局部的推理范式来解决视频异常检测(VAD)中"何时"与"什么"的割裂问题。作者先提出GtS（先概览后细查），一个无需训练的粗到细异常定位与理解框架；进一步提出工具增强的智能体VAD方法，让多模态大语言模型学会调用视频裁剪工具、检查密集重采样帧并进行自纠正。同时扩展了VAGU基准为VAGU-T（含7,567个真实视频、21类异常），并引入联合评估语义可解释性与时间精度的指标JeAUG。
AI.motivation: 现有VAD方法存在"when-what"割裂：传统DNN方法能定位异常发生的时间但缺乏语义理解，而LLM方法能解释异常内容但忽略精确的时间定位。作者将此归因于缺乏统一的推理范式，受人类审查监控视频的方式启发（全局浏览形成时间假设→细查可疑片段→迭代思考纠正错误），希望弥合时间定位与语义理解之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 本文提出两条技术路线：(1) GtS——无需训练的框架，利用静态与动态文本引导实现粗到细的异常定位与理解，兼顾精度与速度；(2) 工具增强的智能体VAD方法——多模态大语言模型学习调用视频裁剪工具、检查密集重采样帧、自我纠正错位假设，通过冷启动监督微调加联合回答-定位奖励的强化学习训练。同时构建VAGU-T基准（含人工验证的grounding、解释、QA对及思维链工具调用轨迹）并提出JeAUG联合评估指标。
AI.result: 实验表明GtS大幅超越无需训练的基线方法；智能体模型在获得更高准确率的同时推理速度更快。VAGU-T基准和JeAUG指标为该领域提供了新的评测标准。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过模拟人类"先概览后细查"的监控视频检查方式，建立了统一的全局到局部推理范式，有效解决了VAD中时间定位与语义理解割裂的问题，并提供了更全面的基准和评估指标，为后续研究奠定了基础。

title: ESVR: 3D Ellipsoid-based Sparse Volume Rendering via Structure-aware Primitive Learning and Per-primitive Ray Sampling
summary: Efficient representation and rendering of large-scale sparse volumetric data remain challenging in scientific visualization, as meaningful structures often occupy only a small fraction of the spatial domain. While direct volume rendering (DVR) provides high-quality visualization, its computational and memory costs scale poorly with data size. Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) address this challenge by representing volumetric scenes with compact geometric primitives, enabling efficient, high-fidelity rendering. However, existing 3DGS-based methods learn from DVR rendered images rather than raw volumes, leading to information loss and limiting flexible transfer function control for interactive exploration. To address these limitations, we propose ESVR, an ellipsoid-based sparse volume rendering framework that directly learns and renders volumetric data in 3D space. Our method combines differentiable ellipsoidal primitives with bounded support, structure-aware primitive learning with complementary pruning, and a per-primitive ray sampling strategy for fast and accurate transfer function mapping. To support large-scale datasets, we further introduce a chunk-based optimization scheme with ghost ellipsoids, providing boundary context during training. Across large sparse datasets, ESVR achieves up to four orders of magnitude compression and real-time rendering at 43-223 FPS while maintaining competitive reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: ESVR提出了一种基于椭球体基元的稀疏体数据直接渲染框架，直接从原始体素数据学习而非从DVR渲染图像中学习，支持灵活的传递函数控制和交互式探索，在大型稀疏数据集上实现高达四个数量级的压缩和43-223 FPS的实时渲染。
AI.motivation: 大规模稀疏体数据的有效表示与渲染是科学可视化的挑战性难题。直接体渲染(DVR)虽提供高质量可视化，但其计算和内存开销随数据规模增长而急剧扩大。现有3DGS方法虽然通过紧凑几何基元实现了高效渲染，但它们是从DVR渲染图像而非原始体数据中学习，导致信息丢失，并限制了交互式探索中传递函数的灵活控制能力。
AI.method: ESVR框架包含以下核心组件：(1)具有有界支撑的可微椭球体基元，直接在3D空间学习体数据；(2)结构感知的基元学习与互补剪枝策略；(3)逐基元光线采样策略，实现快速准确的传递函数映射；(4)基于块(chunk)的优化方案与ghost椭球体，在训练期间提供边界上下文以支持大规模数据集。
AI.result: 在大型稀疏数据集上，ESVR实现了高达四个数量级的压缩比，并达到43-223 FPS的实时渲染性能，同时保持具有竞争力的重建质量。
AI.conclusion: ESVR通过直接从原始体数据学习椭球体表示，克服了现有3DGS方法依赖DVR渲染图像而导致信息丢失和传递函数控制受限的问题，为大规模稀疏体数据的高效表示与交互式可视化提供了一种可行方案。

title: From Sports to Safety: Benchmarking Proactive Risk Inference in MLLMs
summary: Timely anticipation of physical hazards is essential for real-world safety, yet existing MLLM evaluations focus on harmful content or general risks, leaving proactive physical hazard prediction underexplored. Sports provide a well-suited testbed: accident causes span diverse injury dimensions and pre-accident spatiotemporal cues draw on reasoning capabilities shared with broader safety domains such as autonomous driving and fall detection. We introduce SPRINT (Sports Proactive Risk INference Testbed), a benchmark of 2,888 real-world sports videos (2,440 accident, 448 safe controls) spanning 14 sports and 3 environmental settings. Accident videos feature fine-grained annotations of early hazard cues, accident timing, and hierarchical causes; safe videos are manually verified as accident-free and serve to diagnose prompt-induced false alarms. Evaluating state-of-the-art MLLMs under diverse prompts and temporal windows reveals a sharp gap between hazard sensitivity and understanding: the best model exceeds 95% in signaling hazards yet falls below 50% in identifying their causes. Diagnostic experiments further show that explicit danger queries trigger severe false alarms even on hazard-free videos. These findings indicate that current MLLMs exhibit only superficial proactive safety, lacking stable, cause-grounded early warning, and underscore the need for reliable proactive safety in dynamic physical environments. Data and code will be open-sourced upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPRINT基准测试集，包含2,888个真实世界体育视频（2,440个事故视频、448个安全对照视频），覆盖14种运动与3种环境，用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在物理危险主动预判方面的能力。研究发现当前最先进的MLLM在危险信号感知上可超过95%准确率，但在识别事故原因上低于50%，且显式危险查询会引发严重误报，表明现有模型仅具备表面性的主动安全能力。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM评测主要关注有害内容识别或一般性风险评估，缺乏对积极主动物理危险预判的评估。而及时预判物理危险对现实世界安全至关重要，体育视频提供了理想测试场景，因为其事故成因覆盖多种伤害维度，且事故前的时空线索推理能力可与自动驾驶、跌倒检测等更广泛的安全领域共享。
AI.method: 构建SPRINT基准：收集2,888个真实世界体育视频，包含2,440个事故视频（带有早期危险线索、事故时间点、层级化事故原因的细粒度标注）和448个经人工验证无事故的安全对照视频（用于诊断提示引发的误报）。在不同提示语和时空窗口设置下评估多种最先进的MLLM模型。
AI.result: 最优模型在信号危险方面超过95%的准确率，但在识别事故原因方面低于50%。诊断实验进一步表明，显式的危险查询会在无事故视频上诱发严重的误报。
AI.conclusion: 当前MLLM仅表现出表面的主动安全能力，缺乏稳定、基于因果推理的早期预警能力。这凸显了在动态物理环境中实现可靠主动安全的必要性。

title: OmniMech: All-in-one Multimodal Mechanical Benchmark for 3D Reconstruction
summary: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) can generate executable CAD programs from images, but existing methods mainly target coarse, general-purpose 3D objects and rarely address the fine-grained geometry and millimeter-level tolerances required in industrial mechanical design. We introduce OmniMech, the first million-scale benchmark for evaluating VLMs on executable CAD generation from industrial manufacturing data. OmniMech contains more than 251,000 fully dimensioned and toleranced 2D orthographic drawings, paired with native CAD models, multi-view renderings, mesh, STEP and B-rep representations, and rich semantic annotations. The benchmark includes four tasks: (1) parametric CAD program synthesis from engineering drawings; (2) diagram-to-3D reasoning for geometrically and structurally consistent reconstruction; (3) annotation-grounded reasoning over dimensions, symbols, feature callouts, and manufacturing constraints; and (4) tool-augmented agentic reasoning using visualization, measurement, CAD execution, and verification tools. Experiments show that current VLMs and CAD-specialized models still struggle with executable program synthesis, fine-grained 3D reconstruction, and reliable enforcement of dimensions and tolerances. We will release the benchmark data, evaluation code, and tool interfaces to support future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OmniMech，首个百万级规模的工业制造CAD生成基准，包含251,000+张带完整尺寸和公差标注的2D工程图纸，配套原生CAD模型、多视角渲染、网格、STEP和B-rep表示及丰富语义标注，并定义四项核心任务。实验表明当前VLM和CAD专用模型在可执行程序合成、细粒度3D重建及尺寸公差约束执行上仍存在显著不足。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型（VLM）虽然能从图像生成可执行的CAD程序，但主要针对粗粒度的通用3D物体，未能覆盖工业机械设计中对细粒度几何和毫米级公差的要求，缺乏专门的工业级基准来评估VLM在这方面的能力。
AI.method: 构建OmniMech基准数据集：包含超过251,000个完全标注尺寸和公差的2D正交工程图纸，与原生CAD模型、多视图渲染、网格、STEP和B-rep表示及丰富语义标注配对。定义四个评估任务：(1)从工程图纸合成参数化CAD程序；(2)图表到3D推理实现几何和结构一致的3D重建；(3)基于标注的尺寸、符号、特征标注和制造约束推理；(4)利用可视化、测量、CAD执行和验证工具进行工具增强的智能体推理。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，当前的VLM和CAD专用模型在可执行程序合成、细粒度3D重建以及尺寸和公差的可靠执行方面仍然表现不佳，暴露了现有模型在该领域的主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: OmniMech填补了工业级CAD生成评估的空白，将公开基准数据、评估代码和工具接口以支持未来研究，推动VLM在工业机械设计领域的细粒度CAD生成与推理能力发展。

title: HERA: Historical Evidence Routing Adapter for Physical Prediction in Latent World Models
summary: Predictive video models have emerged as promising world models by learning latent visual dynamics from large-scale video. Yet these models remain challenged by physical events under occlusion, where later predictions may depend on object evidence that is no longer available in the current view. Addressing this challenge requires historical evidence not only to be preserved but also to remain accessible when it becomes relevant to a subsequent prediction. Existing approaches mainly enlarge the temporal context, cache generic video features, or impose explicit object-centric states, thereby improving the capacity or structure of retained history. However, they do not directly address how relevant historical evidence can be selectively retrieved and integrated into a pretrained predictor without interfering with its native latent workspace. Accordingly, we introduce HERA (Historical Evidence Routing Adapter), a framework for routing retained historical evidence into a frozen latent predictor, and instantiate it with Register-Routed Patch Memory (RRPM), a lightweight adapter comprising a Structured Memory Bank, Memory Registers, and Workspace Registers. On the IntPhys2 Main split, HERA with RRPM improves the pairwise AvgSurprise accuracy of V-JEPA 2-G from 52.57% to 54.35%. Subgroup analysis shows particularly strong improvements on fixed-camera continuity, from 46.15% to 57.69%, and fixed-camera immutability, from 46.15% to 63.46%. These results support historical evidence routing as a practical adaptation strategy for physical prediction in latent world models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HERA（Historical Evidence Routing Adapter）框架，通过寄存器路由适配器（RRPM）将保留的历史证据选择性路由到冻结的潜在预测模型中，解决遮挡下物理事件预测依赖不可见证据的问题。在IntPhys2 Main基准上将V-JEPA 2-G的AvgSurprise准确率从52.57%提升至54.35%，尤其在固定相机连续性和不变性任务上分别提升至57.69%和63.46%。
AI.motivation: 现有预测视频模型在遮挡条件下难以预测物理事件，因为后续预测可能依赖当前视角已不可见的物体证据。现有方法通过扩大时间上下文、缓存通用视频特征或施加显式对象中心状态来改进历史保留，但未直接解决如何选择性检索相关历史证据并集成到预训练预测器中，而不干扰其原生潜在工作空间的问题。
AI.method: HERA框架将保留的历史证据路由到冻结的潜在预测器中，具体实例化为RRPM（Register-Routed Patch Memory）轻量适配器，包含三个组件：结构化记忆库（Structured Memory Bank）、记忆寄存器（Memory Registers）和工作区寄存器（Workspace Registers），实现历史证据的选择性检索与集成。
AI.result: 在IntPhys2 Main分割上，HERA with RRPM将V-JEPA 2-G的成对AvgSurprise准确率从52.57%提升到54.35%。子组分析显示固定相机连续性从46.15%提升到57.69%，固定相机不变性从46.15%提升到63.46%，改进显著。
AI.conclusion: 历史证据路由是一种实用的适应策略，能够在冻结的潜在世界模型中有效改善物理预测性能，尤其在遮挡和固定相机场景下表现突出。

title: DynaPix: Can Vision-Language Models Identify the Exact Future?
summary: Acting in a physical scene requires knowing its real later state, not a plausible one. Current evaluations often accept words or a realistic-looking image, so the predicted state is never checked against the true one. We introduce DynaPix (Dynamic Pixels), a benchmark that makes prediction checkable. Given a video clip that stops before a key event and a question about a later moment, a model must pick the true future image from close candidates or a large gallery. The scenes come from a physics simulator, so the correct image and its time are known exactly and the wrong options are deliberately similar. Models often succeed when a visible event marks the target moment, but are near chance when only elapsed time marks it. Gallery search is harder still, as the true image rarely ranks first. People handle the elapsed-time items well, so the difficulty lies with the models, not the questions. Training on scene accounts drawn from the simulator's true record, not a teacher's guess, repairs much of this but not the longer elapsed time case. DynaPix thus exposes a temporal-anchoring gap: models attach a prediction to an event far better than to time itself.

AI.tldr: DynaPix是一个让物理场景未来状态预测可检验的基准测试。它使用物理模拟器的视频片段，要求模型从相似候选项或大型图库中选出真实的未来图像。研究发现模型在可见事件标记目标时刻时表现良好，但仅靠时间流逝标记时接近随机；人类则能很好处理后者，说明困难在模型而非问题本身。
AI.motivation: 当前对物理场景预测的评估往往只接受文字描述或看似合理的图像，预测结果从未与真实状态核对。作者希望建立一个可以严格检验预测是否正确（与真实未来画面对比）的基准测试，以更真实地衡量模型对物理世界的理解能力。
AI.method: 构建DynaPix基准：从物理模拟器中生成视频片段（在关键事件前停下），测试时模型需从高度相似的候选图或大型图库中选出对应特定日后时刻的真实未来图像。由于场景来自物理模拟器，正确图像及其精确时间已知，错误的选项被刻意设计为非常相似。另外还探索了用模拟器真实记录训练模型以修复性能。
AI.result: 模型在可见事件标记目标时刻时表现良好，但仅靠经过的时间标记时接近随机猜测；在大型图库搜索中，真实图像很少排在第一位；人类受试者能很好地完成基于时间流逝的项目。用模拟器真实记录训练可大幅修复性能，但更长时间流逝的情况仍未解决。
AI.conclusion: DynaPix揭示了"时间锚定差距"：模型将预测锚定到具体事件的能力远强于锚定到时间本身的能力。现有模型缺乏对物理场景随时间演化的精确时间感知，这是未来需要解决的挑战。
